name: mem_domRestrict
statement: theorem mem_domRestrict {S R x y : ZFSet} : x.pair y ∈ S ◁ R ↔ x ∈ S ∧ x.pair y ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [domRestrict, mem_sep]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hR, x', y', hp, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pair_inj.mp hp
    exact ⟨hx, hR⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hR⟩
    exact ⟨hR, x, y, rfl, hx⟩

name: domRestrict_subset
statement: theorem domRestrict_subset {S R : ZFSet} : S ◁ R ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [domRestrict]; exact sep_subset

name: domRestrict_is_rel
statement: @[zrel] theorem domRestrict_is_rel {S R A B : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B) : S ◁ R ⊆ A.prod B
proof:
:=
  fun _ hp => hR (domRestrict_subset hp)

name: IsPFunc.domRestrict
statement:
@[zpfun] theorem IsPFunc.domRestrict {S R A B : ZFSet} (hR : R.IsPFunc A B) :
    (S ◁ R).IsPFunc A B
proof:
:=
  ⟨domRestrict_is_rel hR.1,
    fun x y hxy z hxz => hR.2 x y (domRestrict_subset hxy) z (domRestrict_subset hxz)⟩

name: mem_override
statement:
theorem mem_override {σ x n y m : ZFSet} :
    y.pair m ∈ σ[x ↦ n] ↔ (y ≠ x ∧ y.pair m ∈ σ) ∨ (y = x ∧ m = n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [override, mem_union, mem_sep, mem_singleton, pair_inj]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hσ, y', m', hp, hy⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pair_inj.mp hp
      exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hσ⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨hy, hσ⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hσ, y, m, rfl, hy⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: pair_mem_override_self
statement: theorem pair_mem_override_self {σ x n : ZFSet} : x.pair n ∈ σ[x ↦ n]
proof:
:=
  mem_override.mpr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)

name: override_is_rel
statement:
@[zrel] theorem override_is_rel {σ x n A B : ZFSet} (hσ : σ ⊆ A.prod B) (hx : x ∈ A)
    (hn : n ∈ B) : σ[x ↦ n] ⊆ A.prod B
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [override, mem_union, mem_sep, mem_singleton] at hp
  rcases hp with ⟨hσp, -⟩ | rfl
  · exact hσ hσp
  · exact pair_mem_prod.mpr ⟨hx, hn⟩

name: IsPFunc.override
statement:
@[zpfun] theorem IsPFunc.override {σ x n A B : ZFSet} (hσ : σ.IsPFunc A B) (hx : x ∈ A)
    (hn : n ∈ B) : (σ[x ↦ n]).IsPFunc A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨override_is_rel hσ.1 hx hn, fun y m hym m' hym' => ?_⟩
  rw [mem_override] at hym hym'
  rcases hym with ⟨hy, hσm⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · rcases hym' with ⟨-, hσm'⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩
    · exact hσ.2 y m hσm m' hσm'
    · exact absurd rfl hy
  · rcases hym' with ⟨hy', -⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact absurd rfl hy'
    · rfl

name: mem_dom_override_self
statement:
@[zdom] theorem mem_dom_override_self {σ x n A B : ZFSet} (hσ : σ.IsPFunc A B) (hx : x ∈ A)
    (hn : n ∈ B) : x ∈ (σ[x ↦ n]).Dom (is_rel_of_is_pfunc (IsPFunc.override hσ hx hn))
proof:
:=
  mem_dom_of (override_is_rel hσ.1 hx hn) pair_mem_override_self

name: mem_dom_override
statement:
theorem mem_dom_override {σ x n A B y : ZFSet} (hσ : σ ⊆ A.prod B) (hx : x ∈ A) (hn : n ∈ B) :
    y ∈ (σ[x ↦ n]).Dom (override_is_rel hσ hx hn) ↔ y = x ∨ y ∈ σ.Dom hσ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_dom_iff (override_is_rel hσ hx hn), mem_dom_iff hσ]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    rcases mem_override.mp hm with ⟨-, hσm⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨m, hσm⟩
    · exact Or.inl rfl
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨m, hm⟩)
    · exact ⟨n, pair_mem_override_self⟩
    · by_cases hy : y = x
      · exact ⟨n, mem_override.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hy, rfl⟩)⟩
      · exact ⟨m, mem_override.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hy, hm⟩)⟩

name: fapply_override_self
statement:
theorem fapply_override_self {σ x n A B : ZFSet} (hσ : σ.IsPFunc A B) (hx : x ∈ A) (hn : n ∈ B) :
    @ᶻ(σ[x ↦ n]) ⟨x, by zdom⟩ = ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:=
  fapply.of_pair (IsPFunc.override hσ hx hn) pair_mem_override_self

name: union_is_rel
statement:
@[zrel] theorem union_is_rel {f g A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B) (hg : g ⊆ A.prod B) :
    f ∪ g ⊆ A.prod B
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases mem_union.mp hp with hp | hp
  · exact hf hp
  · exact hg hp

name: IsPFunc.union
statement:
@[zpfun] theorem IsPFunc.union {f g A B : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) (hg : g.IsPFunc A B)
    (h : ∀ x y z : ZFSet, x.pair y ∈ f → x.pair z ∈ g → False) : (f ∪ g).IsPFunc A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨union_is_rel hf.1 hg.1, fun x y hxy z hxz => ?_⟩
  rcases mem_union.mp hxy with hxy | hxy <;> rcases mem_union.mp hxz with hxz | hxz
  · exact hf.2 x y hxy z hxz
  · exact (h x y z hxy hxz).elim
  · exact (h x z y hxz hxy).elim
  · exact hg.2 x y hxy z hxz

name: IsPFunc.empty
statement: @[zpfun] theorem IsPFunc.empty {A B : ZFSet} : (∅ : ZFSet).IsPFunc A B
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun z hz => absurd hz (notMem_empty z), fun x y hxy => absurd hxy (notMem_empty (x.pair y))⟩

name: domRestrict_mono
statement: theorem domRestrict_mono {S R₁ R₂ : ZFSet} (h : R₁ ⊆ R₂) : S ◁ R₁ ⊆ S ◁ R₂
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [domRestrict, mem_sep] at hp ⊢
  exact ⟨h hp.1, hp.2⟩

name: composition_mono_left
statement:
theorem composition_mono_left {g₁ g₂ f A B C : ZFSet} (h : g₁ ⊆ g₂) :
    composition g₁ f A B C ⊆ composition g₂ f A B C
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨x, w, y, rfl, xA, yC, wB, hf, hg⟩ := mem_composition _ _ |>.mp hp
  exact (mem_composition _ _).mpr ⟨x, w, y, rfl, xA, yC, wB, hf, h hg⟩

name: loopIter_is_rel
statement: @[zrel] theorem loopIter_is_rel {S t f R : ZFSet} (n : ℕ) : loopIter S t f R n ⊆ S.prod S
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact empty_subset _
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [loopIter]
    exact union_is_rel (domRestrict_is_rel (is_rel_of_is_func Id.IsFunc))
      (domRestrict_is_rel is_rel_of_composition)

name: loop_is_rel
statement: @[zrel] theorem loop_is_rel {S t f R : ZFSet} : loop S t f R ⊆ S.prod S
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨r, hr, p_r⟩ := mem_sUnion.mp hp
  obtain ⟨-, n, rfl⟩ := mem_sep.mp hr
  exact loopIter_is_rel n p_r

name: mem_loop_iff
statement: theorem mem_loop_iff {S t f R p : ZFSet} : p ∈ loop S t f R ↔ ∃ n, p ∈ loopIter S t f R n
proof:
:= by
  rw [loop, mem_sUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, p_r⟩
    obtain ⟨-, n, rfl⟩ := mem_sep.mp hr
    exact ⟨n, p_r⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨loopIter S t f R n,
      mem_sep.mpr ⟨mem_powerset.mpr (loopIter_is_rel n), n, rfl⟩, hn⟩

name: loopIter_succ_mono
statement:
theorem loopIter_succ_mono {S t f R : ZFSet} (n : ℕ) :
    loopIter S t f R n ⊆ loopIter S t f R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact empty_subset _
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [loopIter, loopIter]
    intro p hp
    rcases mem_union.mp hp with hp | hp
    · exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hp)
    · exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (domRestrict_mono (composition_mono_left ih) hp))

name: loopIter_le_mono
statement:
theorem loopIter_le_mono {S t f R : ZFSet} {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    loopIter S t f R m ⊆ loopIter S t f R n
proof:
:= by
  induction n, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact fun _ h => h
  | succ n _ ih => exact fun p hp => loopIter_succ_mono n (ih hp)

name: loopIter_pfunc
statement:
theorem loopIter_pfunc {S t f R : ZFSet} (hR : R.IsPFunc S S)
    (htf : ∀ x, x ∈ t → x ∈ f → False) (n : ℕ) : (loopIter S t f R n).IsPFunc S S
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact IsPFunc.empty
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [loopIter]
    exact IsPFunc.union (IsPFunc.domRestrict Id.IsPFunc)
      (IsPFunc.domRestrict (IsPFunc_of_composition_IsPFunc hR ih))
      fun x y z hy hz =>
        htf x (mem_domRestrict.mp hz).1 (mem_domRestrict.mp hy).1

name: loop_pfunc
statement:
@[zpfun] theorem loop_pfunc {S t f R : ZFSet} (hR : R.IsPFunc S S)
    (htf : ∀ x, x ∈ t → x ∈ f → False) : (loop S t f R).IsPFunc S S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨loop_is_rel, fun x y hxy z hxz => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := mem_loop_iff.mp hxy
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_loop_iff.mp hxz
  exact (loopIter_pfunc hR htf (max m n)).2 x
    y (loopIter_le_mono (Nat.le_max_left m n) hm)
    z (loopIter_le_mono (Nat.le_max_right m n) hn)

name: loop_unfold
statement:
theorem loop_unfold {S t f R : ZFSet} :
    loop S t f R = (f ◁ 𝟙S) ∪ (t ◁ composition (loop S t f R) R S S S)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_loop_iff.mp hp
    cases n with
    | zero => rw [loopIter] at hn; exact absurd hn (notMem_empty p)
    | succ n =>
      rw [loopIter] at hn
      rcases mem_union.mp hn with h | h
      · exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inl h)
      · exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (domRestrict_mono
          (composition_mono_left fun q hq => mem_loop_iff.mpr ⟨n, hq⟩) h))
  · intro hp
    rcases mem_union.mp hp with h | h
    · refine mem_loop_iff.mpr ⟨1, ?_⟩
      rw [loopIter]
      exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inl h)
    · rw [domRestrict, mem_sep] at h
      obtain ⟨hcomp, x, y, rfl, hxt⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨x', w, y', heq, hxS, hyS, hwS, hxw, hwy⟩ := (mem_composition _ _).mp hcomp
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pair_inj.mp heq
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_loop_iff.mp hwy
      refine mem_loop_iff.mpr ⟨n + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [loopIter]
      refine mem_union.mpr (Or.inr ?_)
      rw [domRestrict, mem_sep]
      exact ⟨(mem_composition _ _).mpr ⟨x, w, y, rfl, hxS, hyS, hwS, hxw, hn⟩, x, y, rfl, hxt⟩

name: loop_least
statement:
theorem loop_least {S t f R X : ZFSet} (hstop : f ◁ 𝟙S ⊆ X)
    (hstep : t ◁ composition X R S S S ⊆ X) : loop S t f R ⊆ X
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_loop_iff.mp hp
  clear hp
  induction n generalizing p with
  | zero => rw [loopIter] at hn; exact absurd hn (notMem_empty p)
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [loopIter] at hn
    rcases mem_union.mp hn with h | h
    · exact hstop h
    · exact hstep (domRestrict_mono (composition_mono_left fun _ hq => ih hq) h)

name: lambda_isPFunc
statement: @[zpfun] theorem lambda_isPFunc {A B : ZFSet} {f : ZFSet → ZFSet} : (lambda A B f).IsPFunc A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨lambda_subset, fun x y hxy z hxz => ?_⟩
  rw [lambda_spec] at hxy hxz
  rw [hxy.2.2, hxz.2.2]

name: mem_Store
statement: theorem mem_Store {σ : ZFSet} : σ ∈ Store V ↔ σ.IsPFunc V Nat
proof:
:= by
  rw [Store, mem_sep, mem_powerset]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨h.1, h⟩⟩

name: IsPFunc_of_mem_Store
statement: @[zpfun] theorem IsPFunc_of_mem_Store {σ : ZFSet} (hσ : σ ∈ Store V) : σ.IsPFunc V Nat
proof:
:=
  mem_Store.mp hσ

name: override_mem_Store
statement:
theorem override_mem_Store {σ x n : ZFSet} (hσ : σ ∈ Store V) (hx : x ∈ V) (hn : n ∈ Nat) :
    σ[x ↦ n] ∈ Store V
proof:
:=
  mem_Store.mpr (IsPFunc.override (IsPFunc_of_mem_Store hσ) hx hn)

name: sem_lit
statement:
@[simp] theorem sem_lit (n : ZFNat) :
    ⟦(lit n : Expr V)⟧ₑ = λᶻ : Store V → Nat | _σ ↦ n.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem]

name: sem_var
statement:
@[simp] theorem sem_var (x : V) :
    ⟦var x⟧ₑ =
      ((Store V).prod Nat).sep fun p => ∃ σ n : ZFSet, p = σ.pair n ∧ x.val.pair n ∈ σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem]

name: sem_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem sem_add (e₁ e₂ : Expr V) :
    ⟦add e₁ e₂⟧ₑ = ((Store V).prod Nat).sep fun p => ∃ σ : ZFSet, ∃ n₁ n₂ : ZFNat,
      p = σ.pair (n₁ + n₂).val ∧ σ.pair n₁.val ∈ ⟦e₁⟧ₑ ∧ σ.pair n₂.val ∈ ⟦e₂⟧ₑ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem]

name: sem_is_rel
statement: @[zrel] theorem sem_is_rel (e : Expr V) : ⟦e⟧ₑ ⊆ (Store V).prod Nat
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | lit n => rw [sem_lit]; exact lambda_subset
  | var x => rw [sem_var]; exact sep_subset
  | add e₁ e₂ => rw [sem_add]; exact sep_subset

name: mem_sem_lit
statement:
theorem mem_sem_lit {σ m : ZFSet} {n : ZFNat} :
    σ.pair m ∈ ⟦(lit n : Expr V)⟧ₑ ↔ σ ∈ Store V ∧ m = n.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_lit, lambda_spec]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hσ, -, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hσ, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hσ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hσ, n.property, rfl⟩

name: mem_sem_var
statement:
theorem mem_sem_var {σ m : ZFSet} {x : V} :
    σ.pair m ∈ ⟦var x⟧ₑ ↔ σ ∈ Store V ∧ x.val.pair m ∈ σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_var, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hσ, -⟩, σ', n', hp, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pair_inj.mp hp
    exact ⟨hσ, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨hσ, hx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hσ, (pair_mem_prod.mp ((IsPFunc_of_mem_Store hσ).1 hx)).2⟩, σ, m, rfl, hx⟩

name: mem_sem_add
statement:
theorem mem_sem_add {σ m : ZFSet} {e₁ e₂ : Expr V} :
    σ.pair m ∈ ⟦add e₁ e₂⟧ₑ ↔
      ∃ n₁ n₂ : ZFNat, m = (n₁ + n₂).val ∧ σ.pair n₁.val ∈ ⟦e₁⟧ₑ ∧ σ.pair n₂.val ∈ ⟦e₂⟧ₑ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_add, mem_sep]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, σ', n₁, n₂, hp, h₁, h₂⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pair_inj.mp hp
    exact ⟨n₁, n₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩
  · rintro ⟨n₁, n₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨pair_mem_prod.mpr ⟨(pair_mem_prod.mp (sem_is_rel e₁ h₁)).1, (n₁ + n₂).property⟩,
      σ, n₁, n₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩

name: sem_lit_isFunc
statement: @[zfun] theorem sem_lit_isFunc (n : ZFNat) : (Store V).IsFunc Nat ⟦(lit n : Expr V)⟧ₑ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_lit]; exact lambda_isFunc fun _ => n.property

name: sem_pfunc
statement: @[zpfun] theorem sem_pfunc (e : Expr V) : ⟦e⟧ₑ.IsPFunc (Store V) Nat
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sem_is_rel e, ?_⟩
  induction e with
  | lit n =>
    intro σ m hm m' hm'
    rw [(mem_sem_lit.mp hm).2, (mem_sem_lit.mp hm').2]
  | var x =>
    intro σ m hm m' hm'
    rw [mem_sem_var] at hm hm'
    exact (IsPFunc_of_mem_Store hm.1).2 _ _ hm.2 _ hm'.2
  | add e₁ e₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro σ m hm m' hm'
    obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩ := mem_sem_add.mp hm
    obtain ⟨n₁', n₂', rfl, h₁', h₂'⟩ := mem_sem_add.mp hm'
    rw [Subtype.ext (ih₁ _ _ h₁ _ h₁'), Subtype.ext (ih₂ _ _ h₂ _ h₂')]

name: mem_dom_sem_iff
statement:
theorem mem_dom_sem_iff {σ : ZFSet} (hσ : σ ∈ Store V) (e : Expr V) :
    σ ∈ ⟦e⟧ₑ.Dom ↔ e.FV ⊆ σ.Dom
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | lit n =>
    rw [FV, is_func_dom_eq (sem_lit_isFunc n)]
    exact ⟨fun _ => empty_subset _, fun _ => hσ⟩
  | var x =>
    rw [FV, mem_dom_iff (sem_is_rel _), singleton_subset_mem_iff,
      mem_dom_iff (is_rel_of_is_pfunc (IsPFunc_of_mem_Store hσ))]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
      exact ⟨m, (mem_sem_var.mp hm).2⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
      exact ⟨m, mem_sem_var.mpr ⟨hσ, hm⟩⟩
  | add e₁ e₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [FV]
    constructor
    · intro h y hy
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (mem_dom_iff (sem_is_rel _)).mp h
      obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, -, h₁, h₂⟩ := mem_sem_add.mp hm
      rcases mem_union.mp hy with hy | hy
      · exact ih₁.mp ((mem_dom_iff (sem_is_rel _)).mpr ⟨_, h₁⟩) hy
      · exact ih₂.mp ((mem_dom_iff (sem_is_rel _)).mpr ⟨_, h₂⟩) hy
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩ :=
        (mem_dom_iff (sem_is_rel _)).mp (ih₁.mpr fun y hy => h (mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hy)))
      obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩ :=
        (mem_dom_iff (sem_is_rel _)).mp (ih₂.mpr fun y hy => h (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hy)))
      have hn₁ : m₁ ∈ Nat := (pair_mem_prod.mp (sem_is_rel e₁ hm₁)).2
      have hn₂ : m₂ ∈ Nat := (pair_mem_prod.mp (sem_is_rel e₂ hm₂)).2
      exact (mem_dom_iff (sem_is_rel _)).mpr
        ⟨_, mem_sem_add.mpr ⟨⟨m₁, hn₁⟩, ⟨m₂, hn₂⟩, rfl, hm₁, hm₂⟩⟩

name: tt_subset
statement: theorem tt_subset (e : Expr V) : e.tt ⊆ Store V
proof: := by rw [tt]; exact sep_subset

name: ff_subset
statement: theorem ff_subset (e : Expr V) : e.ff ⊆ Store V
proof: := by rw [ff]; exact sep_subset

name: tt_ff_disjoint
statement: theorem tt_ff_disjoint (e : Expr V) {σ : ZFSet} (ht : σ ∈ e.tt) (hf : σ ∈ e.ff) : False
proof:
:= by
  rw [tt, mem_sep] at ht
  rw [ff, mem_sep] at hf
  obtain ⟨-, n, hn, n_ne⟩ := ht
  exact n_ne ((sem_pfunc e).2 σ n hn ∅ hf.2)

name: sem_skip
statement: @[simp] theorem sem_skip : ⟦(skip : Cmd V)⟧ᶜ = 𝟙(Store V)
proof: := by rw [sem]

name: sem_assign
statement:
@[simp] theorem sem_assign (x : V) (e : Expr V) :
    ⟦assign x e⟧ᶜ = λᶻ : ⟦e⟧ₑ.Dom → Store V | h : σ ↦ σ[x.val ↦ (@ᶻ⟦e⟧ₑ ⟨σ, h⟩).val]
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem]

name: sem_seq
statement:
@[simp] theorem sem_seq (c₁ c₂ : Cmd V) :
    ⟦seq c₁ c₂⟧ᶜ = composition ⟦c₂⟧ᶜ ⟦c₁⟧ᶜ (Store V) (Store V) (Store V)
proof: := by rw [sem]

name: sem_ite
statement:
@[simp] theorem sem_ite (e : Expr V) (c₁ c₂ : Cmd V) :
    ⟦ite e c₁ c₂⟧ᶜ = (e.tt ◁ ⟦c₁⟧ᶜ) ∪ (e.ff ◁ ⟦c₂⟧ᶜ)
proof: := by rw [sem]

name: sem_whileDo
statement:
@[simp] theorem sem_whileDo (e : Expr V) (c : Cmd V) :
    ⟦whileDo e c⟧ᶜ = loop (Store V) e.tt e.ff ⟦c⟧ᶜ
proof: := by rw [sem]

name: sem_pfunc
statement: @[zpfun] theorem sem_pfunc (c : Cmd V) : ⟦c⟧ᶜ.IsPFunc (Store V) (Store V)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | skip => rw [sem_skip]; zpfun
  | assign x e =>
    rw [sem_assign]
    exact pfunc_weaken lambda_isPFunc (dom_subset _ _) fun _ h => h
  | seq c₁ c₂ ih₁ ih₂ => rw [sem_seq]; zpfun
  | ite e c₁ c₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [sem_ite]
    have hd : ∀ σ τ τ' : ZFSet, σ.pair τ ∈ e.tt ◁ ⟦c₁⟧ᶜ → σ.pair τ' ∈ e.ff ◁ ⟦c₂⟧ᶜ → False :=
      fun σ τ τ' h₁ h₂ => tt_ff_disjoint e (mem_domRestrict.mp h₁).1 (mem_domRestrict.mp h₂).1
    apply IsPFunc.union <;> zpfun
  | whileDo e c ih =>
    rw [sem_whileDo]
    have hd : ∀ σ : ZFSet, σ ∈ e.tt → σ ∈ e.ff → False := fun σ => tt_ff_disjoint e
    zpfun

name: sem_is_rel
statement: @[zrel] theorem sem_is_rel (c : Cmd V) : ⟦c⟧ᶜ ⊆ (Store V).prod (Store V)
proof: := (sem_pfunc c).1

name: sem_assign_isFunc
statement:
theorem sem_assign_isFunc (x : V) (e : Expr V) :
    ⟦e⟧ₑ.Dom.IsFunc (Store V) ⟦assign x e⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_assign]
  apply lambda_isFunc
  intro σ hσ
  rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hσ)]
  exact override_mem_Store (dom_subset _ _ hσ) x.property (fapply_mem_range _ hσ)

name: sem_assign_lit_isFunc
statement:
@[zfun] theorem sem_assign_lit_isFunc (x : V) (n : ZFNat) :
    (Store V).IsFunc (Store V) ⟦assign x (lit n)⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have h := sem_assign_isFunc x (lit n)
  rwa [is_func_dom_eq (sem_lit_isFunc n)] at h

name: sem_seq_isFunc
statement:
@[zfun] theorem sem_seq_isFunc {c₁ c₂ : Cmd V} (h₁ : (Store V).IsFunc (Store V) ⟦c₁⟧ᶜ)
    (h₂ : (Store V).IsFunc (Store V) ⟦c₂⟧ᶜ) : (Store V).IsFunc (Store V) ⟦seq c₁ c₂⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_seq]; exact IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc h₂ h₁

name: sem_seq_eq_fcomp
statement:
theorem sem_seq_eq_fcomp {c₁ c₂ : Cmd V} (h₁ : (Store V).IsFunc (Store V) ⟦c₁⟧ᶜ)
    (h₂ : (Store V).IsFunc (Store V) ⟦c₂⟧ᶜ) : ⟦seq c₁ c₂⟧ᶜ = ⟦c₂⟧ᶜ ∘ᶻ ⟦c₁⟧ᶜ
proof: := sem_seq c₁ c₂

name: mem_dom_sem_assign_iff
statement:
theorem mem_dom_sem_assign_iff {σ : ZFSet} (x : V) (e : Expr V) :
    σ ∈ ⟦assign x e⟧ᶜ.Dom ↔ σ ∈ ⟦e⟧ₑ.Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_dom_iff (sem_is_rel _), ← mem_dom_iff (is_rel_of_is_func (sem_assign_isFunc x e)),
    is_func_dom_eq (sem_assign_isFunc x e)]

name: sem_seq_skip
statement: theorem sem_seq_skip (c : Cmd V) : ⟦seq c skip⟧ᶜ = ⟦c⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_seq, sem_skip, Id.composition_left (sem_is_rel c)]

name: sem_skip_seq
statement: theorem sem_skip_seq (c : Cmd V) : ⟦seq skip c⟧ᶜ = ⟦c⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_seq, sem_skip, Id.composition_right (sem_is_rel c)]

name: sem_seq_assoc
statement: theorem sem_seq_assoc (c₁ c₂ c₃ : Cmd V) : ⟦seq (seq c₁ c₂) c₃⟧ᶜ = ⟦seq c₁ (seq c₂ c₃)⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_seq, sem_seq, sem_seq, sem_seq, composition_assoc]

name: not_mem_dom_assign_of_unassigned
statement:
theorem not_mem_dom_assign_of_unassigned (x y : V) {σ : ZFSet} (hσ : σ ∈ Store V)
    (hy : y.val ∉ σ.Dom) : σ ∉ ⟦assign x (add (var y) (lit 1))⟧ᶜ.Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_dom_sem_assign_iff, mem_dom_sem_iff hσ]
  intro h
  exact hy (h (mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (mem_singleton.mpr rfl))))

name: sem_whileDo_exit
statement:
theorem sem_whileDo_exit (e : Expr V) (c : Cmd V) {σ : ZFSet} (hσ : σ ∈ e.ff) :
    σ.pair σ ∈ ⟦whileDo e c⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_whileDo]
  refine mem_loop_iff.mpr ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rw [loopIter]
  exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (mem_domRestrict.mpr
    ⟨hσ, pair_self_mem_Id (ff_subset e hσ)⟩))

name: sem_whileDo_step
statement:
theorem sem_whileDo_step (e : Expr V) (c : Cmd V) {σ σ' τ : ZFSet} (hσ : σ ∈ e.tt)
    (hbody : σ.pair σ' ∈ ⟦c⟧ᶜ) (hloop : σ'.pair τ ∈ ⟦whileDo e c⟧ᶜ) :
    σ.pair τ ∈ ⟦whileDo e c⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hσS, hσ'S⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp (sem_is_rel c hbody)
  rw [sem_whileDo] at hloop
  obtain ⟨-, hτS⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp (loop_is_rel hloop)
  rw [sem_whileDo, loop_unfold]
  exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (mem_domRestrict.mpr ⟨hσ,
    (mem_composition _ _).mpr ⟨σ, σ', τ, rfl, hσS, hτS, hσ'S, hbody, hloop⟩⟩))

name: sem_whileDo_least
statement:
theorem sem_whileDo_least (e : Expr V) (c : Cmd V) {X : ZFSet}
    (hstop : e.ff ◁ 𝟙(Store V) ⊆ X)
    (hstep : e.tt ◁ composition X ⟦c⟧ᶜ (Store V) (Store V) (Store V) ⊆ X) :
    ⟦whileDo e c⟧ᶜ ⊆ X
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_whileDo]
  exact loop_least hstop hstep

name: sem_whileDo_unfold
statement:
theorem sem_whileDo_unfold (e : Expr V) (c : Cmd V) :
    ⟦whileDo e c⟧ᶜ = ⟦ite e (seq c (whileDo e c)) skip⟧ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [sem_whileDo, loop_unfold]
  rw [sem_ite, sem_seq, sem_skip, sem_whileDo, union_comm]

name: assign_incr
statement:
theorem assign_incr (x : V) {σ σ' : ZFSet} (h : σ.pair σ' ∈ ⟦assign x (add (var x) (lit 1))⟧ᶜ) :
    ∃ n m : ZFNat, x.val.pair n.val ∈ σ ∧ x.val.pair m.val ∈ σ' ∧ n < m
proof:
:= by
  rw [sem_assign, lambda_spec] at h
  obtain ⟨hσ, -, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [dif_pos hσ]
  obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hv, h₁, h₂⟩ := mem_sem_add.mp (fapply.def (Expr.sem_pfunc _) hσ)
  obtain rfl : n₂ = 1 := Subtype.ext (mem_sem_lit.mp h₂).2
  refine ⟨n₁, n₁ + 1, (mem_sem_var.mp h₁).2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hv]
    exact pair_mem_override_self
  · transfer ZFNat → ℕ => omega

name: mk_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (x : ZFNat × ZFNat) : @Eq ZFInt ⟦x⟧ (mk x)
proof: := rfl

name: mk_out
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_out : ∀ x : ZFInt, mk x.out = x
proof: := Quotient.out_eq

name: eq
statement: theorem eq {x y : ZFNat × ZFNat} : mk x = mk y ↔ ZFSet.zrel x y
proof: := Quotient.eq

name: sound
statement: theorem sound {x y : ZFNat × ZFNat} (h : ZFSet.zrel x y) : mk x = mk y
proof: := Quotient.sound h

name: exact
statement: theorem exact {x y : ZFNat × ZFNat} : mk x = mk y → ZFSet.zrel x y
proof: := Quotient.exact

name: zero_eq
statement: theorem zero_eq : (0 : ZFInt) = mk (0, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: one_eq
statement: theorem one_eq : (1 : ZFInt) = mk (1, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: one_ne_zero
statement: theorem one_ne_zero : (1 : ZFInt) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_eq, one_eq]
  rintro h
  rw [ZFInt.eq, ZFSet.zrel] at h
  simp only [add_zero] at h
  unfold_projs at h
  injection h with h
  rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at h
  simp only [mem_insert_iff, or_iff_right_iff_imp, forall_eq] at h
  nomatch h

name: mk_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_zero_iff {n m} : ZFInt.mk (n,m) = 0 ↔ n = m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [ZFInt.zero_eq, ZFInt.eq, ZFSet.zrel] at h
    exact ZFNat.add_right_cancel.mp h
  · rintro rfl
    exact ZFInt.sound rfl

name: add_eq
statement: theorem add_eq (n m : ZFNat × ZFNat) : mk n + mk m = mk (n.1 + m.1, n.2 + m.2)
proof: := rfl

name: add_assoc
statement: theorem add_assoc (n m k : ZFInt) : n + (m + k) = n + m + k
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Quotient.ind
  induction m using Quotient.ind
  induction k using Quotient.ind
  simp_rw [mk_eq, ZFInt.add_eq, ZFNat.add_assoc]

name: add_comm
statement: theorem add_comm (n m : ZFInt) : n + m = m + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Quotient.ind
  induction m using Quotient.ind
  simp_rw [mk_eq, ZFInt.add_eq, ZFNat.add_comm]

name: add_left_comm
statement: lemma add_left_comm (n m k : ZFInt) : n + (m + k) = m + (n + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc, add_assoc, add_comm n]

name: add_right_comm
statement: lemma add_right_comm (n m k : ZFInt) : (n + m) + k = (n + k) + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_assoc, add_comm m, add_assoc]

name: add_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_zero {x : ZFInt} : x + 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.ind
  simp_rw [mk_eq, zero_eq, ZFInt.add_eq, ZFNat.add_zero]

name: zero_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_add {x : ZFInt} : 0 + x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, add_zero]

name: neg_eq
statement: theorem neg_eq (n : ZFNat × ZFNat) : -mk n = mk (n.2, n.1)
proof: := rfl

name: neg_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_neg (n : ZFInt) : -(-n) = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Quotient.ind
  rw [mk_eq, neg_eq, neg_eq]

name: neg_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_zero : -(0 : ZFInt) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_eq, neg_eq]

name: neg_inj
statement: theorem neg_inj {a b : ZFInt} : -a = -b ↔ a = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← neg_neg a, ← neg_neg b, h], congrArg _⟩

name: neg_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_eq_zero {a : ZFInt} : -a = 0 ↔ a = 0
proof: := ZFInt.neg_inj (b := 0)

name: neg_ne_zero
statement: theorem neg_ne_zero {a : ZFInt} : -a ≠ 0 ↔ a ≠ 0
proof: := not_congr neg_eq_zero

name: add_left_neg
statement: theorem add_left_neg {a : ZFInt} : -a + a = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  apply sound
  rw [ZFNat.add_comm]

name: add_right_neg
statement: theorem add_right_neg (a : ZFInt) : a + -a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  exact add_left_neg

name: neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero
statement: theorem neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero {a b : ZFInt} (h : a + b = 0) : -a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← @add_zero (-a), ← h, add_assoc, add_left_neg, zero_add]

name: eq_neg_of_eq_neg
statement: theorem eq_neg_of_eq_neg {a b : ZFInt} (h : a = -b) : b = -a
proof:
:= by
  rw [h, neg_neg]

name: eq_neg_comm
statement: theorem eq_neg_comm {a b : ZFInt} : a = -b ↔ b = -a
proof: := ⟨eq_neg_of_eq_neg, eq_neg_of_eq_neg⟩

name: neg_eq_comm
statement: theorem neg_eq_comm {a b : ZFInt} : -a = b ↔ -b = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, eq_neg_comm, eq_comm]

name: neg_add_cancel_left
statement: theorem neg_add_cancel_left (a b : ZFInt) : -a + (a + b) = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc, add_left_neg, zero_add]

name: add_neg_cancel_left
statement: theorem add_neg_cancel_left (a b : ZFInt) : a + (-a + b) = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc, add_right_neg, zero_add]

name: add_neg_cancel_right
statement: theorem add_neg_cancel_right (a b : ZFInt) : a + b + -b = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_assoc, add_right_neg, add_zero]

name: neg_add_cancel_right
statement: theorem neg_add_cancel_right (a b : ZFInt) : a + -b + b = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_assoc, add_left_neg, add_zero]

name: add_left_cancel
statement: theorem add_left_cancel {a b c : ZFInt} (h : a + b = a + c) : b = c
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : -a + (a + b) = -a + (a + c) := by rw [h]
  simp only [add_assoc, add_left_neg, zero_add] at h₁
  exact h₁

name: neg_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_add {a b : ZFInt} : -(a + b) = -a + -b
proof:
:= by
  apply add_left_cancel (a := a + b)
  rw [add_right_neg, add_comm a, add_assoc, ← add_assoc b, add_right_neg, add_zero, add_right_neg]

name: sub_eq
statement: theorem sub_eq (n m : ZFNat × ZFNat) : mk n - mk m = mk (n.1 + m.2, n.2 + m.1)
proof: := rfl

name: sub_eq_add_neg
statement: theorem sub_eq_add_neg {a b : ZFInt} : a - b = a + -b
proof: := rfl

name: add_neg_one
statement: theorem add_neg_one (i : ZFInt) : i + -1 = i - 1
proof: := rfl

name: sub_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_self (a : ZFInt) : a - a = 0
proof: := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_right_neg]

name: sub_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_zero (a : ZFInt) : a - 0 = a
proof: := by simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: zero_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_sub (a : ZFInt) : 0 - a = -a
proof: := by simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: sub_eq_zero_of_eq
statement: theorem sub_eq_zero_of_eq {a b : ZFInt} (h : a = b) : a - b = 0
proof: := by rw [h, sub_self]

name: eq_of_sub_eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_of_sub_eq_zero {a b : ZFInt} (h : a - b = 0) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 + b = b := by rw [zero_add]
  have : a - b + b = b := by rwa [h]
  rwa [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add_cancel_right] at this

name: sub_eq_zero
statement: theorem sub_eq_zero {a b : ZFInt} : a - b = 0 ↔ a = b
proof: := ⟨eq_of_sub_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero_of_eq⟩

name: sub_sub
statement: theorem sub_sub (a b c : ZFInt) : a - b - c = a - (b + c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]

name: neg_sub
statement: theorem neg_sub (a b : ZFInt) : -(a - b) = b - a
proof:
:= by
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]

name: sub_sub_self
statement: theorem sub_sub_self (a b : ZFInt) : a - (a - b) = b
proof:
:= by
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_right_neg]

name: sub_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_neg (a b : ZFInt) : a - -b = a + b
proof: := by simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: sub_add_cancel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_add_cancel (a b : ZFInt) : a - b + b = a
proof: := neg_add_cancel_right a b

name: add_sub_cancel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_sub_cancel (a b : ZFInt) : a + b - b = a
proof: := add_neg_cancel_right a b

name: add_sub_assoc
statement: theorem add_sub_assoc (a b c : ZFInt) : a + b - c = a + (b - c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← add_assoc, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: sub_left_cancel
statement: theorem sub_left_cancel (a b c : ZFInt) : a - c = b - c → a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rwa [← sub_eq_zero, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero, ← add_sub_assoc, add_comm, add_sub_cancel] at h

name: sub_right_cancel
statement: theorem sub_right_cancel (a b c : ZFInt) : c - a = c - b → a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_sub a, ← neg_sub b, neg_inj]
  apply sub_left_cancel

name: add_eq_sub_iff
statement:
theorem add_eq_sub_iff {a b c : ZFInt} : a + b = c ↔ a = c - b where
  mp
proof:
:= fun h => by rw [← h, add_sub_cancel]
  mpr := fun h => by rw [h, sub_add_cancel]

name: mul_wf
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [ZFSet.zrel] at *
  suffices h₃ : t * c + a * c + b * d + s * v + t * u = a * d + b * c + s * u + t * v + t * c by
    simp_rw [ZFNat.add_comm _ (t*c), ← ZFNat.add_assoc (t*c)] at h₃
    apply ZFNat.add_left_cancel.mp at h₃
    simp_rw [ZFNat.add_assoc, h₃]
  conv in t*c + a*c => rw [← right_distrib, ZFNat.add_comm, h₁, right_distrib]
  conv in _ + t*v + t*c => rw [← ZFNat.add_assoc, ← left_distrib, ZFNat.add_comm v c, h₂,
    left_distrib, ZFNat.add_assoc]
  apply ZFNat.add_right_cancel.mpr
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm, ZFNat.add_assoc, ZFNat.add_assoc, ← right_distrib, ZFNat.add_comm t a, h₁,
      right_distrib]
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm (b * d + s * d), ZFNat.add_assoc, ← ZFNat.add_assoc,  ← left_distrib s, ← h₂,
      left_distrib]
  ac_rfl

name: mul_eq
statement:
theorem mul_eq (n m : ZFNat × ZFNat) :
  mk n * mk m = mk (n.1 * m.1 + n.2 * m.2, n.1 * m.2 + n.2 * m.1)
proof: := rfl

name: mul_comm
statement: theorem mul_comm (n m : ZFInt) : n * m = m * n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Quotient.ind
  induction m using Quotient.ind
  apply sound
  rw [ZFSet.zrel]
  ac_rfl

name: left_distrib
statement: theorem left_distrib (a b c : ZFInt) : a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  induction b using Quotient.ind
  induction c using Quotient.ind
  rename_i a b c
  let ⟨a₁, a₂⟩ := a
  let ⟨b₁, b₂⟩ := b
  let ⟨c₁, c₂⟩ := c
  apply sound
  simp_rw [ZFNat.left_distrib, ZFSet.zrel]
  ac_rfl

name: right_distrib
statement: theorem right_distrib (a b c : ZFInt) : (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, left_distrib, mul_comm, mul_comm b c]

name: zero_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_mul (a : ZFInt) : 0 * a = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  apply sound
  simp_rw [ZFNat.zero_mul]

name: mul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_zero (a : ZFInt) : a * 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, zero_mul]

name: mul_assoc
statement: theorem mul_assoc (a b c : ZFInt) : a * b * c = a * (b * c)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  induction b using Quotient.ind
  induction c using Quotient.ind
  apply sound
  simp_rw [ZFSet.zrel, ZFNat.left_distrib, ZFNat.right_distrib]
  ac_rfl

name: one_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_mul (a : ZFInt) : 1 * a = a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  apply sound
  simp_rw [ZFNat.one_mul, ZFNat.zero_mul, ZFNat.add_zero]
  apply ZFSet.zrel_eq.refl

name: mul_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_one (a : ZFInt) : a * 1 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, one_mul]

name: lt_succ
statement: theorem lt_succ {n : ZFInt} : n < n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Quotient.ind with
  | _ n =>
    obtain ⟨n, m⟩ := n
    rw [ZFInt.mk_eq, ZFInt.one_eq, ZFInt.add_eq]
    dsimp
    rw [ZFNat.add_zero]
    change n+m < m+(n+1)
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm, ZFNat.add_lt_add_iff_left, ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ]
    exact ZFNat.lt_succ

name: lt_trans
statement: theorem lt_trans {a b c : ZFInt} : a < b → b < c → a < c
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  induction b using Quotient.ind
  induction c using Quotient.ind
  rename_i a b c
  let ⟨a₁, a₂⟩ := a
  let ⟨b₁, b₂⟩ := b
  let ⟨c₁, c₂⟩ := c
  intros h₁ h₂
  let this := ZFNat.add_lt_trans h₁ h₂
  conv at this =>
    conv => lhs; rw [← ZFNat.add_assoc, ZFNat.add_comm b₂, ZFNat.add_comm b₁, ZFNat.add_assoc,
      ZFNat.add_assoc]
    conv => rhs; rw [← ZFNat.add_assoc, ZFNat.add_comm b₁, ZFNat.add_comm b₂, ← ZFNat.add_assoc,
      ZFNat.add_comm b₂, ZFNat.add_assoc, ZFNat.add_assoc]
    rw [ZFNat.add_lt_add_iff_right (k := b₂), ZFNat.add_lt_add_iff_right (k := b₁)]
  assumption

name: lt_irrefl
statement: theorem lt_irrefl {a : ZFInt} : ¬ a < a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind with
  | _ a =>
    let ⟨a₁, a₂⟩ := a
    intro h
    replace h : a₁ + a₂ < a₂ + a₁ := h
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm] at h
    nomatch ZFNat.lt_irrefl h

name: lt_zero_iff
statement: theorem lt_zero_iff {n m : ZFNat} : m < n ↔ 0 < ZFInt.mk (n,m)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n using ZFNat.induction generalizing m with
    | zero =>
      rw [ZFInt.zero_eq]
      change 0 + m < 0 + 0
      exact ZFNat.add_lt_add_left h 0
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [ZFInt.zero_eq]
      change 0 + m < 0 + n.succ
      exact ZFNat.add_lt_add_left h 0
  · intro h
    rw [ZFInt.zero_eq] at h
    change 0 + m < 0 + n at h
    exact ZFNat.add_lt_add_iff_left.mp h

name: neg_one_lt_zero
statement: theorem neg_one_lt_zero : (-1 : ZFInt) < 0
proof: := add_left_neg ▸ lt_succ (n := (-1))

name: zero_lt_one
statement: theorem zero_lt_one : (0 : ZFInt) < 1
proof: := ZFInt.zero_add (x:=1) ▸ lt_succ

name: le_trans
statement: theorem le_trans {a b c : ZFInt} : a ≤ b → b ≤ c → a ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁ h₂
  rcases h₁ with h₁ | rfl
  · rcases h₂ with h₂ | rfl
    · left
      exact lt_trans h₁ h₂
    · left; assumption
  · assumption

name: le_antisymm
statement: theorem le_antisymm {a b : ZFInt} : a ≤ b → b ≤ a → a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁ h₂
  rcases h₁ with h₁ | rfl
  · rcases h₂ with h₂ | rfl
    · nomatch lt_irrefl <| lt_trans h₁ h₂
    · rfl
  · rfl

name: le_total
statement: theorem le_total {a b : ZFInt} : a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  induction b using Quotient.ind
  rename_i a b
  let ⟨a₁, a₂⟩ := a
  let ⟨b₁, b₂⟩ := b
  rcases @ZFNat.le_total (a₁ + b₂) (a₂ + b₁) with (_ | _) | (h | h)
  · left; left; assumption
  · left; right; apply sound; assumption
  · right; left; rw [ZFNat.add_comm a₂, ZFNat.add_comm a₁] at h; assumption
  · right; right; apply sound; rw [ZFNat.add_comm a₂, ZFNat.add_comm a₁] at h; assumption

name: lt_iff_le_not_ge
statement: theorem lt_iff_le_not_ge {x y : ZFInt} : x < y ↔ x ≤ y ∧ ¬y ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro
    apply And.intro
    · left
      assumption
    · rintro (_ | rfl)
      · nomatch lt_irrefl (lt_trans ‹_› ‹_›)
      · nomatch lt_irrefl ‹_›
  · rintro ⟨h | rfl, h'⟩
    · assumption
    · simp only [LE.le, or_true] at h'
      contradiction

name: lt_neg_iff
statement: theorem lt_neg_iff {a b : ZFInt} : a < b ↔ -b < -a
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;>
  (
    intro le
    induction a using Quotient.ind
    induction b using Quotient.ind
    rename_i a b
    let ⟨a₁, a₂⟩ := a
    let ⟨b₁, b₂⟩ := b
    rw [ZFInt.mk_eq, ZFInt.mk_eq] at le ⊢
  )
  · change a₁ + b₂ < a₂ + b₁ at le
    change b₂ + a₁ < b₁ + a₂
    rwa [ZFNat.add_comm b₂, ZFNat.add_comm b₁]
  · change b₂ + a₁ < b₁ + a₂ at le
    change a₁ + b₂ < a₂ + b₁
    rwa [ZFNat.add_comm a₂, ZFNat.add_comm a₁]

name: le_neg_iff
statement: theorem le_neg_iff {a b : ZFInt} : a ≤ b ↔ -b ≤ -a
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;>
  (
    intro le
    induction a using Quotient.ind
    induction b using Quotient.ind
    rename_i a b
    let ⟨a₁, a₂⟩ := a
    let ⟨b₁, b₂⟩ := b
    rw [ZFInt.mk_eq, ZFInt.mk_eq] at le ⊢
  )
  · rcases le with le | le
    · left
      exact lt_neg_iff.mp le
    · rw [eq, ZFSet.zrel] at le
      right
      rwa [neg_eq, neg_eq, eq, ZFSet.zrel, ZFNat.add_comm b₂, ZFNat.add_comm b₁]
  · rcases le with le | le
    · left
      exact lt_neg_iff.mpr le
    · rw [neg_eq, neg_eq, eq, ZFSet.zrel] at le
      right
      rwa [eq, ZFSet.zrel, ZFNat.add_comm a₁, ZFNat.add_comm a₂]

name: ind
statement:
lemma ind {P : ZFNat → ZFNat → Prop} (n m : ZFNat) (zero : P 0 0)
  (succ_l : ∀ n m, P n m → P (n + 1) m) (succ_r : ∀ n m, P n m → P n (m + 1)) : P n m
proof:
:= by
  induction n using ZFNat.induction with
  | zero =>
    induction m using ZFNat.induction with
    | zero => exact zero
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [←ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ]
      exact succ_r 0 m ih
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [←ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ]
    exact succ_l n m ih

name: induction_pos
statement:
lemma induction_pos {P : ZFInt → Prop} (n : ZFInt) (n_pos : 0 ≤ n)
  (zero : P 0) (succ : ∀ k, P k → P (k + 1)) : P n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Quotient.ind
  rename_i n
  obtain ⟨n, m⟩ := n
  rcases lt_trichotomy n m with h | rfl | h
  · exfalso
    rw [ZFInt.lt_zero_iff] at h
    rcases n_pos with n_pos | eq
    · rw [ZFInt.zero_eq] at h n_pos
      change 0 + n < 0 + m at h
      change 0 + m < 0 + n at n_pos
      rw [ZFNat.zero_add, ZFNat.zero_add] at h n_pos
      nomatch ZFNat.lt_irrefl <| ZFNat.lt_trans h n_pos
    · rw [ZFInt.mk_eq] at eq
      rcases ZFInt.mk_eq_zero_iff.mp eq.symm with rfl
      rw [eq] at h
      change n + n < n + n at h
      nomatch ZFNat.lt_irrefl h
  · rcases n_pos with n_pos | eq
    · rw [ZFInt.zero_eq] at n_pos
      change 0 + n < 0 + n at n_pos
      nomatch ZFNat.lt_irrefl n_pos
    · rwa [←eq]
  · let k := n - m
    have : n = k + m := by
      apply ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq _ rfl
      left
      exact h
    rw [this]
    induction k using ZFNat.induction with
    | zero =>
      rw [ZFInt.zero_eq] at zero
      rwa [ZFNat.zero_add, ZFInt.mk_eq, ZFInt.eq (x := (m,m)) (y := (0,0)) |>.mpr rfl]
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [ZFNat.add_comm] at ih
      rw [←ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ, ZFNat.add_comm, ZFNat.add_assoc]
      specialize succ <| ZFInt.mk (m+k,m)
      rw [ZFInt.one_eq, ZFInt.add_eq] at succ
      dsimp at succ
      rw [ZFNat.add_zero, ←ZFInt.mk_eq] at succ
      exact succ ih

name: induction_neg
statement:
lemma induction_neg {P : ZFInt → Prop} (n : ZFInt) (n_neg : n ≤ 0)
  (zero : P 0) (succ : ∀ k, P k → P (k - 1)) : P n
proof:
:= by
  have  : 0 ≤ -n := by rwa [← ZFInt.neg_zero, ZFInt.le_neg_iff, neg_neg n, neg_neg 0]
  letI P' n := P (-n)
  suffices P' (-n) by
    unfold P' at this
    rwa [ZFInt.neg_neg] at this
  have succ' : ∀ k, P' k → P' (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold P' at hk ⊢
    rw [ZFInt.neg_add]
    exact succ _ hk
  exact induction_pos (P := P') (-n) this zero succ'

name: induction
statement:
@[induction_eliminator]
theorem induction {P : ZFInt → Prop} (n : ZFInt)
  (zero : P 0) (pos : ∀ k, P k → P (k + 1)) (neg : ∀ k, P k → P (k - 1)) : P n
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy n 0 with h | rfl | h
  · exact induction_neg n (Or.inl h) zero neg
  · exact zero
  · exact induction_pos n (Or.inl h) zero pos

name: sign_cases
statement:
@[cases_eliminator]
theorem sign_cases {P : ZFInt → Prop} (n : ZFInt)
  (zero : P 0) (neg : n < 0 → P n) (pos : 0 < n → P n) : P n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact zero
  | pos k ih =>
    rcases lt_trichotomy (k+1) 0 with h | h | h
    · exact neg h
    · rwa [h]
    · exact pos h
  | neg k ih =>
    rcases lt_trichotomy (k-1) 0 with h | h | h
    · exact neg h
    · rwa [h]
    · exact pos h

name: cases
statement:
@[cases_eliminator]
theorem cases {P : ZFInt → Prop} (n : ZFInt) (pos : 0 ≤ n → P n) (neg : n < 0 → P n) : P n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact pos (Or.inr rfl)
  | pos n ih =>
    generalize h : n + 1 = m at *
    cases m using sign_cases with
    | zero => exact pos (Or.inr rfl)
    | neg h => exact neg h
    | pos h => exact pos (Or.inl h)
  | neg n ih =>
    generalize h : n - 1 = m at *
    cases m using sign_cases with
    | zero => exact pos (Or.inr rfl)
    | neg h => exact neg h
    | pos h => exact pos (Or.inl h)

name: add_eq_add_sub_eq_sub
statement: theorem add_eq_add_sub_eq_sub {a b c d : ZFNat} : a + b = c + d → a - c = d - b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : a = c + d - b := ZFNat.sub_eq_of_eq_add h.symm |>.symm
  subst this
  rw [←ZFNat.sub_add_distrib, ZFNat.add_comm b c, ZFNat.add_sub_add_left c d b]

name: le_of_lt_succ
statement: theorem le_of_lt_succ (n m : ZFInt) : n < m + 1 → n ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction n using Quotient.ind
  induction m using Quotient.ind
  rename_i n m
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := n
  obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := m
  simp_rw [mk_eq] at h ⊢
  rw [one_eq, add_eq, ZFNat.add_zero] at h
  change a + d < b + (c + 1) at h
  suffices a + d ≤ b + c by
    rcases this with h | h
    · left; exact h
    · right; exact sound h
  rwa [ZFNat.add_assoc, ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ, ←ZFNat.lt_le_iff] at h

name: lt_succ_of_le
statement: theorem lt_succ_of_le (n m : ZFInt) : n ≤ m → n < m + 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro (h | rfl)
  · trans n+1
    · exact lt_succ
    · exact (add_lt_add_iff_right 1).mpr h
  · exact lt_succ

name: lt_succ_of_le_iff
statement:
theorem lt_succ_of_le_iff (n m : ZFInt) : n ≤ m ↔ n < m + 1 where
  mp
proof:
:= lt_succ_of_le n m
  mpr := le_of_lt_succ n m

name: int_le.dest
statement: theorem int_le.dest {n m : ZFInt} : n ≤ m → ∃ k, 0 ≤ k ∧ n + k = m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exists m - n
  and_intros
  · exact sub_nonneg_of_le h
  · exact _root_.add_sub_cancel n m

name: mul_pos_pos_pos
statement: theorem mul_pos_pos_pos (a b : ZFInt) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < a * b
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  induction b using Quotient.ind
  rename_i a b
  obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := b
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := a
  simp_rw [mk_eq, zero_eq] at ha hb ⊢
  rw [mul_eq]
  change 0 + d < 0 + c at hb
  change 0 + b < 0 + a at ha
  change 0 + (a * d + b * c) < 0 + (a * c + b * d)
  simp_rw [ZFNat.zero_add] at ha hb ⊢
  rw [ZFNat.sub_add_cancel (Or.inl hb) |>.symm, ZFNat.left_distrib, ZFNat.left_distrib,
    ZFNat.add_comm _ (b*d), ZFNat.add_assoc, ←ZFNat.right_distrib, ←ZFNat.add_assoc,
    ←ZFNat.right_distrib, ZFNat.add_comm, ZFNat.add_lt_add_iff_right, ZFNat.mul_comm b,
    ZFNat.mul_comm a]
  apply ZFNat.mul_lt_mono
  · exact ZFNat.pos_of_ne_zero (ZFNat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt hb).symm
  · exact ha

name: neg_one_mul
statement: theorem neg_one_mul (a : ZFInt) : (-1 : ZFInt) * a = -a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.ind
  rename_i a
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := a
  rw [mk_eq, one_eq, neg_eq, mul_eq, neg_eq]
  dsimp
  rw [ZFNat.zero_mul, ZFNat.zero_mul, ZFNat.one_mul, ZFNat.one_mul, ZFNat.zero_add, ZFNat.zero_add]

name: neg_one_mul_neg_one
statement: theorem neg_one_mul_neg_one : (-1 : ZFInt) * (-1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_eq, neg_eq, mul_eq, ZFNat.mul_zero, ZFNat.zero_mul, ZFNat.zero_add, ZFNat.zero_add,
    ZFNat.one_mul, ZFNat.one_mul]

name: mul_neg_neg
statement: theorem mul_neg_neg (a b : ZFInt) : a * b = -a * -b
proof:
:= by
  rw [←one_mul (a*b), ←neg_one_mul_neg_one, ←mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_assoc,
    mul_comm (-1), mul_assoc, mul_comm b, neg_one_mul, neg_one_mul]

name: neg_mul_distrib
statement: theorem neg_mul_distrib (a b : ZFInt) : -(a * b) = -a * b
proof: := neg_mul_eq_neg_mul a b

name: mul_neg_neg_pos
statement: theorem mul_neg_neg_pos (a b : ZFInt) (ha : a < 0) (hb : b < 0) : 0 < a * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_neg_neg]
  exact mul_pos_pos_pos _ _ (Left.neg_pos_iff.mpr ha) (Left.neg_pos_iff.mpr hb)

name: neg_flip_lt
statement: theorem neg_flip_lt (a : ZFInt) : a < 0 ↔ 0 < -a
proof: := Iff.symm Left.neg_pos_iff

name: neg_flip_le
statement: theorem neg_flip_le (a : ZFInt) : a ≤ 0 ↔ 0 ≤ -a
proof: := Iff.symm neg_nonneg

name: mul_neg_pos_neg
statement: theorem mul_neg_pos_neg (a b : ZFInt) (ha : a < 0) (hb : 0 < b) : a * b < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_flip_lt, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul]
  exact mul_pos_pos_pos _ _ ((neg_flip_lt a).mp ha) hb

name: mul_pos_neg_neg
statement: theorem mul_pos_neg_neg (a b : ZFInt) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : b < 0) : a * b < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, neg_flip_lt, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul]
  exact mul_pos_pos_pos _ _ ((neg_flip_lt b).mp hb) ha

name: mul_nonneg_nonneg_nonneg
statement: theorem mul_nonneg_nonneg_nonneg (a b : ZFInt) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : 0 ≤ a * b
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with ha | rfl <;> rcases hb with hb | rfl
  · left
    exact mul_pos_pos_pos a b ha hb
  · right
    rw [mul_zero]
  · right
    rw [zero_mul]
  · right
    rw [zero_mul]

name: mul_nonpos_nonneg_nonpos
statement: theorem mul_nonpos_nonneg_nonpos (a b : ZFInt) (ha : a ≤ 0) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : a * b ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_flip_le, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul]
  exact mul_nonneg_nonneg_nonneg _ _ (neg_nonneg.mpr ha) hb

name: mul_nonneg_nonpos_nonpos
statement: theorem mul_nonneg_nonpos_nonpos (a b : ZFInt) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 0) : a * b ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, neg_flip_le, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul]
  exact mul_nonneg_nonneg_nonneg _ _ (neg_nonneg.mpr hb) ha

name: mul_nonpos_nonpos_nonneg
statement: theorem mul_nonpos_nonpos_nonneg (a b : ZFInt) (ha : a ≤ 0) (hb : b ≤ 0) : 0 ≤ a * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_neg_neg]
  exact mul_nonneg_nonneg_nonneg _ _ (neg_nonneg.mpr ha) (neg_nonneg.mpr hb)

name: mul_le_mul_left
statement: theorem mul_le_mul_left {n m : ZFInt} (k : ZFInt) (h : n ≤ m) (h' : 0 ≤ k) : k * n ≤ k * m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, pos, hl⟩ := int_le.dest h
  have : k * n + k * l = k * m := by rw [←hl, left_distrib]
  rw [←this]
  apply le_add_of_nonneg_right
  exact mul_nonneg_nonneg_nonneg k l h' pos

name: mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
statement: theorem mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left {n m k : ZFInt} (h : n < m) (hk : k > 0) : k * n < k * m
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le (b := k*n+k)
  · exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ hk
  · conv =>
      enter [1,2]
      rw [←mul_one k]
    rw [←left_distrib]
    apply mul_le_mul_left k
    · exact (lt_succ_of_le_iff (n + 1) m).mpr <| (add_lt_add_iff_right 1).mpr h
    · exact le_of_lt hk

name: pos_of_mul_pos
statement: theorem pos_of_mul_pos {a b : ZFInt} (h : 0 < a * b) (ha : 0 < a) : 0 < b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hb
  rw [not_lt_iff_eq_or_lt] at hb
  rcases hb with rfl | hb
  · rw [mul_zero] at h
    exact lt_irrefl h
  · rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h' | rfl | h'
    · nomatch lt_irrefl <| lt_trans (lt_trans ha h') hb
    · nomatch lt_irrefl <| lt_trans ha hb
    · nomatch lt_irrefl <| lt_trans h <| mul_pos_neg_neg a b ha hb

name: mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
statement: theorem mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right {n m k : ZFInt} (h : n < m) (hk : k > 0) : n * k < m * k
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm n, mul_comm m]
  exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hk

name: mul_pos_iff
statement: theorem mul_pos_iff {a b : ZFInt} : 0 < a * b ↔ (0 < a ∧ 0 < b) ∨ (a < 0 ∧ b < 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases a with
    | pos pos =>
      rcases pos with pos | rfl
      · left
        and_intros
        · exact pos
        · exact pos_of_mul_pos h pos
      · rw [zero_mul] at h
        nomatch lt_irrefl h
    | neg neg =>
      right
      and_intros
      · exact neg
      · rw [mul_neg_neg] at h
        rw [neg_flip_lt] at neg
        have := pos_of_mul_pos h neg
        rwa [←neg_flip_lt] at this
  · rintro (⟨l, r⟩ | ⟨l, r⟩)
    · exact mul_pos_pos_pos a b l r
    · exact mul_neg_neg_pos a b l r

name: eq_le_iff
statement: theorem eq_le_iff {a b : ZFInt} : a = b ↔ a ≤ b ∧ b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    rcases h₁ with h₁ | rfl <;> rcases h₂ with h₂ | h₂
    · nomatch lt_irrefl <| lt_trans h₁ h₂
    · exact h₂.symm
    · rfl
    · rfl

name: mul_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mul_eq_zero_iff {a b : ZFInt} : a * b = 0 ↔ a = 0 ∨ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction a using Quotient.ind
    induction b using Quotient.ind
    rename_i a b
    simp_rw [mk_eq, mul_eq, zero_eq, eq, ZFSet.zrel, ZFNat.add_zero] at h ⊢
    rcases lt_trichotomy b.1 b.2 with h' | eq | h'
    · have := ZFNat.add_eq_add_sub_eq_sub h.symm
      rw [←ZFNat.left_distrib_mul_sub, ←ZFNat.left_distrib_mul_sub] at this
      have b₁b₂_ne_0 : b.2 - b.1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro contr
        rw [ZFNat.sub_eq_zero_imp_le] at contr
        rcases contr with contr | eq
        · nomatch ZFNat.lt_irrefl <| ZFNat.lt_trans contr h'
        · rw [eq] at h'
          nomatch ZFNat.lt_irrefl h'
      left
      exact ZFNat.mul_right_cancel_iff b₁b₂_ne_0 |>.mp this
    · right; assumption
    · have := ZFNat.add_eq_add_sub_eq_sub h
      rw [←ZFNat.left_distrib_mul_sub, ←ZFNat.left_distrib_mul_sub] at this
      have b₁b₂_ne_0 : b.1 - b.2 ≠ 0 := by
        intro contr
        rw [ZFNat.sub_eq_zero_imp_le] at contr
        rcases contr with contr | eq
        · nomatch ZFNat.lt_irrefl <| ZFNat.lt_trans contr h'
        · rw [eq] at h'
          nomatch ZFNat.lt_irrefl h'
      left
      exact ZFNat.mul_right_cancel_iff b₁b₂_ne_0 |>.mp this
  · rintro (h | h)
    · rw [h, zero_mul]
    · rw [h, mul_zero]

name: mul_eq_zero_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem mul_eq_zero_of_ne_zero {a b : ZFInt} : a * b = 0 → a ≠ 0 → b = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h h'
  rw [mul_eq_zero_iff] at h
  exact Or.resolve_left h h'

name: mul_left_cancel_iff
statement: theorem mul_left_cancel_iff {a b n : ZFInt} (h : n ≠ 0) : n * a = n * b ↔ a = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro eq
    have : n*a - n*b = 0 := sub_eq_zero_of_eq eq
    rw [ZFInt.sub_eq_add_neg, mul_comm n b, neg_mul_distrib, mul_comm _ n, ←left_distrib,
      mul_eq_zero_iff] at this
    rcases this with rfl | this
    · nomatch h
    · exact eq_of_sub_eq_zero this
  · exact fun h => h ▸ rfl

name: mul_right_cancel_iff
statement: theorem mul_right_cancel_iff {a b n : ZFInt} (h : n ≠ 0) : a * n = b * n ↔ a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm a n, mul_comm b n]
  exact mul_left_cancel_iff h

name: ZFNat.mem_lift_lift_Nat
statement: theorem ZFNat.mem_lift_lift_Nat (n : ℕ) : ↑(↑n : ZFNat) ∈ Nat
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.cast_zero, ZFNat.nat_zero_eq, ZFNat.zero_in_Nat]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [Nat.cast_succ, ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ, ZFNat.succ]
    exact ZFNat.succ_mem_Nat' ih

name: mem_ofInt_Int
statement: theorem mem_ofInt_Int (n : ℤ) : ofInt n ∈ Int
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.recOn with
  | ofNat n =>
    rw [Int, mem_union, ofInt]
    right
    rw [pair_mem_prod]
    exact ⟨singleton_subset_mem_iff.mp fun _ => id, ZFNat.mem_lift_lift_Nat n⟩
  | negSucc n =>
    rw [Int, mem_union, ofInt]
    left
    rw [pair_mem_prod]
    exact ⟨ZFNat.mem_lift_lift_Nat (n+1), singleton_subset_mem_iff.mp fun _ => id⟩

name: sub_ofInt_singleton_Int
statement: theorem sub_ofInt_singleton_Int (n : ℤ) : {ofInt n} ⊆ Int
proof:
:= by
  intro
  rw [mem_singleton]
  rintro rfl
  exact mem_ofInt_Int n

name: Int.nonempty
statement: lemma Int.nonempty : ZFSet.Int ≠ ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at h
  simp only [notMem_empty, iff_false] at h
  nomatch h (ZFSet.ofInt 0) (ZFSet.mem_ofInt_Int 0)

name: mem_Int_proj
statement:
theorem mem_Int_proj {x : ZFSet} (h : x ∈ Int) :
  ∃ n ∈ Nat, (x.π₁ = ∅ ∧ x.π₂ = n) ∨ (x.π₁ = n ∧ x.π₂ = ∅)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_union, mem_prod] at h
  rcases h with ⟨a, ha, b, hb, x_eq⟩ | ⟨b, hb, a, ha, x_eq⟩
    <;> (simp only [mem_singleton] at hb; subst x_eq; rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair]; exists a)
  · exact ⟨ha, .inr ⟨rfl, hb⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨ha, .inl ⟨hb, rfl⟩⟩

name: mem_Int_proj'
statement:
theorem mem_Int_proj' {x : ZFSet} :
  x ∈ Int → (x.π₁ = ∅ ∧ x.π₂ ∈ Nat) ∨ (x.π₁ ∈ Nat ∧ x.π₂ = ∅)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases mem_Int_proj h with ⟨n, hn, ⟨l, r⟩ | ⟨l, r⟩⟩
  · left
    exact ⟨l, r ▸ hn⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨l ▸ hn, r⟩

name: ZFInt.outof_inj
statement: theorem ZFInt.outof_inj (x y : {x // x ∈ Int}) : outof x = outof y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  let ⟨y, hy⟩ := y
  simp only [outof, Subtype.mk.injEq]
  intro outof_eq
  split_ifs at outof_eq with h₁ h₂ h₂
    <;> (
      first
      | obtain ⟨l₁, r₁⟩ := h₁
      | obtain ⟨l₁, r₁⟩ := Or.resolve_left (mem_Int_proj' hx) h₁
      first
      | obtain ⟨l₂, r₂⟩ := h₂
      | obtain ⟨l₂, r₂⟩ := Or.resolve_left (mem_Int_proj' hy) h₂
    )
  · apply exact at outof_eq
    simp only [ZFSet.zrel, _root_.zero_add, _root_.add_zero, Subtype.mk.injEq] at outof_eq
    simp_rw [mem_union, mem_prod] at hx hy
    rcases hx, hy with ⟨⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩|⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩,⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩|⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩⟩
      <;> (simp [π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at l₁ r₁ l₂ r₂ outof_eq; subst_eqs; congr)
  · apply exact at outof_eq
    simp only [ZFSet.zrel, _root_.add_zero] at outof_eq
    obtain ⟨l₃, r₃⟩ := ZFNat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero outof_eq.symm
    injection l₃ with l₃
    injection r₃ with r₃
    simp_rw [mem_union, mem_prod] at hx hy
    rcases hx, hy with ⟨⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩|⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩,⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩|⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩⟩
      <;> (simp [π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at l₁ r₁ l₂ r₂ l₃ r₃ outof_eq; subst_eqs; congr)
  · apply exact at outof_eq
    simp only [ZFSet.zrel, _root_.add_zero] at outof_eq
    obtain ⟨l₃, r₃⟩ := ZFNat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero outof_eq
    injection l₃ with l₃
    injection r₃ with r₃
    simp_rw [mem_union, mem_prod] at hx hy
    rcases hx, hy with ⟨⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩|⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩,⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩|⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩⟩
      <;> (simp [π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at l₁ r₁ l₂ r₂ l₃ r₃ outof_eq; subst_eqs; congr)
  · apply exact at outof_eq
    simp only [ZFSet.zrel, _root_.add_zero, _root_.zero_add, Subtype.mk.injEq] at outof_eq
    simp_rw [mem_union, mem_prod] at hx hy
    rcases hx, hy with ⟨⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩|⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩,⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩|⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩⟩
      <;> (simp [π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at l₁ r₁ l₂ r₂ outof_eq; subst_eqs; congr)

name: ZFNat.mem_Nat_sub_one
statement: theorem ZFNat.mem_Nat_sub_one {n : ZFNat} : (n - 1).1 ∈ Nat
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [ZFNat.zero_sub]; exact ZFNat.zero_in_Nat
  | succ n _ =>
    rw [ZFNat.sub_one_eq_pred, ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ, ZFNat.pred_succ]
    rcases n; simpa

name: ZFNat.mem_Nat_sub
statement: theorem ZFNat.mem_Nat_sub {n m : ZFNat} : (n - m).1 ∈ Nat
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rcases n; simpa
  | succ m _ =>
    rw [ZFNat.sub_add_distrib]
    exact ZFNat.mem_Nat_sub_one

name: mem_Int_empty_not_mem
statement: theorem mem_Int_empty_not_mem {x : ZFSet} {h : x ∈ Int} : ∅ ∉ x
proof:
:= by
  intro contr
  simp_rw [mem_union, mem_prod] at h
  rcases h with ⟨a, _, b, _, h⟩ | ⟨a, _, b, _, h⟩
  all_goals
    unfold pair at h
    subst h
    rw [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton] at contr
    rcases contr with contr | contr
    all_goals
      simp only [ZFSet.ext_iff, notMem_empty, false_iff] at contr
      specialize contr a
      simp at contr

name: ZFInt.into_inj_aux
statement: theorem ZFInt.into_inj_aux (x y : ZFInt) : into x = into y → x.out ≈ y.out
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [into]
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := Quotient.out x
  obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := Quotient.out y
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂ <;>
    (intro eq;
     simp only [not_lt, Subtype.mk.injEq, pair_inj, SetLike.coe_eq_coe, true_and,
       and_true] at *)
  · have := ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (hle := .inl h₁) (h := eq)
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm, ← ZFNat.add_sub_assoc (.inl h₂)] at this
    apply ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (h := this.symm)
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm]
    exact ZFNat.le_trans (.inl h₂) (ZFNat.le_add_right d a)
  · obtain ⟨eq₁, eq₂⟩ := eq
    replace eq₁ : 0 = c - d := Subtype.ext eq₁
    replace eq₂ : b - a = 0 := Subtype.ext eq₂
    have := ZFNat.le_antisymm (ZFNat.sub_eq_zero_imp_le.mp (eq₁.symm)) h₂
    subst this
    rw [eq₁] at eq₂
    apply ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (.inl h₁) at eq₂
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm, ← ZFNat.add_sub_assoc h₂] at eq₂
    symm at eq₂
    apply ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (h := eq₂)
    exact ZFNat.le_add_left c a
  · obtain ⟨eq₁, eq₂⟩ := eq
    replace eq₁ : a - b = 0 := Subtype.ext eq₁
    replace eq₂ : 0 = d - c := Subtype.ext eq₂
    have := ZFNat.le_antisymm (ZFNat.sub_eq_zero_imp_le.mp eq₁) h₁
    subst this
    rw [eq₂] at eq₁
    apply ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq h₁ at eq₁
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm, ← ZFNat.add_sub_assoc (.inl h₂)] at eq₁
    symm at eq₁
    apply ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (h := eq₁)
    left
    rw [← @ZFNat.zero_add c]
    apply ZFNat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
    · exact ZFNat.zero_le
    · assumption
  · have := ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (hle := h₁) (h := eq)
    rw [ZFNat.add_comm, ← ZFNat.add_sub_assoc h₂] at this
    apply Eq.symm ∘ ZFNat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (h := this.symm)
    exact ZFNat.le_trans h₂ (ZFNat.le_add_left c b)

name: ZFInt.into_inj
statement: theorem ZFInt.into_inj (x y : ZFInt) : into x = into y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply ZFInt.into_inj_aux at h
  exact Quotient.out_equiv_out.mp h

name: ZFInt.into.injective
statement: theorem ZFInt.into.injective : Function.Injective into
proof: := into_inj

name: ZFInt.outof.injective
statement: theorem ZFInt.outof.injective : Function.Injective outof
proof: := outof_inj

name: ZFInt.outof_into
statement: theorem ZFInt.outof_into (x : ZFInt) : outof (into x) = x
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Quotient.out_eq x]
  unfold into
  generalize x.out = p
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
  dsimp only
  by_cases hab : a < b
  · rw [if_pos hab]
    simp only [outof]
    have h_cond : (ZFSet.pair (∅ : ZFSet) (b - a).1).π₁ = ∅ ∧
                  (ZFSet.pair (∅ : ZFSet) (b - a).1).π₂ ∈ Nat :=
      ⟨π₁_pair _ _, by rw [π₂_pair]; exact ZFNat.mem_Nat_sub⟩
    rw [dif_pos h_cond]
    refine sound ?_
    change (0 : ZFNat) + b = ⟨_, h_cond.2⟩ + a
    have hπ₂ : (⟨(ZFSet.pair (∅ : ZFSet) (b - a).1).π₂, h_cond.2⟩ : ZFNat) = b - a :=
      Subtype.ext (π₂_pair _ _)
    rw [hπ₂, ZFNat.zero_add, ZFNat.sub_add_cancel (Or.inl hab)]
  · rw [if_neg hab]
    simp only [outof]
    by_cases hcond : (ZFSet.pair (a - b).1 (∅ : ZFSet)).π₁ = ∅ ∧
                     (ZFSet.pair (a - b).1 (∅ : ZFSet)).π₂ ∈ Nat
    · rw [dif_pos hcond]
      have h_sub_zero : a - b = 0 :=
        Subtype.ext ((π₁_pair (a - b).1 (∅ : ZFSet)).symm.trans hcond.1)
      have h_le_ab : a ≤ b := ZFNat.sub_eq_zero_imp_le.mp h_sub_zero
      have h_le_ba : b ≤ a := by push Not at hab; exact hab
      have ha_eq_b : a = b := ZFNat.le_antisymm h_le_ab h_le_ba
      subst ha_eq_b
      refine sound ?_
      change (0 : ZFNat) + a = _ + a
      have hπ₂ : (⟨(ZFSet.pair (a - a).1 (∅ : ZFSet)).π₂, hcond.2⟩ : ZFNat) = 0 :=
        Subtype.ext (π₂_pair _ _)
      rw [hπ₂]
    · rw [dif_neg hcond]
      push Not at hab
      
      
      
      simp only [π₁_pair]
      refine sound ?_
      change (a - b) + b = (0 : ZFNat) + a
      rw [ZFNat.zero_add]
      exact ZFNat.sub_add_cancel hab

name: ZFInt.into_outof
statement: theorem ZFInt.into_outof (y : {x // x ∈ Int}) : into (outof y) = y
proof:
:=
  outof_inj _ _ (outof_into _)

name: instEquivZFIntInt.mono_iff
statement:
theorem instEquivZFIntInt.mono_iff (x y : {x // x ∈ Int}) :
    instEquivZFIntInt.invFun x < instEquivZFIntInt.invFun y ↔ x < y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: intCast_surjective
statement: private theorem intCast_surjective : Function.Surjective (Int.cast : ℤ → ZFInt)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z using ZFInt.induction with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | pos z ih =>
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨n + 1, by rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one]⟩
  | neg z ih =>
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨n - 1, by rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one]⟩

name: equivInt_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivInt_intCast (z : ℤ) : equivInt (z : ZFInt) = z
proof:
:= by
  change equivInt (equivInt.symm z) = z
  exact equivInt.apply_symm_apply z

name: intCast_equivInt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intCast_equivInt (z : ZFInt) : ((equivInt z : ℤ) : ZFInt) = z
proof:
:= by
  change equivInt.symm (equivInt z) = z
  exact equivInt.symm_apply_apply z

name: equivInt_le
statement: theorem equivInt_le (a b : ZFInt) : equivInt a ≤ equivInt b ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · have h' : ((equivInt a : ℤ) : ZFInt) ≤ ((equivInt b : ℤ) : ZFInt) :=
      Int.cast_mono h
    rwa [intCast_equivInt, intCast_equivInt] at h'
  · rwa [← intCast_equivInt a, ← intCast_equivInt b, Int.cast_le] at h

name: equivInt_lt
statement: theorem equivInt_lt (a b : ZFInt) : equivInt a < equivInt b ↔ a < b
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_not_ge, lt_iff_not_ge, equivInt_le]

name: equivInt_abs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivInt_abs (z : ZFInt) : equivInt |z| = |equivInt z|
proof:
:= by
  rcases _root_.le_total 0 z with hz | hz
  · have hz' : (0 : ℤ) ≤ equivInt z := by
      rwa [←equivInt_le 0 z, map_zero] at hz
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hz, abs_of_nonneg hz']
  · have hz' : equivInt z ≤ (0 : ℤ) := by
      rwa [←equivInt_le z 0, map_zero] at hz
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hz, abs_of_nonpos hz', map_neg]

name: equivInt_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivInt_div (a b : ZFInt) : equivInt (a / b) = equivInt a / equivInt b
proof:
:=
  equivInt.apply_symm_apply _

name: equivInt_mod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivInt_mod (a b : ZFInt) : equivInt (a % b) = equivInt a % equivInt b
proof:
:=
  equivInt.apply_symm_apply _

name: div_add_mod
statement: theorem div_add_mod (a b : ZFInt) : b * (a / b) + a % b = a
proof:
:=
  EuclideanDomain.div_add_mod a b

name: mod_nonneg
statement: theorem mod_nonneg (a : ZFInt) {b : ZFInt} (hb : b ≠ 0) : 0 ≤ a % b
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivInt_le 0 (a % b)).mp
  rw [equivInt_mod, map_zero]
  apply Int.emod_nonneg
  intro hb'
  apply hb
  apply equivInt.injective
  rw [hb', map_zero]

name: mod_lt_abs
statement: theorem mod_lt_abs (a : ZFInt) {b : ZFInt} (hb : b ≠ 0) : a % b < |b|
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivInt_lt (a % b) |b|).mp
  rw [equivInt_mod, equivInt_abs]
  apply Int.emod_lt_abs
  intro hb'
  apply hb
  apply equivInt.injective
  rw [hb', map_zero]

name: mod_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mod_eq_zero {a b : ZFInt} : a % b = 0 ↔ b ∣ a
proof:
:=
  EuclideanDomain.mod_eq_zero

name: equivInt_ediv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivInt_ediv (a b : ZFInt) :
    equivInt (ediv a b) = equivInt a / equivInt b
proof:
:=
  equivInt.apply_symm_apply _

name: equivInt_emod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivInt_emod (a b : ZFInt) :
    equivInt (emod a b) = equivInt a % equivInt b
proof:
:=
  equivInt.apply_symm_apply _

name: ediv_eq_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ediv_eq_div (a b : ZFInt) : ediv a b = a / b
proof:
:= by
  apply equivInt.injective
  rw [equivInt_ediv, equivInt_div]

name: emod_eq_mod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem emod_eq_mod (a b : ZFInt) : emod a b = a % b
proof:
:= by
  apply equivInt.injective
  rw [equivInt_emod, equivInt_mod]

name: ediv_add_emod
statement: theorem ediv_add_emod (a b : ZFInt) : b * ediv a b + emod a b = a
proof:
:= by
  erw [div_add_mod a b]

name: emod_nonneg
statement: theorem emod_nonneg (a : ZFInt) {b : ZFInt} (hb : b ≠ 0) : 0 ≤ emod a b
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivInt_le 0 (emod a b)).mp
  rw [equivInt_emod, map_zero]
  apply Int.emod_nonneg
  intro hb'
  apply hb
  apply equivInt.injective
  rw [hb', map_zero]

name: emod_lt_abs
statement: theorem emod_lt_abs (a : ZFInt) {b : ZFInt} (hb : b ≠ 0) : emod a b < |b|
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivInt_lt (emod a b) |b|).mp
  rw [equivInt_emod, equivInt_abs]
  apply Int.emod_lt_abs
  intro hb'
  apply hb
  apply equivInt.injective
  rw [hb', map_zero]

name: emod_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem emod_eq_zero {a b : ZFInt} : emod a b = 0 ↔ b ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · apply (map_dvd_iff equivInt).mp
    rw [Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, ←equivInt_emod, h, map_zero]
  · apply equivInt.injective
    rwa [equivInt_emod, map_zero, ← Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, map_dvd_iff equivInt]

name: equivInt_fdiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivInt_fdiv (a b : ZFInt) :
    equivInt (fdiv a b) = (equivInt a).fdiv (equivInt b)
proof:
:=
  equivInt.apply_symm_apply _

name: equivInt_fmod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivInt_fmod (a b : ZFInt) :
    equivInt (fmod a b) = (equivInt a).fmod (equivInt b)
proof:
:=
  equivInt.apply_symm_apply _

name: fdiv_add_fmod
statement: theorem fdiv_add_fmod (a b : ZFInt) : b * fdiv a b + fmod a b = a
proof:
:= by
  apply equivInt.injective
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, equivInt_fdiv, equivInt_fmod]
  apply Int.mul_fdiv_add_fmod

name: fmod_nonneg_of_pos
statement: theorem fmod_nonneg_of_pos (a : ZFInt) {b : ZFInt} (hb : 0 < b) : 0 ≤ fmod a b
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivInt_le 0 (fmod a b)).mp
  rw [equivInt_fmod, map_zero]
  apply Int.fmod_nonneg_of_pos
  rwa [←equivInt_lt 0 b, map_zero] at hb

name: fmod_lt_of_pos
statement: theorem fmod_lt_of_pos (a : ZFInt) {b : ZFInt} (hb : 0 < b) : fmod a b < b
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivInt_lt (fmod a b) b).mp
  rw [equivInt_fmod]
  apply Int.fmod_lt_of_pos
  rwa [←equivInt_lt 0 b, map_zero] at hb

name: fmod_nonpos_of_neg
statement: theorem fmod_nonpos_of_neg (a : ZFInt) {b : ZFInt} (hb : b < 0) : fmod a b ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivInt_le (fmod a b) 0).mp
  rw [equivInt_fmod, map_zero]
  have hb' : equivInt b < (0 : ℤ) := by
    rwa [← equivInt_lt b 0, map_zero] at hb
  exact ((Int.fdiv_fmod_unique' hb').mp ⟨rfl, rfl⟩).2.2

name: lt_fmod_of_neg
statement: theorem lt_fmod_of_neg (a : ZFInt) {b : ZFInt} (hb : b < 0) : b < fmod a b
proof:
:= by
  apply (equivInt_lt b (fmod a b)).mp
  rw [equivInt_fmod]
  have hb' : equivInt b < (0 : ℤ) := by
    rwa [← equivInt_lt b 0, map_zero] at hb
  exact ((Int.fdiv_fmod_unique' hb').mp ⟨rfl, rfl⟩).2.1

name: fmod_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fmod_eq_zero {a b : ZFInt} : fmod a b = 0 ↔ b ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  calc
    fmod a b = 0 ↔ equivInt (fmod a b) = equivInt 0 := equivInt.injective.eq_iff.symm
    _ ↔ (equivInt a).fmod (equivInt b) = 0 := by rw [equivInt_fmod, map_zero]
    _ ↔ equivInt b ∣ equivInt a := Int.dvd_iff_fmod_eq_zero.symm
    _ ↔ b ∣ a := map_dvd_iff equivInt

name: equivInt_dvd
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem equivInt_dvd (a b : ZFInt) :
    a ∣ b ↔ equivInt a ∣ equivInt b
proof: := (map_dvd_iff equivInt).symm

name: inl.injEq
statement: theorem inl.injEq {A B : ZFSet} {x y : {x // x ∈ A}} : (inl x : A ⊎ B) = inl y ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    injection heq with heq
    rw [pair_inj] at heq
    exact Subtype.val_inj.mp heq.2
  · intro
    congr

name: inr.injEq
statement: theorem inr.injEq {A B : ZFSet} {x y : {x // x ∈ B}} : (inr x : A ⊎ B) = inr y ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    injection heq with heq
    rw [pair_inj] at heq
    exact Subtype.val_inj.mp heq.2
  · intro
    congr

name: cases
statement: theorem cases {A B : ZFSet} (x : A ⊎ B) : x.val.π₂ ∈ A ∨ x.val.π₂ ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  rw [mem_union, mem_prod] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ | hx := hx
  · rw [mem_union, pair_mem_prod] at hx
    obtain ⟨ha, bA⟩ | hb := hx
    · rw [mem_singleton] at ha
      left
      rwa [π₂_pair]
    · rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton] at hb
      right
      rw [π₂_pair]
      exact hb.2
  · rw [mem_prod] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [mem_union, pair_mem_prod] at hx
    obtain ⟨ha, aB⟩ | hb := hx
    · rw [mem_singleton] at ha
      left
      rwa [π₂_pair]
    · rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton] at hb
      right
      rw [π₂_pair]
      exact hb.2

name: casesOn_of_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem casesOn_of_inl {A B : ZFSet} {motive : A ⊎ B → Sort*} (a : {x // x ∈ A})
  (inl_case : (val : {x // x ∈ A}) → motive (inl val))
  (inr_case : (val : {x // x ∈ B}) → motive (inr val)) :
    casesOn (inl a) inl_case inr_case = inl_case a
proof:
:= by
  rw [casesOn, dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [inl, π₁_pair]))]
  dsimp
  rw [cast_eq_iff_heq]
  congr
  unfold inl
  rw [π₂_pair]

name: casesOn_of_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem casesOn_of_inr {A B : ZFSet} {motive : A ⊎ B → Sort*} (a : {x // x ∈ B})
  (inl_case : (val : {x // x ∈ A}) → motive (inl val))
  (inr_case : (val : {x // x ∈ B}) → motive (inr val)) :
    casesOn (inr a) inl_case inr_case = inr_case a
proof:
:= by
  rw [casesOn, dite_cond_eq_false (eq_false ?_)]
  · dsimp
    rw [cast_eq_iff_heq]
    congr
    unfold inr
    rw [π₂_pair]
  · rw [inr, π₁_pair]
    exact zftrue_ne_zffalse

name: casesOn_unique
statement:
theorem casesOn_unique {A B : ZFSet} {motive : A ⊎ B → Sort*}
  (inl_case : Π a, motive (inl a)) (inr_case : Π b, motive (inr b)) (g : Π x, motive x)
  (hinl : ∀ a, g (inl a) = inl_case a) (hinr : ∀ b, g (inr b) = inr_case b) (x : A ⊎ B) :
    g x = casesOn x inl_case inr_case
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | inl a => rw [hinl, casesOn_of_inl]
  | inr b => rw [hinr, casesOn_of_inr]

name: sum_eq_subtype_toZFSet
statement: theorem sum_eq_subtype_toZFSet {A B : ZFSet} : (A ⊎ B) = {x // x ∈ toZFSet A B}
proof: := rfl

name: pair_false_mem_toZFSet
statement:
@[zdom] theorem pair_false_mem_toZFSet {A B a : ZFSet} (ha : a ∈ A) :
    ZFSet.pair ZFBool.false.val a ∈ toZFSet A B
proof:
:=
  mem_union.mpr <| Or.inl <| pair_mem_prod.mpr ⟨mem_singleton.mpr rfl, ha⟩

name: pair_true_mem_toZFSet
statement:
@[zdom] theorem pair_true_mem_toZFSet {A B b : ZFSet} (hb : b ∈ B) :
    ZFSet.pair ZFBool.true.val b ∈ toZFSet A B
proof:
:=
  mem_union.mpr <| Or.inr <| pair_mem_prod.mpr ⟨mem_singleton.mpr rfl, hb⟩

name: mem_left_of_toZFSet
statement:
@[zdom] theorem mem_left_of_toZFSet {A B z : ZFSet} (hz : z ∈ toZFSet A B)
    (h : z.π₁ = ZFBool.false.val) : z.π₂ ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [toZFSet, mem_union] at hz
  rcases hz with hz | hz
  · exact (pair_mem_prod.mp (pair_eta hz ▸ hz)).2
  · rw [pair_eta hz, pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton] at hz
    rw [hz.1] at h
    nomatch zftrue_ne_zffalse h

name: mem_right_of_toZFSet
statement:
@[zdom] theorem mem_right_of_toZFSet {A B z : ZFSet} (hz : z ∈ toZFSet A B)
    (h : z.π₁ ≠ ZFBool.false.val) : z.π₂ ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [toZFSet, mem_union] at hz
  rcases hz with hz | hz
  · rw [pair_eta hz, pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton] at hz
    exact absurd hz.1 h
  · exact (pair_mem_prod.mp (pair_eta hz ▸ hz)).2

name: inlFun_is_func
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem inlFun_is_func {A B : ZFSet} : IsFunc A (toZFSet A B) (inlFun A B)
proof:
:=
  lambda_isFunc fun ha => pair_false_mem_toZFSet ha

name: inrFun_is_func
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem inrFun_is_func {A B : ZFSet} : IsFunc B (toZFSet A B) (inrFun A B)
proof:
:=
  lambda_isFunc fun hb => pair_true_mem_toZFSet hb

name: coprod_is_func
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem coprod_is_func {A B X f g : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A X f) (hg : IsFunc B X g) :
    IsFunc (toZFSet A B) X (coprod f g hf hg)
proof:
:= by
  apply lambda_isFunc
  intro z hz
  rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hz)]
  split_ifs <;> apply SetLike.coe_mem

name: coprod_is_pfunc
statement:
theorem coprod_is_pfunc {A B X f g : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A X f) (hg : IsFunc B X g) :
    (coprod f g hf hg).IsPFunc (toZFSet A B) X
proof: := is_func_is_pfunc (coprod_is_func hf hg)

name: coprod_of_inl
statement:
theorem coprod_of_inl {A B X f g : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A X f) (hg : IsFunc B X g)
    {a : ZFSet} (ha : a ∈ A) :
    fapply (coprod f g hf hg) (coprod_is_pfunc hf hg)
        ⟨ZFSet.pair ZFBool.false.val a, by zdom⟩
      = @ᶻf ⟨a, by zdom⟩
proof:
:= by
  have key : (ZFSet.pair ZFBool.false.val a).pair
      (@ᶻf ⟨a, by zdom⟩ : {x // x ∈ X}).val ∈ coprod f g hf hg := by
    rw [coprod, lambda_spec]
    refine ⟨pair_false_mem_toZFSet ha, Subtype.property _, ?_⟩
    rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (pair_false_mem_toZFSet ha)),
      dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (π₁_pair ..))]
    simp only [π₂_pair]
  rw [fapply.of_pair (coprod_is_pfunc hf hg) key]

name: coprod_of_inr
statement:
theorem coprod_of_inr {A B X f g : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A X f) (hg : IsFunc B X g)
    {b : ZFSet} (hb : b ∈ B) :
    fapply (coprod f g hf hg) (coprod_is_pfunc hf hg)
        ⟨ZFSet.pair ZFBool.true.val b, by zdom⟩
      = @ᶻg ⟨b, by zdom⟩
proof:
:= by
  have key : (ZFSet.pair ZFBool.true.val b).pair
      (@ᶻg ⟨b, by zdom⟩ : {x // x ∈ X}).val ∈ coprod f g hf hg := by
    rw [coprod, lambda_spec]
    refine ⟨pair_true_mem_toZFSet hb, Subtype.property _, ?_⟩
    rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (pair_true_mem_toZFSet hb)),
      dite_cond_eq_false (eq_false ?_)]
    · simp only [π₂_pair]
    · rw [π₁_pair]
      exact zftrue_ne_zffalse
  rw [fapply.of_pair (coprod_is_pfunc hf hg) key]

name: fapply_inlFun
statement:
theorem fapply_inlFun {A B x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ A) :
    fapply (inlFun A B) (is_func_is_pfunc inlFun_is_func)
        ⟨x, by zdom⟩
      = ⟨ZFSet.pair ZFBool.false.val x, pair_false_mem_toZFSet hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  have key : x.pair (ZFSet.pair ZFBool.false.val x) ∈ inlFun A B := by
    rw [inlFun, lambda_spec]
    exact ⟨hx, pair_false_mem_toZFSet hx, rfl⟩
  rw [fapply.of_pair (is_func_is_pfunc inlFun_is_func) key]

name: coprod_comp_inl
statement:
theorem coprod_comp_inl {A B X f g : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A X f) (hg : IsFunc B X g) :
    fcomp (coprod f g hf hg) (inlFun A B) (coprod_is_func hf hg) inlFun_is_func = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [is_func_ext_iff (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc (coprod_is_func hf hg) inlFun_is_func) hf]
  intro x hx
  rw [fapply_composition (coprod_is_func hf hg) inlFun_is_func hx]
  have hval : (fapply (inlFun A B) (is_func_is_pfunc inlFun_is_func)
      ⟨x, by zdom⟩).val
      = ZFSet.pair ZFBool.false.val x := congrArg Subtype.val (fapply_inlFun hx)
  simp only [hval]
  exact coprod_of_inl hf hg hx

name: fapply_inrFun
statement:
theorem fapply_inrFun {A B x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ B) :
    fapply (inrFun A B) (is_func_is_pfunc inrFun_is_func)
        ⟨x, by zdom⟩
      = ⟨ZFSet.pair ZFBool.true.val x, pair_true_mem_toZFSet hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  have key : x.pair (ZFSet.pair ZFBool.true.val x) ∈ inrFun A B := by
    rw [inrFun, lambda_spec]
    exact ⟨hx, pair_true_mem_toZFSet hx, rfl⟩
  rw [fapply.of_pair (is_func_is_pfunc inrFun_is_func) key]

name: eta_of_toZFSet
statement: theorem eta_of_toZFSet {A B z : ZFSet} (hz : z ∈ toZFSet A B) : z = z.π₁.pair z.π₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [toZFSet, mem_union] at hz
  rcases hz with hz | hz <;> exact pair_eta hz

name: exists_repr_of_toZFSet
statement:
theorem exists_repr_of_toZFSet {A B z : ZFSet} (hz : z ∈ toZFSet A B) :
    (∃ a ∈ A, z = ZFSet.pair ZFBool.false.val a) ∨ (∃ b ∈ B, z = ZFSet.pair ZFBool.true.val b)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : z.π₁ = ZFBool.false.val
  · exact Or.inl ⟨z.π₂, mem_left_of_toZFSet hz h, by conv_lhs => rw [eta_of_toZFSet hz, h]⟩
  · refine Or.inr ⟨z.π₂, mem_right_of_toZFSet hz h, ?_⟩
    have h1 : z.π₁ = ZFBool.true.val := by
      rw [toZFSet, mem_union] at hz
      rcases hz with hz | hz
      · rw [pair_eta hz, pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton] at hz
        exact absurd hz.1 h
      · rw [pair_eta hz, pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton] at hz
        exact hz.1
    conv_lhs => rw [eta_of_toZFSet hz, h1]

name: coprod_comp_inr
statement:
theorem coprod_comp_inr {A B X f g : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A X f) (hg : IsFunc B X g) :
    fcomp (coprod f g hf hg) (inrFun A B) (coprod_is_func hf hg) inrFun_is_func = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [is_func_ext_iff (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc (coprod_is_func hf hg) inrFun_is_func) hg]
  intro x hx
  rw [fapply_composition (coprod_is_func hf hg) inrFun_is_func hx]
  have hval : (fapply (inrFun A B) (is_func_is_pfunc inrFun_is_func)
      ⟨x, by zdom⟩).val
      = ZFSet.pair ZFBool.true.val x := congrArg Subtype.val (fapply_inrFun hx)
  simp only [hval]
  exact coprod_of_inr hf hg hx

name: coprod_unique
statement:
theorem coprod_unique {A B X f g m : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A X f) (hg : IsFunc B X g)
    (hm : IsFunc (toZFSet A B) X m)
    (hl : fcomp m (inlFun A B) hm inlFun_is_func = f)
    (hr : fcomp m (inrFun A B) hm inrFun_is_func = g) :
    m = coprod f g hf hg
proof:
:= by
  subst hl
  subst hr
  rw [is_func_ext_iff hm (coprod_is_func hf hg)]
  intro z hz
  rcases exists_repr_of_toZFSet hz with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ | ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  · rw [coprod_of_inl hf hg ha, fapply_composition hm inlFun_is_func ha]
    have hval : (fapply (inlFun A B) (is_func_is_pfunc inlFun_is_func)
        ⟨a, by zdom⟩).val
        = ZFSet.pair ZFBool.false.val a := congrArg Subtype.val (fapply_inlFun ha)
    simp only [hval]
  · rw [coprod_of_inr hf hg hb, fapply_composition hm inrFun_is_func hb]
    have hval : (fapply (inrFun A B) (is_func_is_pfunc inrFun_is_func)
        ⟨b, by zdom⟩).val
        = ZFSet.pair ZFBool.true.val b := congrArg Subtype.val (fapply_inrFun hb)
    simp only [hval]

name: funs_coprod_universal
statement:
theorem funs_coprod_universal {A B X f g : ZFSet}
    (hf : f ∈ A.funs X) (hg : g ∈ B.funs X) :
    ∃! m, m ∈ (toZFSet A B).funs X ∧
      composition m (inlFun A B) A (toZFSet A B) X = f ∧
      composition m (inrFun A B) B (toZFSet A B) X = g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨coprod f g (mem_funs.mp hf) (mem_funs.mp hg), ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact mem_funs.mpr (coprod_is_func (mem_funs.mp hf) (mem_funs.mp hg))
  · exact coprod_comp_inl (mem_funs.mp hf) (mem_funs.mp hg)
  · exact coprod_comp_inr (mem_funs.mp hf) (mem_funs.mp hg)
  · rintro m ⟨hm, hml, hmr⟩
    exact coprod_unique (mem_funs.mp hf) (mem_funs.mp hg) (mem_funs.mp hm) hml hmr

name: some_ne_none
statement: theorem some_ne_none {S : ZFSet} (x : {x // x ∈ S}) : some x ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  unfold some Sum.inr none Sum.inl
  intro h
  injection h with h
  rw [ZFSet.pair_inj] at h
  unfold ZFBool.false ZFBool.true zftrue zffalse at h
  obtain ⟨contr, _⟩ := h
  simp_rw [ZFSet.ext_iff, notMem_empty, iff_false, mem_singleton] at contr
  nomatch contr ∅

name: casesOn
statement: theorem casesOn {S : ZFSet} (x : Option S) : x = none ∨ (∃ y, x = some y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  rw [mem_union] at hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx <;> (
    rw [mem_prod] at hx
    obtain ⟨opt, hopt, val, hval, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [mem_singleton] at hopt
    subst hopt
    rw [mem_union, pair_mem_prod] at hx)
  · left
    unfold none Sum.inl
    congr
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact mem_singleton.mp hx.right
    · rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton] at hx
      absurd hx.left
      unfold ZFBool.false ZFBool.true zftrue zffalse
      intro contr
      simp_rw [ZFSet.ext_iff, notMem_empty, false_iff, mem_singleton] at contr
      nomatch contr ∅
  · right
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [mem_singleton] at hx
      absurd hx.left
      unfold ZFBool.false ZFBool.true zftrue zffalse
      intro contr
      simp_rw [ZFSet.ext_iff, notMem_empty, iff_false, mem_singleton] at contr
      nomatch contr ∅
    · rw [pair_mem_prod] at hx
      unfold some Sum.inr
      exists ⟨val, hx.right⟩

name: inl_eq_none
statement: theorem inl_eq_none {S : ZFSet} (a : {x // x ∈ ({∅} : ZFSet)}) : (Sum.inl a : Option S) = none
proof:
:=
  congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext (mem_singleton.mp a.2))

name: elim_of_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem elim_of_none {S : ZFSet} {motive : Option S → Sort*}
  (none_case : motive none) (some_case : Π y, motive (some y)) :
    elim none none_case some_case = none_case
proof:
:= by
  rw [elim, Sum.casesOn_of_inl]
  rfl

name: elim_of_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem elim_of_some {S : ZFSet} {motive : Option S → Sort*}
  (none_case : motive none) (some_case : Π y, motive (some y)) (y : {x // x ∈ S}) :
    elim (some y) none_case some_case = some_case y
proof:
:= by
  rw [elim, Sum.casesOn_of_inr]

name: elim_unique
statement:
theorem elim_unique {S : ZFSet} {motive : Option S → Sort*}
  (none_case : motive none) (some_case : Π y, motive (some y)) (g : Π x, motive x)
  (hnone : g none = none_case) (hsome : ∀ y, g (some y) = some_case y) (x : Option S) :
    g x = elim x none_case some_case
proof:
:= by
  refine Sum.casesOn (motive := fun x => g x = elim x none_case some_case) x (fun a => ?_) ?_
  · rw [inl_eq_none a, hnone, elim_of_none]
  · intro y
    rw [hsome, elim_of_some]

name: some.injEq
statement: theorem some.injEq {T : ZFSet} {x y : {x // x ∈ T}} : some x = some y ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    injection heq with heq
    rw [pair_inj] at heq
    exact Subtype.val_inj.mp heq.2
  · intro
    congr

name: ne_none_is_some
statement: theorem ne_none_is_some {T : ZFSet} (x : Option T) : x ≠ none → ∃ y, x = some y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := casesOn x
  · contradiction
  · assumption

name: into.inj
statement:
private theorem into.inj {T : ZFSet} :
    Function.Injective (into : Option T → _root_.Option {x // x ∈ T})
proof:
:= by
  intro x y heq
  unfold into at heq
  split_ifs at heq with hx hy hy
  · rw [hx, hy]
  · injection heq with heq
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ne_none_is_some x hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ne_none_is_some y hy
    generalize_proofs px py at heq
    rw [Classical.choose_spec px, Classical.choose_spec py]
    congr

name: into.surj
statement:
private theorem into.surj {T : ZFSet} :
    Function.Surjective (into : Option T → _root_.Option {x // x ∈ T})
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  unfold into
  cases y with
  | none =>
    exists none
    split_ifs <;> trivial
