  | some v =>
    exists (some v)
    split_ifs with h
    · nomatch some_ne_none v h
    · generalize_proofs pv
      rw [← some.injEq.mp <| Classical.choose_spec pv]

name: into.bij
statement:
private theorem into.bij {T : ZFSet} :
  Function.Bijective (into : Option T → _root_.Option {x // x ∈ T})
proof: := ⟨into.inj, into.surj⟩

name: outof.inj
statement:
private theorem outof.inj {T : ZFSet} :
    Function.Injective (outof : _root_.Option {x // x ∈ T} → Option T)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y heq
  cases x <;> cases y <;> unfold outof at heq
  · rfl
  · injection heq with heq
    rw [pair_inj] at heq
    absurd heq.1
    unfold ZFBool.false ZFBool.true zftrue zffalse
    intro contr
    rw [Subtype.val_inj] at contr
    injection contr with contr
    rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at contr
    exact (notMem_empty ∅) <| (mem_singleton.eq ▸ contr ∅).mpr rfl
  · injection heq with heq
    rw [pair_inj] at heq
    absurd heq.1
    unfold ZFBool.false ZFBool.true zftrue zffalse
    intro contr
    rw [Subtype.val_inj] at contr
    injection contr with contr
    rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at contr
    exact (notMem_empty ∅) <| (mem_singleton.eq ▸ contr ∅).mp rfl
  · injection heq with heq
    rw [pair_inj] at heq
    have := Subtype.val_inj.mp <| Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mp <| Subtype.val_inj.mp heq.2
    congr

name: outof.surj
statement:
private theorem outof.surj {T : ZFSet} :
    Function.Surjective (outof : _root_.Option {x // x ∈ T} → Option T)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  unfold outof
  rcases y.casesOn with rfl | ⟨x, rfl⟩
  · exists .none
  · exists .some x

name: outof.bij
statement:
private theorem outof.bij {T : ZFSet} :
  Function.Bijective (outof : _root_.Option {x // x ∈ T} → Option T)
proof: := ⟨outof.inj, outof.surj⟩

name: flift_bijective
statement:
theorem flift_bijective {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) :
    (ZFSet.Option.flift f).val.IsBijective (Subtype.property _) ↔ f.IsBijective hf where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rintro ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
    and_intros
    · intro x y z hx hy hz xz yz
      specialize hinj (Option.some ⟨x, hx⟩).val (Option.some ⟨y, hy⟩).val (Option.some ⟨z, hz⟩).val
        (SetLike.coe_mem _) (SetLike.coe_mem _) (SetLike.coe_mem _) ?_ ?_
      · rw [flift, lambda_spec]
        refine ⟨SetLike.coe_mem _, SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
        split_ifs with h1 h2
        · have hc : Classical.choose h2 = ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
            Option.some.injEq.mp (Classical.choose_spec h2).symm
          simp only [hc]
          exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp <|
            congrArg (Option.some (S := B)) (fapply.of_pair _ xz).symm
        · exact absurd ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩ h2
        · exact absurd (SetLike.coe_mem _) h1
      · rw [flift, lambda_spec]
        refine ⟨SetLike.coe_mem _, SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
        split_ifs with h1 h2
        · have hc : Classical.choose h2 = ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
            Option.some.injEq.mp (Classical.choose_spec h2).symm
          simp only [hc]
          exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp <|
            congrArg (Option.some (S := B)) (fapply.of_pair _ yz).symm
        · exact absurd ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩ h2
        · exact absurd (SetLike.coe_mem _) h1
      · exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp <| Option.some.injEq.mp <| Subtype.ext_iff.mpr hinj
    · intro y hy
      have : (Option.some ⟨y, hy⟩).val ∈ Option.toZFSet B :=
        SetLike.coe_mem _
      obtain ⟨x, hx, xy⟩ := hsurj _ this
      rw [flift, lambda_spec, dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hx)] at xy
      obtain ⟨-, -, eq⟩ := xy
      split_ifs at eq with issome
      · obtain rfl := Subtype.ext_iff.mp <| Option.some.injEq.mp <| Subtype.ext_iff.mpr eq
        use (Classical.choose issome).val
        and_intros
        · apply SetLike.coe_mem
        · apply fapply.def
      · nomatch ZFSet.Option.some_ne_none _ (Subtype.val_inj.mp eq)
  mpr := by
    intro hbij
    rw [bijective_exists1_iff] at hbij ⊢
    intro y hy
    obtain eq | ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, eq⟩ := Option.casesOn ⟨y, hy⟩ <;>
      obtain rfl := Subtype.ext_iff.mp eq
    · use (@none A).val
      and_intros
      · apply SetLike.coe_mem
      · rw [flift, lambda_spec]
        refine ⟨SetLike.coe_mem _, SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
        split_ifs with h1 isnone
        · obtain ⟨_, contr⟩ := isnone
          change none = some _ at contr
          nomatch ZFSet.Option.some_ne_none _ contr.symm
        · rfl
        · exact absurd (SetLike.coe_mem _) h1
      · rintro y ⟨hy, pair⟩
        rw [flift, lambda_spec] at pair
        obtain ⟨-, -, eq⟩ := pair
        rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hy)] at eq
        split_ifs at eq with issome
        · nomatch ZFSet.Option.some_ne_none _ (Subtype.val_inj.mp eq).symm
        · have := @ZFSet.Option.ne_none_is_some _ ⟨y, hy⟩
          rw [imp_iff_not issome, not_not] at this
          exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp this
    · obtain ⟨x, ⟨hx, fxy⟩, x_unq⟩ := hbij y ‹_›
      use (Option.some ⟨x, hx⟩).val
      and_intros
      · apply SetLike.coe_mem
      · rw [flift, lambda_spec]
        refine ⟨SetLike.coe_mem _, SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
        split_ifs with h1 isnone
        · have := Classical.choose_spec isnone
          change some _ = some _ at this
          rw [Option.some.injEq, Subtype.ext_iff] at this
          dsimp at this
          refine Subtype.ext_iff.mp (congrArg (Option.some (S := B)) ?_)
          symm
          apply fapply.of_pair
          rwa [this] at fxy
        · exact absurd ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩ isnone
        · exact absurd (SetLike.coe_mem _) h1
      · rintro z ⟨hz, fzy⟩
        rw [flift, lambda_spec] at fzy
        obtain ⟨-, -, eq⟩ := fzy
        rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hz)] at eq
        split_ifs at eq with issome
        · obtain rfl := Subtype.ext_iff.mp <| Option.some.injEq.mp <| Subtype.ext_iff.mpr eq
          have := Subtype.ext_iff.mp <| Classical.choose_spec issome
          dsimp at this
          rw [this]
          refine Subtype.ext_iff.mp (congrArg (Option.some (S := A)) ?_)
          have := fapply.of_pair (is_func_is_pfunc hf) fxy
          simp only [Subtype.coe_eta] at this
          rw [←bijective_exists1_iff hf] at hbij
          symm
          have := IsInjective.apply_inj hf hbij.1 this
          rwa [Subtype.ext_iff] at this ⊢
        · nomatch ZFSet.Option.some_ne_none _ (Subtype.val_inj.mp eq)

name: not_nonempty_is_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem not_nonempty_is_empty {x : ZFSet} : ¬ x.Nonempty ↔ x = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonempty_def, not_exists, eq_empty]

name: insert_def
statement: theorem insert_def {x y : ZFSet} : insert x y = {x} ∪ y
proof:
:= by
  ext1 z
  rw [mem_insert_iff, mem_union, mem_singleton]

name: prod_nonempty
statement: lemma prod_nonempty {x y} : x ≠ ∅ → y ≠ ∅ → ZFSet.prod x y ≠ ∅
proof:
:= by classical
  intro hx hy h'
  simp only [ZFSet.ext_iff, ZFSet.mem_prod, ZFSet.notMem_empty,
    iff_false, not_exists, not_and, not_forall] at h'
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := nonempty_exists_iff.mp hx
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := nonempty_exists_iff.mp hy
  obtain ⟨_, h'⟩ := h' (a.pair b) _ ha _ hb
  exact h' (Eq.to_iff rfl)

name: trans_imp_insert_trans
statement: theorem trans_imp_insert_trans {x : ZFSet} : transitive x → transitive (insert x x)
proof:
:= by
  intro trans y
  rw [mem_insert_iff]
  rintro ⟨rfl | _⟩
  · simp_rw [subset_def, mem_insert_iff]
    exact fun _ ↦ Or.inr
  · simp_rw [subset_def, mem_insert_iff]
    exact fun _ _ => Or.inr (trans y ‹_› ‹_›)

name: inductive_sep
statement:
theorem inductive_sep {S} (P : ZFSet → Prop)
  (ind : inductive_set S) (h₀ : P ∅) (h₁ : ∀ n ∈ S, P n → P (insert n n)) :
    inductive_set <| S.sep P
proof:
:= by
  unfold inductive_set at *
  simp_rw [mem_sep]
  apply And.intro
  · exact ⟨ind.left, h₀⟩
  · rintro n ⟨_,_⟩
    apply And.intro
    · exact ind.right n ‹_›
    · exact h₁ n ‹_› ‹_›

name: inductive_imp_transitive
statement:
theorem inductive_imp_transitive {E : ZFSet} :
    inductive_set E → inductive_set (E.sep transitive)
proof:
:= by
  unfold inductive_set
  rintro ⟨_, hind⟩
  apply And.intro <;> simp_rw [mem_sep]
  · exact ⟨‹_›, by intro; rw [imp_iff_or_not]; exact Or.inr <| notMem_empty _⟩
  · rintro n ⟨_,_⟩
    apply And.intro
    · exact hind n ‹_›
    · exact trans_imp_insert_trans ‹_›

name: insert_mem
statement: theorem insert_mem {x y : ZFSet} (h : x ∈ y) : insert x y = y
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  rw [mem_insert_iff, or_iff_right_iff_imp]
  rintro rfl
  trivial

name: omega_inductive
statement: theorem omega_inductive : inductive_set ω
proof: := ⟨omega_zero, fun _ ↦ omega_succ⟩

name: inductive_some_inf
statement: private lemma inductive_some_inf : inductive_set some_inf
proof: := Classical.choose_spec _

name: some_inf_nonempty
statement: private lemma some_inf_nonempty : some_inf ≠ ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let h' := inductive_some_inf.left
  rw [h] at h'
  exact (ZFSet.notMem_empty ∅) h'

name: some_inf_mem_sep_inductive_set
statement: private lemma some_inf_mem_sep_inductive_set : some_inf ∈ some_inf.powerset.sep inductive_set
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_sep, mem_powerset, subset_refl, true_and]
  exact inductive_some_inf

name: sdiff_subset
statement: theorem sdiff_subset {s t : ZFSet} : s \ t ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [mem_sdiff]
  rintro ⟨h, _⟩
  exact h

name: mem_symmDiff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_symmDiff (x p q : ZFSet) : x ∈ p Δ q ↔ (x ∈ p ∧ x ∉ q) ∨ (x ∈ q ∧ x ∉ p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [symmDiff, mem_union, mem_sdiff]

name: symmDiff_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmDiff_empty (p : ZFSet) : p Δ ∅ = p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_symmDiff, notMem_empty, not_false_eq_true, and_true, false_and, or_false]

name: symmDiff_comm
statement: theorem symmDiff_comm (p q : ZFSet) : p Δ q = q Δ p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_symmDiff]
  exact Or.comm

name: symmDiff_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmDiff_self (p : ZFSet) : p Δ p = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_symmDiff, and_not_self, or_self, notMem_empty]

name: epsilon_mem
statement: theorem epsilon_mem {y : ZFSet} (hy : y ≠ ∅) : ε y ∈ y
proof:
:= by
  apply ZFSet.choice_mem_aux {y}
  · rw [ZFSet.mem_singleton]
    symm at hy
    exact hy
  · exact ZFSet.mem_singleton.mpr rfl

name: union_mono
statement: theorem union_mono {x y z : ZFSet} :  x ⊆ z → y ⊆ z → x ∪ y ⊆ z
proof:
:= by
  intro hx hy a ha
  rw [ZFSet.mem_union] at ha
  rcases ha with _ | _
  · exact hx ‹_›
  · exact hy ‹_›

name: inter_mono
statement: theorem inter_mono {x y z : ZFSet} :  x ⊆ z → y ⊆ z → x ∩ y ⊆ z
proof:
:= by
  intro hx hy a ha
  rw [ZFSet.mem_inter] at ha
  exact hx ha.1

name: non_empty_pair
statement: theorem non_empty_pair {a b : ZFSet} : Nonempty (a.pair b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair]
  exact ⟨{a}, mem_insert {a} {{a, b}}⟩

name: pair_inter
statement: @[simp] theorem pair_inter {x y : ZFSet} : {x} ∩ {x, y} = ({x} : ZFSet)
proof:
:= by
    ext
    rw [mem_inter, mem_singleton, mem_pair]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨rfl, _ | rfl⟩ <;> rfl
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨rfl, .inl rfl⟩

name: pair_union
statement: @[simp] theorem pair_union {x y : ZFSet} : {x} ∪ {x, y} = ({x, y} : ZFSet)
proof:
:= by
    ext
    rw [mem_union, mem_singleton, mem_pair]
    exact or_self_left

name: pair_minus
statement: @[simp] theorem pair_minus {x y : ZFSet} : x ≠ y → {x, y} \ {x} = ({y} : ZFSet)
proof:
:= by
  intro x_ne_y
  ext z
  rw [mem_sdiff, mem_pair, mem_singleton, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rfl | rfl, r⟩
    · contradiction
    · rfl
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨.inr rfl, x_ne_y ∘ Eq.symm⟩

name: pair_eta
statement: theorem pair_eta {z A B : ZFSet} (h : z ∈ A.prod B) : z = z.π₁.pair z.π₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_prod] at h
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair]

name: mem_dom_of
statement:
theorem mem_dom_of {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) {x y : ZFSet} :
    x.pair y ∈ f → x ∈ f.Dom hf
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [mem_sep]
  exact ⟨pair_mem_prod.mp (hf h) |>.1, y, pair_mem_prod.mp (hf h) |>.2, h⟩

name: mem_range_of
statement:
theorem mem_range_of {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) {x y : ZFSet} :
    x.pair y ∈ f → y ∈ f.Range hf
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [mem_sep]
  exact ⟨pair_mem_prod.mp (hf h) |>.2, x, pair_mem_prod.mp (hf h) |>.1, h⟩

name: mem_dom_iff
statement:
theorem mem_dom_iff {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) {x : ZFSet} :
    x ∈ f.Dom hf ↔ ∃ y, x.pair y ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_sep, and_iff_right_of_imp]
  conv =>
    enter [1,1,y]
    rw [and_iff_right_of_imp]
    · skip
    · tactic =>
        intro h
        apply mem_range_of hf at h
        apply sep_subset at h
        exact h
  rintro ⟨_, _, h⟩
  apply mem_dom_of hf at h
  apply sep_subset at h
  exact h

name: mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_iff {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) {y : ZFSet} :
    y ∈ f.Range hf ↔ ∃ x, pair x y ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_sep, and_iff_right_of_imp]
  conv =>
    enter [1,1,y]
    rw [and_iff_right_of_imp]
    · skip
    · tactic =>
        intro h
        apply mem_dom_of hf at h
        apply sep_subset at h
        exact h
  rintro ⟨_, _, h⟩
  apply mem_range_of hf at h
  apply sep_subset at h
  exact h

name: dom_indep
statement:
theorem dom_indep {R A B A' B' : ZFSet} (h : R ⊆ A.prod B) (h' : R ⊆ A'.prod B') :
    R.Dom h = R.Dom h'
proof:
:= by
  ext x; rw [mem_dom_iff h, mem_dom_iff h']

name: range_indep
statement:
theorem range_indep {R A B A' B' : ZFSet} (h : R ⊆ A.prod B) (h' : R ⊆ A'.prod B') :
    R.Range h = R.Range h'
proof:
:= by
  ext y; rw [mem_range_iff h, mem_range_iff h']

name: dom_subset
statement: theorem dom_subset (f : ZFSet) {A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) : f.Dom ⊆ A
proof:
:=
  sep_subset

name: range_subset
statement: theorem range_subset (f : ZFSet) {A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) : f.Range ⊆ B
proof:
:=
  sep_subset

name: is_rel_ext_iff
statement:
theorem is_rel_ext_iff {A B C D : ZFSet} (R S : ZFSet)
  (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) (hS : S ⊆ C.prod D := by zrel) :
    (∀ x y : ZFSet, x.pair y ∈ R ↔ x.pair y ∈ S) ↔ R = S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro z_R
      obtain ⟨x, _, y, _, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hR z_R
      exact (h x y).mp z_R
    · intro z_S
      obtain ⟨x, _, y, _, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hS z_S
      exact (h x y).mpr z_S
  · intro rfl x y
    trivial

name: mem_inv
statement:
theorem mem_inv {x y R A B : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B) :
    y.pair x ∈ R⁻¹ ↔ x.pair y ∈ R where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro h
    dsimp [inv] at h
    rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at h
    exact h.2
  mpr := by
    intro h
    rw [inv, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, π₁_pair, π₂_pair]
    dsimp
    and_intros
    · exact hR h |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.2
    · exact hR h |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.1
    · exact h

name: subset_prod_inv
statement:
@[zrel]
theorem subset_prod_inv {R A B : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B) : R⁻¹ ⊆ B.prod A
proof: := sep_subset

name: inv_involutive
statement: theorem inv_involutive {R A B : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B) : (R⁻¹)⁻¹ = R
proof:
:= by
  ext1 z
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := (subset_prod_inv <| subset_prod_inv hR) h |> mem_prod.mp
    rwa [mem_inv, mem_inv] at h
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hR h |> mem_prod.mp
    rwa [mem_inv, mem_inv]

name: inv_indep
statement:
theorem inv_indep {R A B A' B' : ZFSet} (h : R ⊆ A.prod B) (h' : R ⊆ A'.prod B') :
    R.inv h = R.inv h'
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨b, hb, a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp (subset_prod_inv h hz)
    exact (mem_inv h').mpr ((mem_inv h).mp hz)
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨b, hb, a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp (subset_prod_inv h' hz)
    exact (mem_inv h).mpr ((mem_inv h').mp hz)

name: dom_inv
statement:
theorem dom_inv (f : ZFSet) {A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) :
    Dom f⁻¹ = Range f
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [mem_dom_iff, mem_range_iff]
  conv => enter [1, 1, y] ; rw [mem_inv]

name: range_inv
statement:
theorem range_inv (f : ZFSet) {A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) :
    Range f⁻¹ = Dom f
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [mem_dom_iff, mem_range_iff]
  conv => enter [1, 1, y] ; rw [mem_inv]

name: is_rel_symmetric_iff
statement:
theorem is_rel_symmetric_iff (R : ZFSet) {A B : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) :
    is_rel_symmetric R hR ↔ ∀ x y : ZFSet, x.pair y ∈ R ↔ y.pair x ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [is_rel_symmetric, ←is_rel_ext_iff R R⁻¹ hR (subset_prod_inv hR)]
  conv => enter [1, x, y] ; rw [mem_inv]

name: funs.nonempty
statement: theorem funs.nonempty {A B : ZFSet} (hB : B ≠ ∅) : ZFSet.funs A B ≠ ∅
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := nonempty_exists_iff.mp hB
  let f := (A.prod B).sep fun z ↦ ∃ x ∈ A, z = x.pair b
  have hf : ZFSet.IsFunc A B f := by
    unfold IsFunc
    and_intros
    · exact sep_subset_self
    · intro x hx
      exists b
      and_intros
      · beta_reduce
        rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod]
        exact ⟨⟨hx,hb⟩,x, ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩
      · intro y hy
        rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod] at hy
        obtain ⟨⟨xA, yB⟩, z, z_A, eq⟩ := hy
        rw [pair_inj] at eq
        exact eq.2
  intro contr
  rw [← mem_funs, contr] at hf
  nomatch notMem_empty f hf

name: is_rel_of_is_pfunc
statement:
@[zrel]
theorem is_rel_of_is_pfunc {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) : f ⊆ A.prod B

name: pfunc_weaken
statement:
theorem pfunc_weaken {f A B C D : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc C D) (hAB : C ⊆ A) (hCD : D ⊆ B) :
    f.IsPFunc A B
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨sub, unique⟩
  and_intros
  · intro _ hz
    obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| sub hz
    rw [mem_prod]
    exact ⟨a, hAB ha, b, hCD hb, rfl⟩
  · intros x y pair_x_y z pair_x_z
    exact unique x y pair_x_y z pair_x_z

name: is_func_is_pfunc
statement:
@[zpfun]
theorem is_func_is_pfunc {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : A.IsFunc B f) : f.IsPFunc A B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sub, func⟩ := hf
  and_intros
  · assumption
  · intros x y pair_x_y z pair_x_z
    obtain ⟨_, x_A, b, b_B, eq⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| sub pair_x_y
    rw [pair_inj] at eq; rcases eq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, pair_x_w, unique⟩ := func x x_A
    rw [unique z pair_x_z, unique y pair_x_y]

name: is_rel_of_is_func
statement:
@[zrel]
theorem is_rel_of_is_func {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : A.IsFunc B f) : f ⊆ A.prod B

name: is_func_extend_range
statement:
theorem is_func_extend_range {f D E : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc D E f) {F : ZFSet} (sub_E_F : E ⊆ F) :
    IsFunc D F f
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨sub, func⟩
  and_intros
  · intro _ hz
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| sub hz
    rw [mem_prod]
    exact ⟨a, ha, b, sub_E_F hb, rfl⟩
  · exact func

name: is_func_empty
statement:
@[simp, zfun]
theorem is_func_empty : IsFunc ∅ ∅ ∅
proof:
:=
  ⟨empty_subset (prod ∅ ∅), fun _ h ↦ nomatch h, notMem_empty _⟩

name: is_pfunc_func_exists
statement:
theorem is_pfunc_func_exists {f A B : ZFSet} :
    f.IsPFunc A B → ∃ A' B', IsFunc A' B' f ∧ A' ⊆ A ∧ B' ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro ⟨sub_AB, func⟩
  by_cases hf : f = ∅
  · subst f
    exact ⟨∅, ∅, is_func_empty, empty_subset A, empty_subset B⟩
  · let A' := A.sep (fun x ↦ ∃ y, pair x y ∈ f)
    let B' := B.sep (fun y ↦ ∃ x ∈ A', pair x y ∈ f)
    exists A', B'
    and_intros
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| sub_AB hz
      rw [mem_prod]
      unfold A' B'
      simp only [mem_sep]
      exists a
      and_intros
      · exact ha
      · exact ⟨b, hz⟩
      · exact ⟨b, ⟨hb, a, mem_sep.mpr ⟨ha, b, hz⟩, hz⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro x x_A
      rw [mem_sep] at x_A
      obtain ⟨x_A, y, pair⟩ := x_A
      have y_B : y ∈ B := by
        obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,h⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| sub_AB pair
        rw [pair_inj] at h
        rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      exact ⟨y, pair, fun z hz ↦ func x z hz y pair⟩
    repeat (intro z hz; exact mem_sep.mp hz |>.left)

name: is_func_dom_range
statement:
theorem is_func_dom_range (f : ZFSet) {A B} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) :
    IsFunc f.Dom f.Range f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hf with ⟨sub, unique⟩
  and_intros
  · intro _ h
    obtain ⟨a,a_A,b,b_B,rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| sub h
    rw [pair_mem_prod]
    and_intros
    · rw [mem_sep]
      and_intros
      · exact a_A
      · use b
    · unfold Range
      rw [mem_sep]
      and_intros
      · exact b_B
      · exists a
  · intro z z_dom
    rw [mem_sep] at z_dom
    obtain ⟨zA, w, hw, zw_f⟩ := z_dom
    use w
    and_intros
    · exact zw_f
    · intro w' zw'_f
      exact unique z w' zw'_f w zw_f

name: is_func_of_pfunc
statement: theorem is_func_of_pfunc (f : ZFSet) {A B} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) : IsFunc f.Dom B f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ftot, uniq⟩ := is_func_dom_range f hf
  obtain ⟨fsub, ispfun⟩ := hf
  and_intros
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, xA, y, yB, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| fsub hz
    obtain ⟨u, u_dom, v, v_dom, eq⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| ftot hz
    rcases pair_inj.mp eq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    clear eq
    rw [pair_mem_prod]
    exact ⟨u_dom, yB⟩
  · exact uniq

name: IsInjective.ofBijective
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ z hx hy _ hxy hxz ↦
    f_bij.1 _ _ z hx hy (pair_mem_prod.mp (hf.1 hxy)).2 hxy hxz

name: bijective_exists1_iff
statement:
theorem bijective_exists1_iff {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) :
  f.IsBijective ↔ ∀ y ∈ B, ∃! x ∈ A, x.pair y ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro bij y y_B
    obtain ⟨inj, surj⟩ := bij
    obtain ⟨x, x_A, x_pair_y⟩ := surj y y_B
    apply ExistsUnique.intro x ⟨x_A, x_pair_y⟩
    rintro z ⟨z_A, z_pair_y⟩
    exact inj x z y x_A z_A y_B x_pair_y z_pair_y |>.symm
  · intro exists1
    constructor
    · intro x z y x_A z_A y_B x_pair_y z_pair_y
      obtain ⟨w, ⟨w_A, w_pair_y⟩, unique⟩ := exists1 y y_B
      rw [unique x ⟨x_A, x_pair_y⟩, unique z ⟨z_A, z_pair_y⟩]
    · intro y y_B
      obtain ⟨x, ⟨x_A, x_pair_y⟩, unique⟩ := exists1 y y_B
      exact ⟨x, x_A, x_pair_y⟩

name: pair_mem_Id_iff
statement: theorem pair_mem_Id_iff {A : ZFSet} {x y : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ A) : x.pair y ∈ 𝟙A ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Id, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right', and_assoc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩
    rfl
  · rintro rfl
    simpa only [and_true, and_self]

name: mem_Id_iff
statement: theorem mem_Id_iff {A : ZFSet} {z : ZFSet} : z ∈ 𝟙A ↔ ∃ x ∈ A, z = x.pair x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Id, mem_sep, mem_prod, and_iff_right_iff_imp, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  rintro x xA rfl
  use x, xA, x, xA

name: pair_self_mem_Id
statement: theorem pair_self_mem_Id {A : ZFSet} {x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ A) : x.pair x ∈ 𝟙A
proof:
:= by
  rwa [pair_mem_Id_iff]

name: Id.IsFunc
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem Id.IsFunc {A : ZFSet} : A.IsFunc A 𝟙A
proof:
:= by
  unfold Id
  and_intros
  · intro z hz
    rw [mem_sep] at hz
    exact hz.1
  · intro x xA
    simp only [mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right']
    exists x
    beta_reduce
    simp only [and_self, and_true, and_imp, forall_self_imp]
    and_intros
    · exact xA
    · rintro _ _ _ rfl
      rfl

name: Id.IsPFunc
statement:
@[zpfun]
theorem Id.IsPFunc {A : ZFSet} : (𝟙A).IsPFunc A A
proof: := is_func_is_pfunc IsFunc

name: Id.IsBijective
statement: theorem Id.IsBijective {A : ZFSet} : (𝟙A).IsBijective Id.IsFunc
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y z xA yA zA x_pair_y y_pair_z
    rw [Id, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod] at x_pair_y y_pair_z
    obtain ⟨x', x'_A, eq_x⟩ := x_pair_y.2
    obtain ⟨y', y'_A, eq_y⟩ := y_pair_z.2
    rw [pair_inj] at eq_x eq_y
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_x
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_y
    rfl
  · intro y yA
    simp_rw [Id, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right',
      existsAndEq, and_self, yA, and_true]

name: range_Id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_Id {A : ZFSet} : (𝟙A).Range = A
proof:
:= by
  ext1 z
  simp only [mem_sep, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  intro hz
  use z, hz
  rw [pair_mem_Id_iff hz]

name: is_rel_reflexive_iff
statement:
theorem is_rel_reflexive_iff (R : ZFSet) {A : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod A) :
    is_rel_reflexive R hR ↔ ∀ x ∈ A, x.pair x ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [is_rel_reflexive, subset_def]
  conv =>
    enter [1, z]
    rw [mem_Id_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x x_A
    exact h ⟨x, x_A, rfl⟩
  · rintro h _ ⟨x, x_A, rfl⟩
    exact h x x_A

name: Id.IsPermutation
statement: theorem Id.IsPermutation {A : ZFSet} : IsPermutation 𝟙A A
proof:
:= by
  exists Id.IsFunc
  exact Id.IsBijective

name: mem_composition
statement:
theorem mem_composition (g f : ZFSet) {A B C : ZFSet} {z : ZFSet} :
  z ∈ composition g f A B C ↔
    ∃ (x w y : ZFSet), z = x.pair y ∧ x ∈ A ∧ y ∈ C ∧ w ∈ B ∧ x.pair w ∈ f ∧ w.pair y ∈ g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [composition, mem_sep, mem_prod]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, eq, _, memB, memf, memg⟩⟩
    rw [pair_inj] at eq
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq
    simp only [pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true, exists_and_left, exists_eq_left']
    and_intros
    · exact ha
    · exact hc
    · exact ⟨_, memB, memf, memg⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, w, y, rfl, xA, yC, wB, xw_f, wy_g⟩
    simp only [pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right', existsAndEq, and_true, exists_eq_left']
    and_intros
    · exact xA
    · exact yC
    · exact ⟨w, wB, xw_f, wy_g⟩

name: Id.composition_left
statement: theorem Id.composition_left {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B) : composition 𝟙B f A B B = f
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  unfold Id composition
  simp only [mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right', existsAndEq, and_self, and_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, aA, b, bB, rfl⟩, x, y, eq, yB, memf, -⟩
    rw [pair_inj] at eq
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq
    exact memf
  · intro xf
    and_intros
    · obtain ⟨a, aA, b, bB, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hf xf
      exists a, aA, b, bB
    · obtain ⟨a, aA, b, bB, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hf xf
      exists a, b

name: Id.composition_right
statement: theorem Id.composition_right {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B) : composition f 𝟙A A A B = f
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  unfold Id composition
  simp only [mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right', existsAndEq, and_self, and_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, aA, b, bB, rfl⟩, x, y, eq, xB, xA, memf⟩
    rw [pair_inj] at eq
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq
    exact memf
  · intro xf
    and_intros
    · obtain ⟨a, aA, b, bB, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hf xf
      exists a, aA, b, bB
    · obtain ⟨a, aA, b, bB, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hf xf
      exists a, b

name: is_rel_of_composition
statement:
@[zrel]
theorem is_rel_of_composition {f g : ZFSet} {A B C : ZFSet} : (composition g f A B C) ⊆ A.prod C
proof:
:=
  sep_subset

name: IsPFunc_of_composition_IsPFunc
statement:
@[zpfun]
theorem IsPFunc_of_composition_IsPFunc {f g : ZFSet} {A B C : ZFSet}
  (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) (hg : g.IsPFunc B C) :
    (composition g f A B C).IsPFunc A C
proof:
:= by
  and_intros
  · intro z hz
    rw [composition, mem_sep] at hz
    exact hz.1
  · intro x y hxy z hz
    rw [composition, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod] at hxy hz
    obtain ⟨a, c, eq, b, bB, ab_f, bc_g⟩ := hz.2
    obtain ⟨a', c', eq', b', bB', ab_f', bc_g'⟩ := hxy.2
    rw [pair_inj] at eq eq'
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq'
    have := hf.2 _ _ ab_f _ ab_f'
    subst this
    symm
    exact hg.2 _ _ bc_g _ bc_g'

name: IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc {g f : ZFSet} {A B C : ZFSet}
  (hg : B.IsFunc C g) (hf : A.IsFunc B f) :
    A.IsFunc C (composition g f A B C)
proof:
:= by
  and_intros
  · intro z hz
    rw [composition, mem_sep] at hz
    exact hz.1
  · intro x xA
    obtain ⟨y, xy_f, y_unq⟩ := hf.2 x xA
    have yB : y ∈ B := And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hf.1 xy_f
    obtain ⟨z, yz_g, z_unq⟩ := hg.2 y yB
    have zC : z ∈ C := And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hg.1 yz_g
    exists z
    simp_rw [composition, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod]
    and_intros
    · exact xA
    · exact zC
    · exists x, z
      and_intros
      · rfl
      · exists y
    · intro z' hz'
      obtain ⟨x', z', eq, y', y'_B, x'y'f, y'z'g⟩ := hz'.2
      rw [pair_inj] at eq
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq
      apply z_unq
      suffices y' = y by
        rw [←this]
        exact y'z'g
      apply y_unq
      exact x'y'f

name: pair_mem_composition
statement:
@[simp] theorem pair_mem_composition (g f : ZFSet) {A B C x y : ZFSet}
  (hg : IsFunc B C g) (hf : IsFunc A B f) :
    x.pair y ∈ (g ∘ᶻ f) ↔ ∃ w ∈ B, x.pair w ∈ f ∧ w.pair y ∈ g where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro hxy
    simp only [mem_composition, pair_inj, ↓existsAndEq, and_true, exists_and_left,
      exists_eq_left'] at hxy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, fxb, gby⟩ := hxy
    use b, hb
  mpr := by
    intro ⟨w, hw, fxw, gwy⟩
    simp only [mem_composition, pair_inj, ↓existsAndEq, and_true, exists_and_left, exists_eq_left']
    and_intros
    · exact hf.1 fxw |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.1
    · exact hg.1 gwy |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.2
    · use w

name: is_rel_transitive_iff
statement:
theorem is_rel_transitive_iff (R : ZFSet) {A B : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B := by zrel) :
    is_rel_transitive R hR ↔ ∀ x y z : ZFSet, x.pair y ∈ R ∧ y.pair z ∈ R → x.pair z ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [is_rel_transitive, subset_def]
  conv =>
    enter [1, z]
    rw [mem_composition]
  constructor
  · rintro h x y z ⟨l,r⟩
    apply h
    exists x, y, z
    exact ⟨rfl,
      dom_subset R hR <| mem_dom_of hR l,
      range_subset R hR <| mem_range_of hR r,
      range_subset R hR <| mem_range_of hR l,
      l, r⟩
  · rintro h _ ⟨x, y, z, rfl, _, _, _, t⟩
    exact h x y z t

name: IsInjective.composition_of_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y z xA yA zC x_f y_f
  rw [fcomp, composition, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod] at x_f y_f
  obtain ⟨a, c, eq, b, bB, ab_f, bc_g⟩ := x_f.2
  have cC : c ∈ C := And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hg.1 bc_g
  obtain ⟨a', c', eq', b', bB', a'b_f, b'c_g⟩ := y_f.2
  have cC' : c' ∈ C := And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hg.1 b'c_g
  rw [pair_inj] at eq eq'
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq'
  obtain ⟨rfl⟩ := ginj _ _ _ bB bB' cC bc_g b'c_g
  exact finj _ _ _ xA yA bB ab_f a'b_f

name: IsSurjective.composition_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro z zC
  simp only [composition, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true, exists_eq_left']
  obtain ⟨y, hy, yz_g⟩ := gsurj z zC
  obtain ⟨x, xA, xy_f⟩ := fsurj y hy
  exists x
  and_intros
  · exact xA
  · exact xA
  · exact zC
  · exists y

name: IsBijective.composition_of_bijective
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsInjective.composition_of_injective fbij.1 gbij.1,
    IsSurjective.composition_of_surjective fbij.2 gbij.2⟩

name: IsPermutation.composition_of_permutations
proof:
:= ⟨
  IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hτ.1 hσ.1,
  IsInjective.composition_of_injective hσ.2.1 hτ.2.1,
  IsSurjective.composition_of_surjective hσ.2.2 hτ.2.2⟩

name: composition_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem composition_assoc {A B C D : ZFSet} {f : ZFSet} {g : ZFSet} {h : ZFSet} :
    (h.composition (g.composition f A B C) A C D) =
    ((h.composition g B C D).composition f A B D)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 z
  constructor <;> intro hz
  · rw [mem_composition] at hz ⊢
    obtain ⟨x, w, y, rfl, hx, hy, hw, hxw, hwy⟩ := hz
    simp only [mem_composition, pair_inj, existsAndEq,
      and_true, exists_and_left, exists_eq_left'] at hxw
    obtain ⟨-, -, u, hu, hxu, huw⟩ := hxw
    use x, u, y
    refine ⟨rfl, hx, hy, hu, hxu, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_composition]
    use u, w, y
  · rw [mem_composition] at hz ⊢
    obtain ⟨x, u, y, rfl, hx, hy, hu, hxu, huy⟩ := hz
    simp only [mem_composition, pair_inj, existsAndEq,
      and_true, exists_and_left, exists_eq_left'] at huy
    obtain ⟨-, -, w, hw, huw, hwy⟩ := huy
    use x, w, y
    refine ⟨rfl, hx, hy, hw, ?_, hwy⟩
    rw [mem_composition]
    use x, u, w

name: fcomp_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fcomp_assoc {A B C D : ZFSet} {f : ZFSet} {g : ZFSet} {h : ZFSet}
  (hf : IsFunc A B f) (hg : IsFunc B C g) (hh : IsFunc C D h) :
    (h ∘ᶻ (g ∘ᶻ f)) = (h ∘ᶻ g ∘ᶻ f)
proof: := composition_assoc

name: is_func_dom_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem is_func_dom_eq {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f := by zfun) : f.Dom = A
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  constructor
  · intro x_dom
    rw [mem_sep] at x_dom
    obtain ⟨xA⟩ := x_dom
    exact xA
  · intro mem_x_A
    rw [mem_sep]
    and_intros
    · exact mem_x_A
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, _⟩ := hf.2 x mem_x_A
      use y
      and_intros
      · exact hf.1 hy |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.2
      · exact hy

name: mem_dom_of_mem
statement:
@[zdom]
theorem mem_dom_of_mem {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) {x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ A) :
    x ∈ Dom f (is_rel_of_is_func hf)
proof: := by rwa [is_func_dom_eq hf]

name: mem_of_mem_dom
statement: theorem mem_of_mem_dom {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) {x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) : x ∈ A
proof:
:=
  dom_subset f (is_rel_of_is_pfunc hf) hx

name: pair_mem_prod_of_mem
statement:
@[zdom]
theorem pair_mem_prod_of_mem {A B a b : ZFSet} (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) :
    a.pair b ∈ A.prod B
proof: := pair_mem_prod.mpr ⟨ha, hb⟩

name: mem_funs_of_is_func
statement:
@[zdom]
theorem mem_funs_of_is_func {A B f : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) : f ∈ A.funs B
proof:
:=
  mem_funs.mpr hf

name: mem_powerset_of_subset
statement:
@[zdom]
theorem mem_powerset_of_subset {A B : ZFSet} (h : A ⊆ B) : A ∈ B.powerset
proof:
:=
  mem_powerset.mpr h

name: fapply_Id
statement:
theorem fapply_Id {A x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ A) :
    @ᶻ𝟙A ⟨x, by zdom⟩ = ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [fapply]
  generalize_proofs choose _
  obtain ⟨_, mem_id⟩ := choose_spec choose
  rw [pair_mem_Id_iff hx] at mem_id
  congr
  rw [←mem_id]

name: fapply_mem_range
statement:
@[zdom]
theorem fapply_mem_range {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) {x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) :
    (@ᶻf ⟨x, hx⟩).val ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.property

name: fapply.def
statement:
theorem fapply.def {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) {x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) :
  x.pair (@ᶻf ⟨x, hx⟩) ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [fapply]
  generalize_proofs y_def
  exact Classical.choose_spec y_def |>.2

name: fapply_val_indep
statement:
theorem fapply_val_indep {f A B A' B' : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) (hf' : f.IsPFunc A' B')
    {x : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) (hx' : x ∈ f.Dom) :
    (fapply f hf ⟨x, hx⟩).val = (fapply f hf' ⟨x, hx'⟩).val
proof:
:=
  hf.2 x _ (fapply.def hf hx) _ (fapply.def hf' hx')

name: IsInjective.apply_inj
statement:
theorem IsInjective.apply_inj {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) (inj : f.IsInjective) :
    Function.Injective @ᶻf
proof:
:= by classical
  rintro ⟨x, x_dom⟩ ⟨y, y_dom⟩ h
  have x_A : x ∈ A := by zdom
  have y_A : y ∈ A := by zdom
  obtain ⟨pair_x_ε, unq_fx⟩ := Classical.choose_spec <| hf.right x x_A
  obtain ⟨pair_y_ε, unq_fy⟩ := Classical.choose_spec <| hf.right y y_A
  congr
  unfold fapply at h
  injection h with h
  generalize_proofs hpf hpf' at h
  have choose_eq {z} (z_dom : z ∈ f.Dom) :
      Classical.choose (hf.right z (by zdom)) =
      Classical.choose (fapply._proof_1 f (is_func_is_pfunc hf) z z_dom) := by
    congr
    funext w
    rw [propext_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨pair_z_w, unq_w⟩
      obtain ⟨_,_,_,l,eq⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hf.left pair_z_w
      rcases pair_inj.mp eq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨l, pair_z_w⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, pair_z_w⟩
      obtain ⟨a,pair_z_a,unq_a⟩ := hf.right z (by zdom)
      exact ⟨pair_z_w, by intro w' pair_x_w'; rw [unq_a w' pair_x_w', unq_a w pair_z_w]⟩
  apply inj x y (Classical.choose <| hf.right x x_A) x_A y_A
  · exact choose_eq x_dom ▸ fapply_mem_range (is_func_is_pfunc hf) x_dom
  · exact pair_x_ε
  · rw [choose_eq x_dom, h, ← choose_eq y_dom]
    exact pair_y_ε

name: IsPFunc.exists_unique_of_mem_dom
proof:
:= by
  unfold Dom at hx
  rw [mem_sep] at hx
  obtain ⟨xA, y, yB, xy_f⟩ := hx
  use y
  and_intros
  · exact xy_f
  · intro y' xy'_f
    symm
    exact hf.2 _ _ xy_f _ xy'_f

name: fapply.of_pair
statement:
theorem fapply.of_pair {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) {x y : ZFSet} (hxy : x.pair y ∈ f) :
  @ᶻf ⟨x, mem_dom_of (is_rel_of_is_pfunc hf) hxy⟩ = ⟨y, (pair_mem_prod.mp <| hf.1 hxy).2⟩
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [fapply]
  generalize_proofs y_def choose_B yB
  congr
  have spec := Classical.choose_spec y_def |>.2
  obtain ⟨w, xw, uniq⟩ :=
    IsPFunc.exists_unique_of_mem_dom hf (mem_dom_of (is_rel_of_is_pfunc hf) hxy)
  exact uniq _ hxy ▸ uniq _ spec

name: IsPFunc.supset_of_range
statement: theorem IsPFunc.supset_of_range {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : f.IsPFunc A B) : f.Range ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  intro y y_B
  rw [mem_sep] at y_B
  exact y_B.1

name: IsPFunc.nonempty_range_of_nonempty_dom
proof:
:= by
  have y_ran := mem_range_of (is_rel_of_is_pfunc hf) hxy
  rw [nonempty_exists_iff]
  exists y

name: IsInjective.apply_inj_pfun
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, x_dom⟩ ⟨y, y_dom⟩ h
  congr
  unfold IsInjective at inj
  apply inj x y (@ᶻf ⟨x, x_dom⟩) x_dom y_dom
  · dsimp [fapply]
    have : ∃ z ∈ B, pair x z ∈ f := by
      unfold Dom at x_dom
      rw [mem_sep] at x_dom
      obtain ⟨xA, y, yB, xy_f⟩ := x_dom
      use y
    generalize_proofs
    obtain ⟨memB, -⟩ := Classical.choose_spec this
    exact memB
  · exact fapply.def hf x_dom
  · rw [h]
    exact fapply.def hf y_dom

name: IsInjective.apply_surj
statement:
theorem IsInjective.apply_surj {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) (surj : f.IsSurjective) :
    Function.Surjective @ᶻf
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, yB⟩
  obtain ⟨x, -, pair⟩ := surj y yB
  have x_dom : x ∈ f.Dom := mem_dom_of (is_rel_of_is_func hf) pair
  exists ⟨x, x_dom⟩
  exact fapply.of_pair (is_func_is_pfunc hf) pair

name: IsInjective.apply_surj_pfun
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, yB⟩
  obtain ⟨x, -, pair⟩ := surj y yB
  have x_dom' : x ∈ f.Dom := mem_dom_of (is_rel_of_is_pfunc hf) pair
  exists ⟨x, x_dom'⟩
  exact fapply.of_pair hf pair

name: prod_sep_is_pfunc_mem
statement:
theorem prod_sep_is_pfunc_mem {A B C D : ZFSet} (subAC : A ⊆ C) (subBD : B ⊆ D) :
    (A.prod B).powerset.sep (IsPFunc · A B) ∈ (C.prod D).powerset.powerset
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_powerset]
  intro S hS
  rw [mem_sep] at hS
  rw [mem_powerset] at hS ⊢
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨_,l,_,r,rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hS.left hx
  rw [pair_mem_prod]
  exact ⟨subAC l, subBD r⟩

name: lambda_spec
statement:
theorem lambda_spec {dom ran : ZFSet} {exp : ZFSet → ZFSet} {x : ZFSet} {y : ZFSet} :
  x.pair y ∈ (λᶻ : dom → ran | z ↦ exp z) ↔ x ∈ dom ∧ y ∈ ran ∧ y = exp x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambda, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, π₁_pair, π₂_pair, and_assoc]

name: mem_lambda
statement:
theorem mem_lambda {dom ran : ZFSet} {exp : ZFSet → ZFSet} {z : ZFSet} :
    (z ∈ λᶻ : dom → ran | x ↦ exp x) ↔
    ∃ x y : ZFSet, z = x.pair y ∧ x ∈ dom ∧ y ∈ ran ∧ y = exp x where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro hz
    rw [lambda, mem_sep] at hz
    obtain ⟨hz, eq⟩ := hz
    rw [mem_prod] at hz
    obtain ⟨x, x_dom, y, y_ran, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at eq
    subst y
    exists x, exp x
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨x, y, ⟨rfl, x_dom, y_ran, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [lambda, mem_sep, mem_prod]
    and_intros
    · exact ⟨x, x_dom, exp x, y_ran, rfl⟩
    · rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair]

name: lambda_ext_iff
statement:
theorem lambda_ext_iff {d r : ZFSet} {f₁ f₂ : ZFSet → ZFSet} (hf₁ : ∀ {x}, x ∈ d → f₁ x ∈ r) :
    (λᶻ : d → r | x ↦ f₁ x) = (λᶻ : d → r | x ↦ f₂ x) ↔ ∀ z ∈ d, f₁ z = f₂ z where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro h z hz
    rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at h
    specialize h (z.pair (f₁ z))
    rw [lambda_spec, lambda_spec, eq_self, and_true] at h
    exact h.mp ⟨hz, hf₁ hz⟩ |>.2.2
  mpr := by
    intro hext
    ext1 z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rw [mem_lambda] at hz
      obtain ⟨x, y, ⟨rfl, x_d, y_r, rfl⟩⟩ := hz
      rw [lambda_spec]
      exact ⟨x_d, y_r, hext x x_d⟩
    · intro hz
      rw [mem_lambda] at hz
      obtain ⟨x, y, ⟨rfl, x_d, y_r, rfl⟩⟩ := hz
      rw [lambda_spec]
      exact ⟨x_d, y_r, hext x x_d |>.symm⟩

name: lambda_ext_iff'
statement:
theorem lambda_ext_iff' {d₁ d₂ r₁ r₂ : ZFSet} {f₁ f₂ : ZFSet → ZFSet}
  (hf₁ : ∀ {x}, x ∈ d₁ → f₁ x ∈ r₁) (hf₂ : ∀ {x}, x ∈ d₂ → f₂ x ∈ r₂) :
    (λᶻ : d₁ → r₁ | x ↦ f₁ x) = (λᶻ : d₂ → r₂ | x ↦ f₂ x) ↔ d₁ = d₂ ∧ ∀ z ∈ d₁, f₁ z = f₂ z where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at h
    and_intros
    · ext1 z
      constructor
      · intro z_d₁
        specialize h <| z.pair (f₁ z)
        rw [lambda_spec, lambda_spec, eq_self, and_true] at h
        exact h.mp ⟨z_d₁, hf₁ z_d₁⟩ |>.1
      · intro z_d₂
        specialize h <| z.pair (f₂ z)
        rw [lambda_spec, lambda_spec, eq_self, and_true] at h
        exact h.mpr ⟨z_d₂, hf₂ z_d₂⟩ |>.1
    · intro z z_d₁
      specialize h <| z.pair (f₁ z)
      rw [lambda_spec, lambda_spec, eq_self, and_true] at h
      exact h.mp ⟨z_d₁, hf₁ z_d₁⟩ |>.2.2
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨rfl, hext⟩
    ext1 z
    unfold lambda
    simp only [mem_sep, mem_prod]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩, eq⟩
      rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at eq
      subst b
      and_intros
      · use a, ha, f₁ a
        and_intros
        · rw [hext a ha]
          exact hf₂ ha
        · rfl
      · rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair, hext a ha]
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩, eq⟩
      rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at eq
      subst b
      and_intros
      · use a, ha, f₂ a
        and_intros
        · rw [←hext a ha]
          exact hf₁ ha
        · rfl
      · rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair, ←hext a ha]

name: lambda_eta
statement:
theorem lambda_eta {A B : ZFSet} {f : ZFSet} (hf : A.IsFunc B f) :
  f = (λᶻ : A → B
          | x ↦ @ᶻf ⟨x, by zdom⟩)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 z
  constructor <;> intro hz
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hf.1 hz |> mem_prod.mp
    rw [lambda_spec, dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hx)]
    refine ⟨hx, hy, ?_⟩
    rw [fapply.of_pair (is_func_is_pfunc hf) hz]
  · rw [mem_lambda] at hz
    obtain ⟨x, y, rfl, xA, -, rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true xA)]
    apply fapply.def

name: is_func_ext_iff
statement:
theorem is_func_ext_iff {A B : ZFSet} {f g : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) (hg : IsFunc A B g) :
    f = g ↔ (∀ x,
      (hx : x ∈ A) →
      @ᶻf ⟨x, by zdom⟩ = @ᶻg ⟨x, by zdom⟩)
where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rintro rfl
    exact fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  mpr := by
    intro h
    rw [
      lambda_eta hf,
      lambda_eta hg,
      lambda_ext_iff
        (fun h ↦ by rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true h)]; apply Subtype.property)]
    intro z hz
    simp_rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hz), ←Subtype.ext_iff]
    exact h _ hz

name: lambda_subset
statement: theorem lambda_subset {A B : ZFSet} {exp : ZFSet → ZFSet} : lambda A B exp ⊆ A.prod B
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [lambda, mem_sep] at hz
  exact hz.1

name: lambda_isFunc
statement:
theorem lambda_isFunc {A B : ZFSet} {f : ZFSet → ZFSet} (hf : ∀ {x}, x ∈ A → f x ∈ B) :
    A.IsFunc B (lambda A B f)
proof:
:= by
  and_intros
  · exact lambda_subset
  · intro x x_A
    exists f x
    and_intros
    · beta_reduce
      rw [lambda_spec]
      exact ⟨x_A, hf x_A, rfl⟩
    · beta_reduce
      intro y hy
      rw [lambda_spec] at hy
      exact hy.2.2

name: mem_funs_of_lambda
statement:
@[zdom]
theorem mem_funs_of_lambda {A B : ZFSet} {f : ZFSet → ZFSet} (hf : ∀ {x}, x ∈ A → f x ∈ B) :
  lambda A B f ∈ A.funs B
proof: := mem_funs.mpr <| lambda_isFunc hf

name: fapply_lambda
statement:
theorem fapply_lambda {A B : ZFSet} {f : ZFSet → ZFSet}
  (hf : ∀ {x}, x ∈ A → f x ∈ B) {a : ZFSet} (ha : a ∈ A) :
    fapply (λᶻ : A → B | x ↦ f x) (is_func_is_pfunc <| lambda_isFunc hf)
      ⟨a, by zdom⟩ = f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [fapply]
  generalize_proofs choose_y y_mem_B
  have y_def := Classical.choose_spec choose_y |>.2
  rw [lambda_spec] at y_def
  exact y_def.2.2

name: inv_is_func_of_injective
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem inv_is_func_of_injective {f A B : ZFSet} {f_is_func : A.IsFunc B f}
  (hf : f.IsInjective f_is_func) :
    (f.Range).IsFunc A f⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  and_intros
  · intro y hy
    rw [inv, mem_sep] at hy
    obtain ⟨y_mem, pair_f⟩ := hy
    rw [mem_prod] at y_mem
    obtain ⟨b, hb, a, ha, rfl⟩ := y_mem
    rw [π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at pair_f
    dsimp at pair_f
    rw [pair_mem_prod]
    and_intros
    · rw [mem_sep]
      and_intros
      · exact hb
      · use a
    · exact ha
  · intro y hy
    rw [mem_sep] at hy
    obtain ⟨hy, x, hx, pair_f⟩ := hy
    use x
    and_intros <;> beta_reduce
    · unfold inv
      rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, π₁_pair, π₂_pair]
      exact ⟨⟨hy, hx⟩, pair_f⟩
    · intro z hz
      rw [inv, mem_sep, π₁_pair, π₂_pair, pair_mem_prod] at hz
      symm
      exact hf x z y hx hz.1.2 hy pair_f hz.2

name: inv_is_func_of_bijective
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem inv_is_func_of_bijective {f A B : ZFSet} {f_is_func : A.IsFunc B f}
  (hf : f.IsBijective f_is_func) :
    B.IsFunc A (f.inv )
proof:
:= by
  and_intros
  · intro xy hxy
    dsimp [inv] at hxy
    rw [mem_sep] at hxy
    obtain ⟨xy_prod, pair_f⟩ := hxy
    rw [mem_prod] at xy_prod
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := xy_prod
    rw [pair_mem_prod]
    exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
  · intro z hz
    rw [bijective_exists1_iff] at hf
    obtain ⟨x, ⟨x_A, hx⟩, x_unq⟩ := hf z hz
    simp_rw [mem_inv]
    use x
    and_intros <;> beta_reduce
    · exact hx
    · intro y hy
      apply x_unq y
      refine And.intro ?_ hy
      exact f_is_func.1 hy |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.1

name: inv_bijective_of_bijective
proof:
:= by
  and_intros
  · intro x y z xB yB zA fxz fyz
    rw [mem_inv] at fxz fyz
    obtain ⟨_, _, unq⟩ := f_is_func.2 z zA
    rw [unq x fxz, unq y fyz]
  · intro x xA
    obtain ⟨y, yA, _⟩ := f_is_func.2 x xA
    use y
    and_intros
    · exact f_is_func.1 yA |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.2
    · rw [mem_inv]
      exact yA

name: composition_self_inv_of_bijective
proof:
:= by
  ext1 z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [mem_composition] at hz
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, rfl, aA, cA, bB, ab_f, bc_finv⟩ := hz
    rw [mem_inv] at bc_finv
    rw [pair_mem_Id_iff aA]
    exact hf.1 _ _ _ aA cA bB ab_f bc_finv
  · intro hz
    rw [mem_Id_iff] at hz
    obtain ⟨a, aA, rfl⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨b, ab_f, -⟩ := f_is_func.2 a aA
    simp only [mem_composition, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true, exists_and_left, exists_eq_left',
      and_self_left]
    apply And.intro aA
    use b, f_is_func.1 ab_f |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.2
    rw [mem_inv, and_self]
    exact ab_f

name: composition_inv_self_of_bijective
proof:
:= by
  set g := f⁻¹
  have : B.IsFunc A g := inv_is_func_of_bijective hf
  have ginv_eq : g⁻¹ = f := inv_involutive _
  conv =>
    enter [1,1]
    rw [←ginv_eq]
  exact composition_self_inv_of_bijective <| inv_bijective_of_bijective hf

name: inv_fcomp_iff
proof:
:= by
  ext1 z
  constructor <;> intro hz
  · generalize_proofs g_f_rel at hz
    obtain ⟨c, hc, a, ha, rfl⟩ := subset_prod_inv g_f_rel hz |> mem_prod.mp
    rw [mem_inv, pair_mem_composition] at hz
    obtain ⟨b, hb, fab, gbc⟩ := hz
    rw [←mem_inv (is_rel_of_is_func ‹_›)] at fab gbc
    rw [pair_mem_composition]
    use b, hb, gbc, fab
  · rw [mem_composition] at hz
    obtain ⟨x, w, y, rfl, hx, hy, hw, gwx, fyw⟩ := hz
    rw [mem_inv (is_rel_of_is_func ‹_›)] at gwx fyw
    rw [mem_inv, pair_mem_composition]
    use w, hw, fyw, gwx

name: fcomp_bij_fcomp_inv_right
statement:
theorem fcomp_bij_fcomp_inv_right {A B C : ZFSet} {f g h : ZFSet} {hf : IsFunc A B f}
  (hbij : f.IsBijective hf) (hg : IsFunc B C g) (hh : IsFunc A C h) :
    (g ∘ᶻ f) = h ↔ g = (h ∘ᶻ f⁻¹) where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro eq
    ext1 z
    constructor <;> intro hz
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hg.1 hz |> mem_prod.mp
      obtain ⟨w, hw, fwx⟩ := hbij.2 x hx
      rw [pair_mem_composition]
      use w, hw
      rw [mem_inv]
      and_intros
      · exact fwx
      · rw [←eq, pair_mem_composition]
        use x, hx, fwx, hz
    · rw [mem_composition] at hz
      obtain ⟨x, w, y, rfl, hx, hy, hw, fwx, hwy⟩ := hz
      rw [←eq, pair_mem_composition] at hwy
      obtain ⟨x', hx', fwx', gx'y⟩ := hwy
      rw [mem_inv] at fwx
      obtain rfl := hf.2 w hw |>.unique fwx fwx'
      exact gx'y
  mpr := by
    intro eq
    ext1 z
    constructor <;> intro hz
    · rw [mem_composition] at hz
      obtain ⟨x, w, y, rfl, hx, hy, hw, fwx, gwy⟩ := hz
      rw [eq, pair_mem_composition] at gwy
      obtain ⟨w', hw', fww', hwy⟩ := gwy
      rw [mem_inv] at fww'
      obtain rfl := hbij.1 _ _ _ hx hw' hw fwx fww'
      exact hwy
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hh.1 hz |> mem_prod.mp
      obtain ⟨w, hw, fxw⟩ := ZFSet.inv_bijective_of_bijective hbij |>.2 x hx
      rw [mem_inv] at fxw
      rw [pair_mem_composition]
      use w, hw, fxw
      rw [eq, pair_mem_composition]
      use x, hx, (by rwa [mem_inv]), hz

name: fcomp_bij_fcomp_inv_left
statement:
theorem fcomp_bij_fcomp_inv_left {A B C : ZFSet} {f g h : ZFSet} {hf : IsFunc B C f}
  (hbij : f.IsBijective hf) (hg : IsFunc A B g) (hh : IsFunc A C h) :
    (f ∘ᶻ g) = h ↔ g = (f⁻¹ ∘ᶻ h) where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro eq
    ext1 z
    constructor <;> intro hz
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hg.1 hz |> mem_prod.mp
      obtain ⟨w, fyw, w_unq⟩ := hf.2 y hy
      have hw := hf.1 fyw |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.2
      rw [pair_mem_composition]
      use w, hw
      rw [mem_inv]
      and_intros
      · rw [←eq, pair_mem_composition]
        use y, hy, hz, fyw
      · exact fyw
    · rw [mem_composition] at hz
      obtain ⟨x, w, y, rfl, hx, hy, hw, gwx, fyw⟩ := hz
      rw [mem_inv] at fyw
      rw [←eq, pair_mem_composition] at gwx
      obtain ⟨y', hy', gxy', fy'w⟩ := gwx
      obtain rfl := hbij.1 _ _ _ hy hy' hw fyw fy'w
      exact gxy'
  mpr := by
    intro eq
    ext1 z
    constructor <;> intro hz
    · rw [mem_composition] at hz
      obtain ⟨x, w, y, rfl, hx, hy, hw, gwx, fyw⟩ := hz
      rw [eq, pair_mem_composition] at gwx
      obtain ⟨y', hy', gy'y, fwy'⟩ := gwx
      rw [mem_inv] at fwy'
      obtain rfl := hf.2 w hw |>.unique fyw fwy'
      exact gy'y
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hh.1 hz |> mem_prod.mp
      rw [pair_mem_composition]
      obtain ⟨w, hw, fyw⟩ := hbij.2 y hy
      use w, hw
      and_intros
      · rw [eq, pair_mem_composition]
        use y, hy, hz
        rwa [mem_inv]
      · exact fyw

name: fcomp_bij_right_cancel_iff
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [fcomp_bij_fcomp_inv_right hbij hg₁ (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hg₂ hf)]
    change g₁ = (g₂ ∘ᶻ f ∘ᶻ f⁻¹)
    rw [←fcomp_assoc]
    conv =>
      enter [2]
      conv =>
        enter [2]
        rw [composition_inv_self_of_bijective hbij]
      rw [fcomp, Id.composition_right hg₂.1]

name: fcomp_bij_left_cancel_iff
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [fcomp_bij_fcomp_inv_left hbij hg₁ (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hf hg₂)]
    change g₁ = (f⁻¹ ∘ᶻ (f ∘ᶻ g₂))
    rw [fcomp_assoc]
    conv =>
      enter [2]
      conv =>
        enter [1]
        rw [composition_self_inv_of_bijective hbij]
      rw [fcomp, Id.composition_left hg₂.1]

name: mem_Image
statement:
theorem mem_Image {R A B X y : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B) :
    y ∈ R[X] ↔ y ∈ B ∧ ∃ x ∈ X, x.pair y ∈ R where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro hy
    rw [Image, mem_sep] at hy
    exact ⟨hy.1, hy.2⟩
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨yB, x, xX, xyR⟩
    rw [Image, mem_sep]
    exact ⟨yB, ⟨x, xX, xyR⟩⟩

name: Image_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Image_empty {R A B : ZFSet} (hR : R ⊆ A.prod B) : R[∅] = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext1 y
  simp only [mem_Image, notMem_empty, false_and, exists_const, and_false]

name: Image_of_singleton_pair_mem_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · ext1 z
    simp only [mem_Image, mem_singleton, exists_eq_left]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨zB, hz⟩
      apply hf.2 a (hf.1 h |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.1) |>.unique
      · exact hz
      · exact h
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨hf.1 h |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.2, h⟩
  · rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at h
    specialize h b
    rw [ZFSet.mem_singleton, eq_self, iff_true, mem_Image] at h
    simp only [mem_singleton, exists_eq_left] at h
    exact h.2

name: eq_singleton_of_bijective_inv_Image_of_singleton
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, aA, fab⟩ := hbij.2 b hb
  use a, aA
  rwa [←Image_of_singleton_pair_mem_iff (inv_is_func_of_bijective hbij), mem_inv]

name: Image_singleton_eq_fapply
proof:
:= by
  rw [←Image_of_singleton_pair_mem_iff hf]
  apply fapply.def

name: fapply_eq_Image_singleton
proof:
:= by
  rw [Image_singleton_eq_fapply hf ha, sInter_singleton]

name: fapply_composition
proof:
:= by
  unfold fcomp
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff]
  rw [fapply_eq_Image_singleton (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hg hf) xA,
    fapply_eq_Image_singleton hg (fapply_mem_range _ _)]
  congr 1
  ext1 c
  constructor
  · intro hc
    simp only [mem_Image, mem_singleton, mem_composition, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true,
      exists_and_left, exists_eq_left', exists_eq_left] at hc
    obtain ⟨cC, -, -, b, bB, xb_f, bc_g⟩ := hc
    rw [fapply.of_pair (is_func_is_pfunc hf) xb_f, Image_singleton_eq_fapply hg bB, mem_singleton,
      fapply.of_pair (is_func_is_pfunc hg) bc_g]
  · intro hc
    rw [mem_Image] at hc
    obtain ⟨cC, b, hb, bc_g⟩ := hc
    rw [mem_singleton] at hb
    simp only [mem_Image, mem_singleton, mem_composition, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true,
      exists_and_left, exists_eq_left', exists_eq_left]
    and_intros
    · exact cC
    · exact xA
    · exact cC
    · use b
      subst hb
      and_intros
      · apply fapply_mem_range
      · apply fapply.def
      · exact bc_g

name: Image_of_composition_inv_self_of_bijective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Image_of_composition_inv_self_of_bijective {f A B : ZFSet} {f_is_func : A.IsFunc B f}
  (hf : f.IsBijective) {X : ZFSet} (hX : X ⊆ A) :
    f⁻¹[f[X]] = X
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_Image] at hx
    obtain ⟨xA, y, yfX, xy_finv⟩ := hx
    rw [mem_inv] at xy_finv
    rw [mem_Image] at yfX
    obtain ⟨yB, z, zX, zy_f⟩ := yfX
    obtain rfl := hf.1 x z y xA (f_is_func.1 zy_f |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.1) yB xy_finv zy_f
    exact zX
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_Image]
    and_intros
    · exact hX hx
    · use @ᶻf ⟨x, by zdom⟩
      and_intros
      · rw [mem_Image]
        and_intros
        · apply fapply_mem_range
        · use x, hx
          apply fapply.def
      · rw [mem_inv]
        apply fapply.def

name: Image_of_composition_self_inv_of_bijective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Image_of_composition_self_inv_of_bijective {f A B : ZFSet} {f_is_func : A.IsFunc B f}
  (hf : f.IsBijective f_is_func) {X : ZFSet} (hX : X ⊆ B) :
    f[f⁻¹[X]] = X
proof:
:= by
  have := Image_of_composition_inv_self_of_bijective (f := f⁻¹) (inv_bijective_of_bijective hf) hX
  conv at this =>
    enter [1,1]
    rw [inv_involutive]
  exact this

name: fapply_inv_of_bijective
proof:
:= by
  intro rfl
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [←fapply_composition (inv_is_func_of_bijective f_bij) hf hx,
      fapply_eq_Image_singleton
        (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc (inv_is_func_of_bijective f_bij) hf) hx]
    conv =>
      enter [1,1]
      rw [←fcomp.eq_def _ _ (inv_is_func_of_bijective f_bij) hf,
        composition_self_inv_of_bijective f_bij]
    rw [←fapply_eq_Image_singleton Id.IsFunc hx, fapply_Id hx]

name: fapply_inv_of_bijective_iff
proof:
:= fapply_inv_of_bijective f_bij hx hy
    mpr := by
      intro h
      have := fapply_inv_of_bijective (inv_bijective_of_bijective f_bij) hy hx h
      conv_lhs at this =>
        rw [fapply_eq_Image_singleton
          (inv_is_func_of_bijective (inv_bijective_of_bijective f_bij)) hx]
        conv =>
          enter [1,1]
          rw [inv_involutive]
        rw [←fapply_eq_Image_singleton hf hx]
      exact this

name: isTuple_pair
statement: theorem isTuple_pair {a b : ZFSet} : hasArity (ZFSet.pair a b) 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasArity]
  · split_ifs with cond
    · trivial
    · push Not at cond
      nomatch cond a b
  · rintro ⟨⟩

name: sep_mem_powerset
statement:
theorem sep_mem_powerset {D T : ZFSet} {P : ZFSet → Prop} :
    D ∈ T.powerset → D.sep P ∈ T.powerset
proof:
:= by
  intro hD
  rw [mem_powerset, subset_def] at hD ⊢
  exact fun _ hz => hD (ZFSet.mem_sep.mp hz).1

name: subset_of_
statement: theorem subset_of_𝔹_sInter (B : ZFSet) : B ⊆ ZFSet.𝔹 → (⋂₀ B : ZFSet) ∈ ZFSet.𝔹
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  simp_rw [← ZFSet.mem_powerset, ZFSet.ZFBool.powerset_𝔹_def,
    ZFSet.mem_insert_iff, ZFSet.mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · rw [ZFSet.sInter_empty]
    exact ZFSet.ZFBool.zffalse_mem_𝔹
  · rw [ZFSet.sInter_singleton]
    exact ZFSet.ZFBool.zffalse_mem_𝔹
  · rw [ZFSet.sInter_singleton]
    exact ZFSet.ZFBool.zftrue_mem_𝔹
  · rw [ZFSet.sInter_pair, ZFSet.ZFBool.mem_𝔹_iff]
    left
    ext1 x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases ZFSet.mem_inter.mp hx
      assumption
    · intro hx
      unfold ZFSet.zffalse at hx
      nomatch (ZFSet.notMem_empty x) hx

name: subset_of_
statement: theorem subset_of_𝔹_sUnion (B : ZFSet) : B ⊆ ZFSet.𝔹 → (⋃₀ B : ZFSet) ∈ ZFSet.𝔹
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  simp_rw [← ZFSet.mem_powerset, ZFSet.ZFBool.powerset_𝔹_def,
    ZFSet.mem_insert_iff, ZFSet.mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · rw [ZFSet.sUnion_empty]
    exact ZFSet.ZFBool.zffalse_mem_𝔹
  · rw [ZFSet.sUnion_singleton]
    exact ZFSet.ZFBool.zffalse_mem_𝔹
  · rw [ZFSet.sUnion_singleton]
    exact ZFSet.ZFBool.zftrue_mem_𝔹
  · rw [ZFSet.sUnion_pair, ZFSet.ZFBool.mem_𝔹_iff]
    right
    ext1 x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases ZFSet.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
      · nomatch (ZFSet.notMem_empty x) hx
      · exact hx
    · intro hx
      exact mem_union.mpr <| Or.inr hx

name: sInter_sep_subset_of_
statement:
theorem sInter_sep_subset_of_𝔹_mem_𝔹 {D : ZFSet} {P : ZFSet → Prop} :
    D ⊆ ZFSet.𝔹 → (⋂₀ (D.sep P) : ZFSet) ∈ ZFSet.𝔹
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply ZFSet.subset_of_𝔹_sInter (ZFSet.sep P D)
  intros _ hx
  rw [ZFSet.mem_sep] at hx
  exact h hx.1

name: sUnion_sep_subset_of_
statement:
theorem sUnion_sep_subset_of_𝔹_mem_𝔹 {D : ZFSet} {P : ZFSet → Prop} :
    D ⊆ ZFSet.𝔹 → (⋃₀ (D.sep P) : ZFSet) ∈ ZFSet.𝔹
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply ZFSet.subset_of_𝔹_sUnion (ZFSet.sep P D)
  intros _ hx
  rw [ZFSet.mem_sep] at hx
  exact h hx.1

name: IsFunc.sep_on_eq
statement:
theorem IsFunc.sep_on_eq {A B : ZFSet} {f : ZFSet → ZFSet} (hf : ∀ x ∈ A, f x ∈ B) :
    IsFunc A B <| (A.prod B).sep (fun z ↦ ∃ x y : ZFSet, z = x.pair y ∧ y = f z.π₁)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsFunc
  and_intros
  · exact sep_subset_self
  · intro x hx
    exists f x
    and_intros
    · beta_reduce
      rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod]
      and_intros
      · exact hx
      · exact hf x hx
      · exists x, (f x)
        and_intros
        · rfl
        · rw [π₁_pair]
    · intro w hw
      rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod] at hw
      obtain ⟨⟨hx, hw⟩, z, _, eq, rfl⟩ := hw
      rw [π₁_pair] at eq
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pair_inj.mp eq
      rfl

name: IsFunc.is_func_on_range
statement:
theorem IsFunc.is_func_on_range {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : A.IsFunc B f) :
  A.IsFunc (f.Range) f
proof:
:= by
    conv =>
      arg 1
      rw [←is_func_dom_eq hf]
    exact is_func_dom_range f (is_func_is_pfunc hf)

name: IsPFunc.empty_dom
statement: theorem IsPFunc.empty_dom {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsPFunc f A B) (dom_emp : f.Dom = ∅) : f = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext1 z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨x, xA, y, yB, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| hf.1 hz
    nomatch notMem_empty _ <| dom_emp ▸ mem_dom_of (is_rel_of_is_pfunc hf) hz
  · intro hz
    nomatch notMem_empty _ <| hz

name: IsPFunc.empty_range_of_empty_dom
statement:
theorem IsPFunc.empty_range_of_empty_dom {f A B : ZFSet}
  (hf : IsPFunc f A B) (dom_emp : f.Dom = ∅) : f.Range = ∅
proof:
:= by
    unfold Range
    apply empty_dom hf at dom_emp
    conv => arg 1 ; rw [dom_emp]
    simp only [notMem_empty, and_false, exists_const, sep_empty_iff, not_false_eq_true,
      implies_true, or_true]

name: IsPFunc.exists_dom_of_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  unfold Range at hy
  rw [mem_sep] at hy
  obtain ⟨y_B, x, x_dom, pair⟩ := hy
  exists x

name: IsFunc.surj_on_range
statement:
theorem IsFunc.surj_on_range {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) :
    IsSurjective (f := f) (A := A) (B := f.Range) (is_func_on_range hf)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  exact IsPFunc.exists_dom_of_mem_range (is_func_is_pfunc hf) hy

name: bijective_of_injective
statement:
theorem bijective_of_injective {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f) (inj : f.IsInjective hf) :
    f.IsBijective (A := A) (B := Range f) (IsFunc.is_func_on_range hf)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y z xA yA zRange xz yz
    apply inj x y z xA yA _ xz yz
    rw [mem_sep] at zRange
    exact zRange.1
  · intro y hy
    exact IsPFunc.exists_dom_of_mem_range (is_func_is_pfunc hf) hy

name: IsFunc.range_eq_of_surjective
statement:
theorem IsFunc.range_eq_of_surjective {f A B : ZFSet} (hf : IsFunc A B f)
  (surj : f.IsSurjective hf) :
    f.Range = B
proof:
:= by
  ext1 y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact (mem_sep.mp hy).1
  · intro hy
    rw [mem_sep]
    and_intros
    · exact hy
    · obtain ⟨x, x_dom, xy⟩ := surj y hy
      exists x

name: IsFinite.empty
statement: theorem IsFinite.empty : (∅:ZFSet).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsFinite IsInjective
  simp only [notMem_empty, IsEmpty.forall_iff, implies_true, mem_funs, exists_prop, and_true,
    exists_and_left, IsFunc, prod_empty_left]
  exact ⟨∅, ZFNat.zero_in_Nat, ∅, fun _ => id⟩

name: IsFinite.subset
statement:
theorem IsFinite.subset {A B : ZFSet} (finB : B.IsFinite) (subAB : A ⊆ B) :
  A.IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, f, hn, hf, inj⟩ := finB
  generalize_proofs f_func at inj
  exists n, A.prod n |>.sep fun z => ∃ x y : ZFSet, z ∈ f ∧ z = x.pair y, hn, ?_
  · rw [mem_funs] at hf ⊢
    and_intros
    · intro z hz
      rw [mem_sep] at hz
      exact hz.1
    · intro x xA
      simp only [exists_and_left, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj,
        exists_eq_right_right', exists_eq', and_true]
      obtain ⟨z, hz, z_unq⟩ := hf.2 x (subAB xA)
      exists z
      and_intros
      · exact xA
      · exact And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hf.1 hz
      · exact hz
      · intro y hy
        apply z_unq
        exact hy.2
  · generalize_proofs f'_A_n
    intro x y z xA yA zn eq
    simp_rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, pair_inj] at eq ⊢
    intro ⟨_, _, _, yz, rfl, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨_, _, xz, rfl, rfl⟩ := eq.2
    exact inj x y z (subAB xA) (subAB yA) zn xz yz

name: IsFinite.insert
statement:
theorem IsFinite.insert {A : ZFSet} (finA : A.IsFinite) (x : ZFSet) :
  (insert x A).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A
  · have : Insert.insert x A = A := by
      ext1 w
      rw [mem_insert_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro (rfl | h) <;> assumption
      · intro; right; assumption
    rwa [this]
  · obtain ⟨n, f, hn, hf, inj⟩ := finA
    let sucn := ZFNat.succ (⟨n, hn⟩:ZFNat)
    exists sucn, f ∪ {x.pair n}, Subtype.property _, ?_
    · rw [mem_funs]
      and_intros
      · intro z hz
        rw [mem_union, mem_singleton] at hz
        rcases hz with hz | rfl
        · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hf |>.1 hz
          simp_rw [mem_prod, mem_insert_iff]
          exists a
          and_intros
          · right; exact ha
          · exists b
            and_intros
            · unfold sucn ZFNat.succ
              rw [mem_insert_iff]
              right
              exact hb
            · rfl
        · rw [pair_mem_prod]
          and_intros
          · exact mem_insert x A
          · unfold sucn ZFNat.succ
            rw [mem_insert_iff]
            left
            rfl
      · intro z hz
        rw [mem_insert_iff] at hz
        rcases hz with rfl | hz
        · exists n
          beta_reduce
          and_intros
          · rw [mem_union, mem_singleton]
            right
            rfl
          · intro z' hz'
            rw [mem_union, mem_singleton] at hz'
            rcases hz' with hz' | hz'
            · nomatch hx <| And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hf |>.1 hz'
            · rw [pair_inj] at hz'
              exact hz'.2
        · obtain ⟨w, hw, w_unq⟩ := mem_funs.mp hf |>.2 z hz
          exists w
          beta_reduce
          and_intros
          · rw [mem_union]
            left
            exact hw
          · intro w' hw'
            rw [mem_union, mem_singleton, pair_inj] at hw'
            rcases hw' with hw' | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
            · exact w_unq w' hw'
            · contradiction
    · intro w y z wA yA zn wz yz
      rw [mem_insert_iff] at wA yA
      unfold sucn ZFNat.succ at zn
      rw [mem_insert_iff] at zn
      simp_rw [mem_union, mem_singleton, pair_inj] at zn wz yz
      rcases wz with wz | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
      rcases yz with yz | ⟨rfl, ⟨⟩⟩
      · exact inj w y z
          (And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hf |>.1 wz)
          (And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hf |>.1 yz)
          (And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hf |>.1 yz) wz yz
      · nomatch mem_irrefl _ (And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hf |>.1 wz)
      · nomatch mem_irrefl _ (And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hf |>.1 yz)
      · rfl

name: IsFinite.disjoint_union
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₁, fA, hn₁, hfA, injA⟩ := finA
  by_cases A_emp : A = ∅
  · subst A
    rwa [empty_union]
  · have n₁_ne_zero : n₁ ≠ ∅ := by
      rintro rfl
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := nonempty_exists_iff.mp A_emp
      obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := mem_funs.mp hfA |>.2 a ha
      nomatch notMem_empty _ <| And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 hb
    obtain ⟨n₂, fB, hn₂, hfB, injB⟩ := finB
    let f' :=
      fA ∪ (B.prod (⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ + ⟨n₂, hn₂⟩ : ZFNat)).sep fun z ↦
        ∃ (x y : ZFSet) (hy : y ∈ Nat), z = x.pair (⟨y, hy⟩ + ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ : ZFNat) ∧ x.pair y ∈ fB
    exists ((⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ : ZFNat) + (⟨n₂, hn₂⟩ : ZFNat)), f', ?_, ?_
    · apply Subtype.property
    · rw [mem_funs]
      and_intros
      · intro z hz
        rcases mem_union.mp hz with hz | hz
        · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 hz
          rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_union]
          and_intros
          · left; exact ha
          · have b_mem_Nat : b ∈ Nat := ZFNat.mem_Nat_of_mem_mem_Nat hn₁ hb
            change (⟨b, b_mem_Nat⟩ : ZFNat) < ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ at hb
            change (⟨b, b_mem_Nat⟩ : ZFNat) < ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ + ⟨n₂, hn₂⟩
            rw [←@ZFNat.add_zero ⟨b, b_mem_Nat⟩]
            exact ZFNat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hb ZFNat.zero_le
        · rw [mem_sep, mem_prod] at hz
          obtain ⟨⟨z₁,hz₁,z₂,hz₂, rfl⟩, _, b, hb, eq, z₁b⟩ := hz
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pair_inj.mp eq
          rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_union]
          and_intros
          · right; exact hz₁
          · exact hz₂
      · intro z hz
        rw [mem_union] at hz
        rcases hz with hz | hz
        · obtain ⟨a, z_a_fA, a_unq⟩ := mem_funs.mp hfA |>.2 z hz
          exists a
          beta_reduce
          and_intros
          · unfold f'
            rw [mem_union]
            left
            exact z_a_fA
          · intro y hy
            rw [mem_union] at hy
            rcases hy with hy | hy
            · exact a_unq y hy
            · simp_rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, pair_inj] at hy
              obtain ⟨⟨hz, hy⟩, _, b, hb, eq, z_b⟩ := hy
              have zB := And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfB |>.1 z_b
              have contr := ZFSet.ext_iff.mp disjoint z
              simp_rw [mem_inter, notMem_empty, iff_false] at contr
              nomatch contr ⟨‹z ∈ A›, hz⟩
        · obtain ⟨a, z_a_fB, a_unq⟩ := mem_funs.mp hfB |>.2 z hz
          have a_Nat : a ∈ Nat :=
            ZFNat.mem_Nat_of_mem_mem_Nat hn₂ <|
              And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfB |>.1 z_a_fB
          exists (⟨a, a_Nat⟩ + ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ : ZFNat)
          beta_reduce
          and_intros
          · unfold f'
            rw [mem_union, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod]
            right
            and_intros
            · exact hz
            · change (⟨a, a_Nat⟩ + ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ : ZFNat) < ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ + ⟨n₂, hn₂⟩
              rw [add_comm, ZFNat.add_lt_add_iff_left]
              exact And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfB |>.1 z_a_fB
            · exists z, a, a_Nat
          · intro y hy
            rw [mem_union] at hy
            rcases hy with hy | hy
            · have zA := And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 hy
              have contr := ZFSet.ext_iff.mp disjoint z
              simp_rw [mem_inter, notMem_empty, iff_false] at contr
              nomatch contr ⟨zA, hz⟩
            · simp only [exists_and_right, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj,
                exists_eq_right_right', exists_and_left] at hy
              obtain ⟨⟨zB, z_lt_n₂⟩, _, w, ⟨rfl, w_Nat, rfl⟩, zw⟩ := hy
              obtain ⟨⟩ := a_unq w zw
              rfl
    · intro x y z xA yA hz xz yz
      have contr := ZFSet.ext_iff.mp disjoint
      simp_rw [mem_inter, notMem_empty, iff_false] at contr
      rw [mem_union] at xA yA
      rcases xA with xA | xB <;>
      rcases yA with yA | yB <;>
      unfold f' at xz yz <;>
      rw [mem_union] at xz yz <;>
      rcases xz with xz | xz <;>
      rcases yz with yz | yz
      · obtain ⟨⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 xz
        obtain ⟨⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 yz
        apply injA <;> assumption
      · simp_rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_and_right, exists_and_left] at yz
        obtain ⟨_, w, ⟨rfl, ⟨w_Nat, rfl⟩⟩, yw⟩ := yz.2
        nomatch contr y ⟨yA, And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfB |>.1 yw⟩
      · simp_rw [mem_sep, pair_mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_and_right, exists_and_left] at xz
        obtain ⟨_, w, ⟨rfl, ⟨w_Nat, rfl⟩⟩, xw⟩ := xz.2
        nomatch contr x ⟨xA, And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfB |>.1 xw⟩
      · simp only [exists_and_right, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj,
          exists_eq_right_right', exists_and_left] at xz
        nomatch contr x ⟨xA, xz.1.1⟩
      · obtain ⟨⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 xz
        obtain ⟨⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 yz
        apply injA <;> assumption
      · simp only [exists_and_right, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj,
          exists_eq_right_right', exists_and_left] at yz
        obtain ⟨⟨-, w_lt_n₂⟩, ⟨_, v, ⟨rfl, v_Nat, rfl⟩, yv⟩⟩ := yz
        have v_add_n₁_lt_n₁ := And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 xz
        change (⟨v, v_Nat⟩ + ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ : ZFNat) < ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ at v_add_n₁_lt_n₁
        conv at v_add_n₁_lt_n₁ =>
          rhs
          rw [←@ZFNat.zero_add ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩]
        rw [ZFNat.add_lt_add_iff_right] at v_add_n₁_lt_n₁
        nomatch ZFNat.not_lt_zero v_add_n₁_lt_n₁
      · nomatch contr y ⟨And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 yz, yB⟩
      · simp only [exists_and_right, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj,
          exists_eq_right_right', exists_and_left] at xz
        nomatch contr x ⟨xA, xz.1.1⟩
      · obtain ⟨⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 xz
        obtain ⟨⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 yz
        apply injA <;> assumption
      · obtain ⟨zA, -⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 xz
        nomatch contr x ⟨And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 xz, xB⟩
      · simp only [exists_and_right, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj,
          exists_eq_right_right', exists_and_left] at xz
        obtain ⟨⟨-, w_lt_n₂⟩, ⟨_, v, ⟨rfl, v_Nat, rfl⟩, yv⟩⟩ := xz
        have v_add_n₁_lt_n₁ := And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 yz
        change (⟨v, v_Nat⟩ + ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ : ZFNat) < ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ at v_add_n₁_lt_n₁
        conv at v_add_n₁_lt_n₁ =>
          rhs
          rw [←@ZFNat.zero_add ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩]
        rw [ZFNat.add_lt_add_iff_right] at v_add_n₁_lt_n₁
        nomatch ZFNat.not_lt_zero v_add_n₁_lt_n₁
      · simp only [exists_and_right, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj,
          exists_eq_right_right', exists_and_left] at yz
        nomatch contr y ⟨yA, yz.1.1⟩
      · obtain ⟨⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 xz
        obtain ⟨⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 yz
        apply injA <;> assumption
      · obtain ⟨xA, -⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 xz
        nomatch contr x ⟨xA, xB⟩
      · obtain ⟨yA, -⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfA |>.1 yz
        nomatch contr y ⟨yA, yB⟩
      · simp only [exists_and_right, mem_sep, mem_prod, pair_inj,
          exists_eq_right_right', exists_and_left] at xz yz
        obtain ⟨⟨-, w_lt_n₂⟩, ⟨_, w, ⟨rfl, w_Nat, rfl⟩, xw⟩⟩ := xz
        obtain ⟨⟨_, w_lt_n₁⟩, ⟨_, v, ⟨rfl, v_Nat, eq⟩, yv⟩⟩ := yz
        rw [←Subtype.ext_iff, ZFNat.add_right_cancel] at eq
        injection eq
        subst w
        exact injB x y v xB yB (And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| mem_funs.mp hfB |>.1 xw) xw yv

name: IsFinite.union
statement:
theorem IsFinite.union {A B : ZFSet} (finA : A.IsFinite) (finB : B.IsFinite) :
  (A ∪ B).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  have : A ∪ B = (A \ B) ∪ B := by
    ext1 z
    simp_rw [mem_union, mem_sdiff]
    constructor
    · rintro (hA | hB)
      · by_cases hB : z ∈ B
        · right; exact hB
        · left; exact ⟨hA, hB⟩
      · right; exact hB
    · rintro (⟨hA, -⟩ | hB)
      · left; exact hA
      · right; exact hB
  rw [this]
  have : (A \ B) ∩ B = ∅ := by
    ext1 z
    rw [mem_inter, mem_sdiff, and_assoc]
    simp only [not_and_self, and_false, notMem_empty]
  apply IsFinite.disjoint_union (IsFinite.subset finA ?_) finB this
  intro z hz
  rw [mem_sdiff] at hz
  exact hz.1

name: IsFinite.inter
statement:
theorem IsFinite.inter {A B : ZFSet} (fin : A.IsFinite ∨ B.IsFinite) :
  (A ∩ B).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  wlog fin : A.IsFinite
  · replace fin := Or.resolve_left ‹_ ∨ _› fin
    rw [inter_comm]
    exact this (Or.inl fin) fin
  · apply IsFinite.subset fin
    · intro z hz
      rw [mem_inter] at hz
      exact hz.1

name: IsFinite.diff
statement:
theorem IsFinite.diff {A B : ZFSet} (finA : A.IsFinite) :
  (A \ B).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFinite.subset finA
  intro z hz
  rw [mem_sdiff] at hz
  exact hz.1

name: ZFFinSet.inductionOn
statement:
@[induction_eliminator]
theorem ZFFinSet.inductionOn {P : ZFFinSet → Prop}
  (empty : P ⟨∅, IsFinite.empty⟩)
  (insert : ∀ (S : ZFFinSet) (x : ZFSet), P S → x ∉ S.val → P ⟨insert x S, S.property.insert x⟩) :
  ∀ (S : ZFFinSet), P S
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨S, finS⟩
  obtain ⟨n , fS , hn, hfS, fS_inj⟩ := finS
  generalize_proofs finS
  generalize_proofs fS_is_func at fS_inj
  revert S fS
  apply ZFNat.ind n hn
  · intro S fS h _ _ _
    rw [mem_funs, IsFunc, prod_empty_right] at h
    obtain ⟨⟩ := subset_of_empty h.1
    have : S = ∅ := by
      simp only [subset_refl, notMem_empty, existsUnique_false, imp_false, true_and] at h
      exact (eq_empty S).mpr h
    subst S
    exact empty
  · intro n hn IH S fS _ S_fin fS_fun fS_inj
    by_cases n_range : n ∈ fS.Range
    · rw [Range, mem_sep, mem_insert_iff, eq_self, true_or, true_and,] at n_range
      obtain ⟨a, a_dom, an⟩ := n_range
      let S' := S \ {a}
      let fS' := fS \ {a.pair n}
      have S'_fin : S'.IsFinite := IsFinite.diff S_fin
      have S'_is_func : S'.IsFunc n fS' := by
        and_intros
        · intro z hz
          unfold fS' at hz
          rw [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton] at hz
          obtain ⟨x, xS, y, yS, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| fS_fun.1 hz.1
          rw [pair_inj] at hz
          rw [pair_mem_prod]
          rw [mem_insert_iff] at yS
          rcases yS with rfl | yS
          · obtain ⟨⟩ :=
              fS_inj a x y (And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| fS_fun.1 an) xS (mem_insert y y) an hz.1
            nomatch hz.2 (pair_inj.mp rfl)
          · and_intros
            · unfold S'
              rw [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton]
              and_intros
              · exact xS
              · rintro rfl
                rw [not_and, eq_self, true_implies] at hz
                obtain ⟨fS_x, hfS_x, fS_x_unq⟩ := fS_fun.2 x xS
                obtain ⟨⟩ := fS_x_unq y hz.1
                obtain ⟨⟩ := fS_x_unq n an
                nomatch mem_irrefl _ yS
            · exact yS
        · intro z zS
          rw [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton] at zS
          obtain ⟨w, hw, w_unq⟩ := fS_fun.2 z zS.1
          exists w
          and_intros
          · unfold fS'
            beta_reduce
            rw [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton, pair_inj]
            and_intros
            · exact hw
            · rw [not_and_or]
              left
              exact zS.2
          · intro w' hw'
            unfold fS' at hw'
            rw [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton, pair_inj] at hw'
            exact w_unq w' hw'.left
      have : fS'.IsInjective := by
        intro x y z xS' yS' zn xy yz
        apply fS_inj x y z
        · exact mem_sdiff.mp xS' |>.1
        · exact mem_sdiff.mp yS' |>.1
        · exact mem_insert_of_mem n zn
        all_goals
          unfold fS' at xy
          rw [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton] at xy yz
        · exact xy.1
        · exact yz.1
      specialize IH S' fS' (mem_funs.mpr S'_is_func) S'_fin S'_is_func this
      have : S = Insert.insert a S' := by classical
        unfold S'
        ext1 z
        simp_rw [mem_insert_iff, mem_sdiff, mem_singleton, or_and_left, Classical.em, and_true]
        constructor
        · exact Or.inr
        · rintro (rfl | hz)
          · exact And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| fS_fun |>.1 an
          · exact hz
      specialize insert _ a IH (by
        unfold S'
        rw [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton, not_and_or, not_not]
        right; rfl)
      conv at insert =>
        enter [1,1]
        rw [←this]
      exact insert
    · have : S.IsFunc n fS := by
        and_intros
        · intro z hz
          obtain ⟨a, aS, b, bS, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| fS_fun.1 hz
          rw [mem_insert_iff] at bS
          rw [pair_mem_prod]
          apply And.intro aS
          rcases bS with rfl | bS
          · unfold Range at n_range
            simp_rw [mem_sep, mem_insert_iff, true_or, true_and, not_exists, not_and] at n_range
            nomatch n_range a aS hz
          · exact bS
        · exact fS_fun.2
      apply IH S fS (mem_funs.mpr this) S_fin this
      intro x y z xS yS zn xy yz
      apply fS_inj x y z xS yS
      · rw [mem_insert_iff]
        right
        exact zn
      · exact xy
      · exact yz

name: IsFinite.singleton
statement: theorem IsFinite.singleton {x : ZFSet} : ({x} : ZFSet).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  exists (1:ZFNat), {x.pair (0:ZFNat)}, ?_, ?_
  · exact SetLike.coe_mem 1
  · rw [mem_funs]
    and_intros
    · intro z hz
      rw [mem_singleton] at hz
      obtain ⟨⟩ := hz
      rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton, eq_self, true_and]
      exact singleton_subset_mem_iff.mp fun _ => id
    · intro z
      simp only [mem_singleton, pair_inj]
      rintro rfl
      simp only [true_and, existsUnique_eq]
  · intro x y z
    simp only [mem_singleton, pair_inj, and_imp]
    intros
    subst_eqs
    rfl

name: IsFinite.prod_singleton
statement:
theorem IsFinite.prod_singleton {A x : ZFSet} (finA : A.IsFinite) :
  (A.prod {x}).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  induction hA : (⟨A, finA⟩ : ZFFinSet) using ZFFinSet.inductionOn generalizing A finA x with
  | empty =>
    injections
    subst_vars
    rwa [prod_empty_left]
  | insert E e ih he =>
    injections
    subst_vars
    rw [insert_prod]
    apply IsFinite.union
    · apply ih
      rfl
    · have : ({e} : ZFSet).prod {x} = {e.pair x} := by
        ext1 z
        simp only [mem_prod, mem_singleton, exists_eq_left]
      rw [this]
      apply IsFinite.singleton

name: IsFinite.singleton_prod
statement:
theorem IsFinite.singleton_prod {A x : ZFSet} (finA : A.IsFinite) :
  (({x} : ZFSet).prod A).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  induction hA : (⟨A, finA⟩ : ZFFinSet) using ZFFinSet.inductionOn generalizing A finA x with
  | empty =>
    injections
    subst_vars
    rwa [prod_empty_right]
  | insert E e ih he =>
    injections
    subst_vars
    rw [prod_insert]
    apply IsFinite.union
    · apply ih
      rfl
    · have : ({x} : ZFSet).prod {e} = {x.pair e} := by
        ext1 z
        simp only [mem_prod, mem_singleton, exists_eq_left]
      rw [this]
      apply IsFinite.singleton

name: IsFinite.prod
statement:
theorem IsFinite.prod {A B : ZFSet} (finA : A.IsFinite) (finB : B.IsFinite) :
  (A.prod B).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  induction hA : (⟨A, finA⟩ : ZFFinSet) using ZFFinSet.inductionOn generalizing A finA with
  | empty =>
    injections
    subst_vars
    rwa [prod_empty_left]
  | insert S x ih x_not_mem_S =>
    injections
    subst_vars
    rw [insert_prod]
    apply IsFinite.union
    · apply ih
      rfl
    · exact singleton_prod finB

name: IsFinite.sep
statement: theorem IsFinite.sep {A : ZFSet} (finA : A.IsFinite) (P : ZFSet → Prop) : (A.sep P).IsFinite
proof:
:=
  subset finA sep_subset_self

name: ZFNat.every_nat_isfinite
statement: theorem ZFNat.every_nat_isfinite (n : ZFNat) : n.val.IsFinite
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, 𝟙n, n.property, mem_funs.mpr <| Id.IsFunc, Id.IsBijective.1⟩
