name: IsFinite.exists_bij
statement:
theorem IsFinite.exists_bij {A : ZFSet} (finA : A.IsFinite) :
  ∃ (n : ZFSet) (f : ZFSet) (_ : n ∈ Nat) (hf : f ∈ A.funs n), f.IsBijective (mem_funs.mp hf)
proof:
:= by
  induction hA : (⟨A, finA⟩ : ZFFinSet) using ZFFinSet.inductionOn generalizing A finA with
  | empty =>
    injections
    subst_vars
    exists (0 : ZFNat), ∅, ?_, ?_
    · exact SetLike.coe_mem 0
    · simp_rw [mem_funs, IsFunc, prod_empty_left, subset_refl, notMem_empty,
        existsUnique_false, imp_self, implies_true, and_self]
    · and_intros
      · intro _ _ _ h
        nomatch notMem_empty _ h
      · intro _ h
        nomatch notMem_empty _ h
  | insert S x ih x_not_mem_S =>
    injections
    subst_vars
    obtain ⟨n, f, hn, hf, bij⟩ :=
      ih (IsFinite.subset (A := S) finA (fun _ ↦ mem_insert_of_mem x)) rfl
    exists (ZFNat.succ ⟨n, hn⟩), f ∪ {x.pair n}, ?_, ?_
    · exact SetLike.coe_mem (ZFNat.succ ⟨n, hn⟩)
    · rw [mem_funs]
      and_intros
      · intro z hz
        rw [mem_union, mem_singleton] at hz
        rcases hz with hz | rfl
        · obtain ⟨a, aS, b, bS, rfl⟩ := mem_prod.mp <| (mem_funs.mp hf).1 hz
          simp only [mem_prod, mem_insert_iff, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right']
          obtain ⟨aS, bn⟩ := pair_mem_prod.mp <| (mem_funs.mp hf).1 hz
          and_intros
          · right
            exact aS
          · change ⟨b, ZFNat.mem_Nat_of_mem_mem_Nat hn bS⟩ < ZFNat.succ ⟨n, hn⟩
            trans ⟨n, hn⟩
            · exact bn
            · exact ZFNat.lt_succ
        · rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_insert_iff]
          and_intros
          · left
            rfl
          · exact ZFNat.lt_succ
      · simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_union, mem_singleton, pair_inj, forall_eq_or_imp, true_and]
        and_intros
        · exists n
          and_intros
          · right; rfl
          · intro w hw
            rcases hw with hw | rfl
            · nomatch x_not_mem_S (And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| (mem_funs.mp hf).1 hw)
            · rfl
        · intro a aS
          obtain ⟨w, wS, w_unq⟩ := (mem_funs.mp hf).2 a aS
          exists w
          and_intros
          · left; exact wS
          · intro w' hw'
            rcases hw' with hw' | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
            · obtain ⟨⟩ := w_unq w' hw'
              rfl
            · contradiction
    · rw [bijective_exists1_iff] at bij ⊢
      intro y hy
      have y_Nat := ZFNat.mem_Nat_of_mem_mem_Nat (SetLike.coe_mem (ZFNat.succ ⟨n, hn⟩)) hy
      change (⟨y, y_Nat⟩ : ZFNat) < ZFNat.succ ⟨n, hn⟩ at hy
      rw [← ZFNat.lt_le_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · obtain ⟨x, ⟨xS, xy⟩, x_unq⟩ := bij y hy
        exists x
        and_intros
        · rw [mem_insert_iff]
          right; exact xS
        · rw [mem_union, mem_singleton]
          left; exact xy
        · intro x' hx'
          rw [mem_insert_iff, mem_union, mem_singleton, pair_inj] at hx'
          rcases hx' with ⟨rfl|_, _|⟨_,rfl⟩⟩
          · nomatch x_not_mem_S <| And.left <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| (mem_funs.mp hf).1 ‹_ ∈ f›
          · nomatch mem_irrefl _ <| And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| (mem_funs.mp hf).1 ‹_ ∈ f›
          · obtain ⟨⟩ := x_unq x' ⟨‹_›, ‹_›⟩
            rfl
          · subst_vars
            contradiction
      · injection hy
        subst y
        exists x
        and_intros
        · rw [mem_insert_iff]
          left; rfl
        · rw [mem_union, mem_singleton]
          right; rfl
        · intro y hy
          simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_union, mem_singleton, pair_inj, and_true] at hy
          rcases hy with ⟨rfl|_, _|_⟩
          · rfl
          · rfl
          · nomatch mem_irrefl _ <| And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| (mem_funs.mp hf).1 ‹_ ∈ f›
          · assumption

name: Card.empty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Card.empty_iff {S : ZFFinSet} : Card S = 0 ↔ S = ⟨∅, IsFinite.empty⟩
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Card] at h
    split_ifs at h with Semp
    · exact Subtype.ext Semp
    · replace Semp : S.val ≠ ∅ := Semp
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (@nonempty_exists_iff S).mp Semp
      extract_lets ex_bij at h
      let n := Classical.choose ex_bij
      obtain ⟨f, hn, hf, bij⟩ := Classical.choose_spec ex_bij
      refold_let n at *
      have : n = ∅ := by
        rwa [ZFNat.nat_zero_eq, ←Subtype.val_inj] at h
      rw [this, mem_funs, IsFunc] at hf
      obtain ⟨w, hw, w_unq⟩ := hf.2 s hs
      nomatch notMem_empty _ <| And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hf.1 hw
  · rintro ⟨⟩
    rw [Card, eq_self, if_true]

name: Card.empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Card.empty : Card ⟨∅, IsFinite.empty⟩ = 0
proof: := empty_iff.mpr rfl

name: Card.singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Card.singleton (x : ZFSet) : Card ⟨{x}, IsFinite.singleton⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Card]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp_rw [eq_empty, mem_singleton] at h
    nomatch h x
  · extract_lets ex_bij
    let n := Classical.choose ex_bij
    generalize_proofs _ hn
    obtain ⟨f, hn, hf, bij⟩ := Classical.choose_spec ex_bij
    refold_let n at *
    have : (⟨n, hn⟩ : ZFNat) = 1 := by
      simp_rw [mem_funs, IsFunc, mem_singleton, forall_eq] at hf
      obtain ⟨k, hk, k_unq⟩ := hf.2
      have := And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hf.1 hk
      induction ind_n : (⟨n, hn⟩ : ZFNat) using ZFNat.induction generalizing n hn with
      | zero =>
        injection ind_n with eq
        rw [eq] at this
        nomatch notMem_empty _ this
      | succ m IH =>
        injection ind_n with eq
        rw [eq, mem_insert_iff] at this
        rcases this with rfl | this
        · rw [←@ZFNat.zero_add 1, ←ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ,
            ZFNat.add_right_cancel, ZFNat.nat_zero_eq, Subtype.ext_iff]
          dsimp
          symm
          apply k_unq
          obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := bij.2 ∅ <| eq ▸ ZFNat.zero_lt_succ
          obtain ⟨⟩ := mem_singleton.mp hx'.1
          exact hx'.2
        · obtain ⟨w, hw, xm⟩ := bij.2 m (eq ▸ mem_insert m m)
          obtain ⟨⟩ := mem_singleton.mp hw
          rw [k_unq m xm] at this
          nomatch mem_irrefl _ this
    exact this

name: ZFNat.succ_val
statement: theorem ZFNat.succ_val (n : ZFNat) : (ZFNat.succ n).val = insert n.val n.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := n
  rfl

name: Card.spec
statement:
theorem Card.spec (S : ZFFinSet) :
    ∃ f, ∃ hf : f ∈ S.val.funs (Card S).val, f.IsBijective (mem_funs.mp hf)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, Sfin⟩ := S
  rw [Card]
  split_ifs with hS
  · subst hS
    exact ⟨𝟙(∅ : ZFSet), mem_funs_of_is_func Id.IsFunc, Id.IsBijective⟩
  · extract_lets ex_bij
    obtain ⟨f, hn, hf, bij⟩ := Classical.choose_spec ex_bij
    exact ⟨f, hf, bij⟩

name: ZFNat.eq_of_bijective
statement:
theorem ZFNat.eq_of_bijective (m : ZFNat) : ∀ (n : ZFNat) (f : ZFSet)
    (hf : f ∈ ZFSet.funs m.val n.val), f.IsBijective (mem_funs.mp hf) → m = n
proof:
:= by
  induction m using ZFNat.induction with
  | zero =>
    intro n f hf bij
    have : n.val = ∅ := by
      rw [eq_empty]
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := bij.2 y hy
      exact notMem_empty x hx
    exact Subtype.ext this.symm
  | succ m IH =>
    intro n f hf bij
    have hfunc := mem_funs.mp hf
    have hMtop : m.val ∈ (ZFNat.succ m).val := by
      rw [ZFNat.succ_val]; exact mem_insert _ _
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hfunc.2 m.val hMtop
      exact notMem_empty y (pair_mem_prod.mp (hfunc.1 hy)).2
    obtain ⟨n', rfl⟩ : ∃ n', n = ZFNat.succ n' :=
      (ZFNat.cases (P := fun k => k = 0 ∨ ∃ n', k = ZFNat.succ n') n (Or.inl rfl)
        fun n' => Or.inr ⟨n', rfl⟩).resolve_left hn0
    have hNtop : n'.val ∈ (ZFNat.succ n').val := by
      rw [ZFNat.succ_val]; exact mem_insert _ _
    have hxs : ∀ {x : ZFSet}, x ∈ m.val → x ∈ (ZFNat.succ m).val := fun hx => by
      rw [ZFNat.succ_val]; exact mem_insert_iff.mpr (Or.inr hx)
    have hsN : ∀ {z : ZFSet}, z ∈ n'.val → z ∈ (ZFNat.succ n').val := fun hz => by
      rw [ZFNat.succ_val]; exact mem_insert_iff.mpr (Or.inr hz)
    have hran : ∀ {x y : ZFSet}, x.pair y ∈ f → y ∈ insert n'.val n'.val := fun h => by
      have := (pair_mem_prod.mp (hfunc.1 h)).2
      rwa [ZFNat.succ_val] at this
    set g : ZFSet := (m.val.prod n'.val).sep (fun p => ∃ x y : ZFSet, p = x.pair y ∧
      ((x.pair y ∈ f ∧ y ≠ n'.val) ∨ (x.pair n'.val ∈ f ∧ m.val.pair y ∈ f))) with hg_def
    have mem_g : ∀ {x y : ZFSet}, x.pair y ∈ g ↔ (x ∈ m.val ∧ y ∈ n'.val) ∧
        ((x.pair y ∈ f ∧ y ≠ n'.val) ∨ (x.pair n'.val ∈ f ∧ m.val.pair y ∈ f)) := by
      intro x y
      rw [hg_def, mem_sep, pair_mem_prod]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hp, a, b, heq, hcase⟩
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pair_inj.mp heq
        exact ⟨hp, hcase⟩
      · rintro ⟨hp, hcase⟩
        exact ⟨hp, x, y, rfl, hcase⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw, w_unq⟩ := hfunc.2 m.val hMtop
    have g_func : IsFunc m.val n'.val g := by
      constructor
      · rw [hg_def]; exact sep_subset
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨y, hy, y_unq⟩ := hfunc.2 x (hxs hx)
        by_cases hyN : y = n'.val
        · subst hyN
          have hwN : w ≠ n'.val := by
            intro hwN
            subst hwN
            have : m.val = x := bij.1 m.val x n'.val hMtop (hxs hx) hNtop hw hy
            exact mem_irrefl x (this ▸ hx)
          have hwn' : w ∈ n'.val := by
            have := hran hw
            rw [mem_insert_iff] at this
            exact this.resolve_left hwN
          refine ⟨w, mem_g.mpr ⟨⟨hx, hwn'⟩, Or.inr ⟨hy, hw⟩⟩, ?_⟩
          rintro y' hy'
          obtain ⟨-, hcase⟩ := mem_g.mp hy'
          rcases hcase with ⟨hy', hne⟩ | ⟨-, hMy'⟩
          · exact absurd (y_unq y' hy') hne
          · exact w_unq y' hMy'
        · have hyn' : y ∈ n'.val := by
            have := hran hy
            rw [mem_insert_iff] at this
            exact this.resolve_left hyN
          refine ⟨y, mem_g.mpr ⟨⟨hx, hyn'⟩, Or.inl ⟨hy, hyN⟩⟩, ?_⟩
          rintro y' hy'
          obtain ⟨-, hcase⟩ := mem_g.mp hy'
          rcases hcase with ⟨hy', -⟩ | ⟨hxN, -⟩
          · exact y_unq y' hy'
          · exact absurd (y_unq n'.val hxN).symm hyN
    have g_bij : g.IsBijective g_func := by
      constructor
      · intro x y z hx hy hz hxz hyz
        obtain ⟨-, hcx⟩ := mem_g.mp hxz
        obtain ⟨-, hcy⟩ := mem_g.mp hyz
        rcases hcx with ⟨hxz', hzN⟩ | ⟨hxN, hMz⟩ <;>
          rcases hcy with ⟨hyz', hzN'⟩ | ⟨hyN, hMz'⟩
        · exact bij.1 x y z (hxs hx) (hxs hy) (hsN hz) hxz' hyz'
        · exfalso
          have : x = m.val := bij.1 x m.val z (hxs hx) hMtop (hsN hz) hxz' hMz'
          exact mem_irrefl m.val (this ▸ hx)
        · exfalso
          have : y = m.val := bij.1 y m.val z (hxs hy) hMtop (hsN hz) hyz' hMz
          exact mem_irrefl m.val (this ▸ hy)
        · exact bij.1 x y n'.val (hxs hx) (hxs hy) hNtop hxN hyN
      · intro y hy
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := bij.2 y (hsN hy)
        rw [ZFNat.succ_val, mem_insert_iff] at hx
        rcases hx with rfl | hx
        · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀N⟩ := bij.2 n'.val hNtop
          rw [ZFNat.succ_val, mem_insert_iff] at hx₀
          rcases hx₀ with rfl | hx₀
          · exfalso
            have h1 := w_unq y hxy
            have h2 := w_unq n'.val hx₀N
            exact mem_irrefl n'.val ((h1.trans h2.symm) ▸ hy)
          · exact ⟨x₀, hx₀, mem_g.mpr ⟨⟨hx₀, hy⟩, Or.inr ⟨hx₀N, hxy⟩⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨x, hx, mem_g.mpr ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩,
            Or.inl ⟨hxy, fun h => mem_irrefl n'.val (h ▸ hy)⟩⟩⟩
    exact congrArg ZFNat.succ (IH n' g (mem_funs_of_is_func g_func) g_bij)

name: Card.uniq
statement:
theorem Card.uniq (S : ZFFinSet) {n : ZFNat} {f : ZFSet}
    (hf : f ∈ S.val.funs n.val) (bij : f.IsBijective (mem_funs.mp hf)) : Card S = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, gbij⟩ := Card.spec S
  have hg' : IsFunc S.val (Card S).val g := mem_funs.mp hg
  have hf' : IsFunc S.val n.val f := mem_funs.mp hf
  have hinv : IsFunc (Card S).val S.val (g.inv hg'.1) := inv_is_func_of_bijective gbij
  have hcomp : IsFunc (Card S).val n.val (fcomp f (g.inv hg'.1) hf' hinv) :=
    IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hf' hinv
  exact ZFNat.eq_of_bijective (Card S) n _ (mem_funs_of_is_func hcomp)
    (IsBijective.composition_of_bijective (hf := hinv) (hg := hf')
      (inv_bijective_of_bijective gbij) bij)

name: image_of_lambda_subset_range
statement:
theorem image_of_lambda_subset_range {A B φ : ZFSet} {hφ : A.IsFunc B φ} {S : ZFSet} :
  φ[S] ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [mem_Image] at hy
  obtain ⟨hy, x, hx, φxy⟩ := hy
  exact hφ.1 φxy |> pair_mem_prod.mp |>.2

name: fprod_is_func
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem fprod_is_func {A B A' B' φ ψ : ZFSet} (hφ : A.IsFunc A' φ) (hψ : B.IsFunc B' ψ) :
  (A.prod B).IsFunc (A'.prod B') (fprod φ ψ)
proof:
:= by
  and_intros
  · intro z hz
    simp only [fprod, mem_prod, mem_lambda, existsAndEq, and_true] at hz
    obtain ⟨a', b', a, b, rfl, ⟨aA, bB⟩, ⟨a'A', b'B'⟩, eq⟩ := hz
    rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨aA, bB⟩)), pair_inj] at eq
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq
    let φa : ZFSet := @ᶻφ ⟨a, by zdom⟩
    let ψb : ZFSet := @ᶻψ ⟨b, by zdom⟩
    simp only [mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right', π₁_pair, π₂_pair]
    and_intros
    · exact aA
    · exact bB
    · apply fapply_mem_range
    · apply fapply_mem_range
  · intro z hz
    rw [mem_prod] at hz
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hz
    let φa : ZFSet := @ᶻφ ⟨a, by zdom⟩
    let ψb : ZFSet := @ᶻψ ⟨b, by zdom⟩
    use φa.pair ψb
    and_intros <;> beta_reduce
    · simp_rw [fprod, lambda_spec, pair_mem_prod]
      rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩)), pair_inj]
      and_intros
      · exact ha
      · exact hb
      · apply fapply_mem_range
      · apply fapply_mem_range
      · simp only [π₁_pair]
        rfl
      · simp only [π₂_pair]
        rfl
    · intro y hy
      simp_rw [fprod, lambda_spec, pair_mem_prod, π₁_pair, π₂_pair] at hy
      rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩))] at hy
      exact hy.2.2

name: fprod_bijective_of_bijective
proof:
:= by
  and_intros
  · intro x y z hx hy hz xy yz
    simp only [fprod, mem_prod, mem_lambda, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true,
      exists_eq_left'] at xy yz
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩, -, rfl⟩ := xy
    obtain ⟨⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩, -, eq⟩ := yz
    rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩)),
        dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨hc, hd⟩)), pair_inj] at eq
    simp only [π₁_pair, SetLike.coe_eq_coe, π₂_pair] at eq
    obtain ⟨φa_eq_φc, ψb_eq_ψd⟩ := eq
    rw [pair_inj]
    and_intros
    · obtain ⟨⟩ := IsInjective.apply_inj hφ φ_bij.1 φa_eq_φc
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨⟩ := IsInjective.apply_inj hψ ψ_bij.1 ψb_eq_ψd
      rfl
  · intro y hy
    rw [mem_prod] at hy
    obtain ⟨a', ha', b', hb', rfl⟩ := hy
    let φ_inv_a' : ZFSet := fapply φ⁻¹ (is_func_is_pfunc <| inv_is_func_of_bijective φ_bij)
      ⟨a', by zdom⟩
    let ψ_inv_b' : ZFSet := fapply ψ⁻¹ (is_func_is_pfunc <| inv_is_func_of_bijective ψ_bij)
      ⟨b', by zdom⟩
    use φ_inv_a'.pair ψ_inv_b'
    and_intros
    · rw [pair_mem_prod]
      and_intros
      · apply fapply_mem_range
      · apply fapply_mem_range
    · simp only [fprod, mem_prod, lambda_spec, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right', π₁_pair, π₂_pair]
      and_intros
      · apply fapply_mem_range
      · apply fapply_mem_range
      · exact ha'
      · exact hb'
      · rw [dite_cond_eq_true
          (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; and_intros <;> apply fapply_mem_range)),
          pair_inj]
        and_intros
        · rw [←fapply_composition hφ (inv_is_func_of_bijective φ_bij) ha',
            fapply_eq_Image_singleton
              (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hφ (inv_is_func_of_bijective φ_bij)) ha']
          conv =>
            enter [2, 1, 1]
            change φ ∘ᶻ φ⁻¹
            rw [composition_inv_self_of_bijective φ_bij]
          rw [←fapply_eq_Image_singleton Id.IsFunc ha', fapply_Id ha']
        · rw [←fapply_composition hψ (inv_is_func_of_bijective ψ_bij) hb',
            fapply_eq_Image_singleton
              (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hψ (inv_is_func_of_bijective ψ_bij)) hb']
          conv =>
            enter [2, 1, 1]
            change ψ ∘ᶻ ψ⁻¹
            rw [composition_inv_self_of_bijective ψ_bij]
          rw [←fapply_eq_Image_singleton Id.IsFunc hb', fapply_Id hb']

name: mem_fprod
statement:
theorem mem_fprod {A B C D f g x : ZFSet} {hf : A.IsFunc C f} {hg : B.IsFunc D g} :
  x ∈ fprod f g ↔ ∃ (a b : ZFSet) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B),
    let fa : ZFSet
proof:
:= @ᶻf ⟨a, by zdom⟩
    let gb : ZFSet := @ᶻg ⟨b, by zdom⟩
    x = (a.pair b).pair (fa.pair gb) where
  mp := by
    intro hx
    rw [fprod, mem_lambda] at hx
    obtain ⟨ab, cd, rfl, hab, hcd, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hab)] at hcd
    rw [mem_prod] at hab
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hab
    rw [pair_mem_prod] at hab
    simp only [mem_prod, pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right', π₁_pair, π₂_pair,
      exists_and_left, existsAndEq, and_true, exists_eq_left']
    rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true ‹_›)]
    simp only [exists_prop, and_true, ha, hb]
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩
    simp only [fprod, mem_prod, mem_lambda, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true,
      exists_eq_right_right', SetLike.coe_mem, true_and, exists_eq_right', exists_eq_left', π₁_pair,
      π₂_pair, left_eq_dite_iff, not_and]
    and_intros
    · exact ha
    · exact hb
    · intro c
      nomatch c ha hb

name: pair_mem_fprod
statement:
theorem pair_mem_fprod {A B C D f g x y : ZFSet} {hf : A.IsFunc C f} {hg : B.IsFunc D g} :
  x.pair y ∈ fprod f g ↔ ∃ (a b : ZFSet) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B),
    let fa : ZFSet
proof:
:= @ᶻf ⟨a, by zdom⟩
    let gb : ZFSet := @ᶻg ⟨b, by zdom⟩
    x = a.pair b ∧ y = fa.pair gb := by
  rw [mem_fprod]
  simp only [pair_inj, exists_and_left]

name: fapply_fprod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fapply_fprod {A B C D f g a b : ZFSet} (hf : A.IsFunc C f) (hg : B.IsFunc D g)
  (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) :
    @ᶻ(fprod f g)
      ⟨a.pair b, by zdom⟩ =
    let fa : ZFSet
proof:
:= @ᶻf ⟨a, by zdom⟩
    let gb : ZFSet := @ᶻg ⟨b, by zdom⟩
    fa.pair gb := by
  conv =>
    enter [1]
    rw [fapply_eq_Image_singleton (fprod_is_func hf hg) (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩)]
    dsimp [fprod]
    rw [
      ←fapply_eq_Image_singleton
        (lambda_isFunc
          (fun h ↦ by
            rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true h), pair_mem_prod]
            and_intros <;> apply fapply_mem_range))
        (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩),
      fapply_lambda (fun h ↦ by
        rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true h), pair_mem_prod]
        and_intros <;> apply fapply_mem_range)
        (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩),
      dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩))]
    simp only [π₁_pair, π₂_pair]

name: composition_fprod_Image_bijective
proof:
:= fprod φ ψ
    have φ_ψ_bij : φ_ψ.IsBijective := fprod_bijective_of_bijective φ_bij ψ_bij
    let Φ : ZFSet := λᶻ : (A.prod B).powerset → (A'.prod B').powerset
                        |                   S ↦ φ_ψ[S]
    ∃ (hΦ : (A.prod B).powerset.IsFunc (A'.prod B').powerset Φ), IsBijective Φ hΦ := by
  extract_lets φ_ψ hφ_ψ φ_ψ_bij
  use ?_
  · and_intros
    · intro x y z hx hy hz x_z y_z
      rw [mem_lambda] at x_z y_z
      simp only [pair_inj, mem_powerset, existsAndEq, and_true, exists_eq_left'] at x_z y_z
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := x_z
      obtain ⟨_, _, eq⟩ := y_z
      rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at eq
      simp only [mem_Image, mem_prod, and_congr_right_iff, forall_exists_index, and_imp] at eq
      ext1 z
      constructor <;> intro hz
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := ‹x ⊆ A.prod B› hz |> mem_prod.mp
        let φa : ZFSet := @ᶻφ ⟨a, by zdom⟩
        let ψb : ZFSet := @ᶻψ ⟨b, by zdom⟩
        specialize eq (φa.pair ψb) φa (fapply_mem_range _ _) ψb (fapply_mem_range _ _) rfl
        have := eq.mp ⟨a.pair b, hz, ?_⟩
        · obtain ⟨p, hp, p_def⟩ := this
          simp_rw [φ_ψ, pair_mem_fprod, pair_inj] at p_def
          obtain ⟨a', b', ha', hb', rfl, φa_φa', ψb_ψb'⟩ := p_def
          rw [←Subtype.ext_iff] at φa_φa' ψb_ψb'
          obtain ⟨⟩ := IsInjective.apply_inj hφ φ_bij.1 φa_φa'
          obtain ⟨⟩ := IsInjective.apply_inj hψ ψ_bij.1 ψb_ψb'
          exact hp
        · simp_rw [φ_ψ, pair_mem_fprod, pair_inj]
          simp only [exists_and_left, exists_and_right, existsAndEq, and_true, exists_eq_left']
          and_intros
          · use ha
          · use hb
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := ‹y ⊆ A.prod B› hz |> mem_prod.mp
        let φa : ZFSet := @ᶻφ ⟨a, by zdom⟩
        let ψb : ZFSet := @ᶻψ ⟨b, by zdom⟩
        specialize eq (φa.pair ψb) φa (fapply_mem_range _ _) ψb (fapply_mem_range _ _) rfl
        have := eq.mpr ⟨a.pair b, hz, ?_⟩
        · obtain ⟨p, hp, p_def⟩ := this
          simp_rw [φ_ψ, pair_mem_fprod, pair_inj] at p_def
          obtain ⟨a', b', ha', hb', rfl, φa_φa', ψb_ψb'⟩ := p_def
          rw [←Subtype.ext_iff] at φa_φa' ψb_ψb'
          obtain ⟨⟩ := IsInjective.apply_inj hφ φ_bij.1 φa_φa'
          obtain ⟨⟩ := IsInjective.apply_inj hψ ψ_bij.1 ψb_ψb'
          exact hp
        · simp_rw [φ_ψ, pair_mem_fprod, pair_inj]
          simp only [exists_and_left, exists_and_right, existsAndEq, and_true, exists_eq_left']
          and_intros
          · use ha
          · use hb
    · intro Y hY
      rw [mem_powerset] at hY
      use φ_ψ⁻¹[Y]
      rw [mem_lambda]
      simp only [mem_powerset, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true, exists_eq_left', and_self_left]
      and_intros
      · intro z hz
        rw [mem_Image] at hz
        obtain ⟨hz, y, hy, yz⟩ := hz
        rw [mem_inv, pair_mem_fprod] at yz
        obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl, rfl⟩ := yz
        exact hz
      · exact hY
      · rw [Image_of_composition_self_inv_of_bijective hφ_ψ hY]
  · apply lambda_isFunc
    intro S hS
    rw [mem_powerset] at hS ⊢
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_Image] at hz
    exact hz.1

name: fprod_injective_of_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y z hx hy hz xy yz
  simp only [fprod, mem_prod, mem_lambda, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true,
    exists_eq_left'] at xy yz
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩, -, rfl⟩ := xy
  obtain ⟨⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩, -, eq⟩ := yz
  rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩)),
      dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true (by rw [pair_mem_prod]; exact ⟨hc, hd⟩)), pair_inj] at eq
  simp only [π₁_pair, SetLike.coe_eq_coe, π₂_pair] at eq
  obtain ⟨φa_eq_φc, ψb_eq_ψd⟩ := eq
  rw [pair_inj]
  and_intros
  · obtain ⟨⟩ := IsInjective.apply_inj hφ φ_inj φa_eq_φc
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨⟩ := IsInjective.apply_inj hψ ψ_inj ψb_eq_ψd
    rfl

name: inductive_some_inf
statement: private lemma inductive_some_inf : inductive_set some_inf
proof: := Classical.choose_spec _

name: some_inf_nonempty
statement: private lemma some_inf_nonempty : some_inf ≠ ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let h' := inductive_some_inf.left
  rw [h] at h'
  exact (ZFSet.notMem_empty ∅) h'

name: some_inf_mem_sep_inductive_set
statement: private lemma some_inf_mem_sep_inductive_set : some_inf ∈ some_inf.powerset.sep inductive_set
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_sep, mem_powerset, subset_refl, true_and]
  exact inductive_some_inf

name: some_inf_mem_powerset_some_inf_ind
statement:
private theorem some_inf_mem_powerset_some_inf_ind :
  some_inf ∈ some_inf.powerset.sep inductive_set
proof:
:=
  mem_sep.mpr ⟨mem_powerset.mpr fun _ => id, inductive_some_inf⟩

name: Nat_subset_some_inf
statement: private theorem Nat_subset_some_inf : Nat ⊆ some_inf
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  unfold Nat at hn
  rw [mem_sInter] at hn
  · have aux :
      n ∈ (⋃₀ (powerset some_inf).sep inductive_set : ZFSet) ∧
      (fun b => ∀ c, c ∈ (powerset some_inf).sep inductive_set → b ∈ c) n := by
        simp only [mem_sUnion, mem_sep, and_imp] at *
        exact ⟨
          ⟨some_inf,
            ⟨mem_powerset.mpr fun _ => id, inductive_some_inf⟩,
            hn some_inf (mem_powerset.mpr fun _ => id) (inductive_some_inf)⟩,
          fun _ _ _ => hn _ ‹_› ‹_›⟩
    simp only [mem_sep, mem_powerset, and_imp, mem_sUnion] at aux
    obtain ⟨⟨_, ⟨left, _⟩, _⟩, _⟩ := aux
    apply left
    assumption
  · exact ⟨some_inf, some_inf_mem_powerset_some_inf_ind⟩

name: zero_in_Nat
statement: theorem zero_in_Nat : ∅ ∈ Nat
proof:
:= by
  unfold Nat
  rw [mem_sInter]
  · intro x hx
    rw [mem_sep] at hx
    exact hx.right.left
  · exact ⟨some_inf, some_inf_mem_powerset_some_inf_ind⟩

name: nat_zero_eq
statement: lemma nat_zero_eq : (0 : ZFNat) = ⟨∅, zero_in_Nat⟩
proof: := rfl

name: not_lt_zero
statement: theorem not_lt_zero {n : ZFNat} : ¬ n < 0
proof: := fun _ => notMem_empty _ ‹_›

name: zero_lt_ne_zero
statement: theorem zero_lt_ne_zero {n : ZFNat} : 0 < n → n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h h'
  subst h'
  absurd not_lt_zero h
  trivial

name: zero_mem_inductive
statement: lemma zero_mem_inductive {a} (h : inductive_set a) : ↑(0 : ZFNat).val ∈ a
proof: := h.left

name: insert_mem_inductive
statement: theorem insert_mem_inductive {a n} (h : inductive_set a) (h' : n ∈ a) : insert n n ∈ a
proof:
:=
  h.right n h'

name: some_inf_powerset_sep_inductive_nonempty
statement: private theorem some_inf_powerset_sep_inductive_nonempty : (some_inf.powerset.sep inductive_set).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨some_inf, some_inf_mem_powerset_some_inf_ind⟩

name: inductive_subset_some_inf_contains_Nat
statement:
private theorem inductive_subset_some_inf_contains_Nat {a} (h : inductive_set a) (h' : a ⊆ some_inf) :
  Nat ⊆ a
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  unfold Nat at hn
  rw [mem_sInter] at hn
  · have aux :
      n ∈ (⋃₀ (powerset some_inf).sep inductive_set : ZFSet) ∧
      (fun b => ∀ c, c ∈ (powerset some_inf).sep inductive_set → b ∈ c) n := by
        simp only [mem_sUnion, mem_sep, and_imp] at *
        exact ⟨
          ⟨some_inf,
            ⟨mem_powerset.mpr fun _ => id, inductive_some_inf⟩,
            hn some_inf (mem_powerset.mpr fun _ => id) (inductive_some_inf)⟩,
            fun _ _ _ => hn _ ‹_› ‹_›⟩
    simp only [mem_sep, mem_powerset, and_imp, mem_sUnion] at aux
    exact aux.2 _ h' h
  · exact some_inf_powerset_sep_inductive_nonempty

name: succ_mem_Nat'
statement: theorem succ_mem_Nat' {n} (h : n ∈ Nat) : insert n n ∈ Nat
proof:
:= by
  have all_sub_ind : ∀ a, a ∈ some_inf.powerset.sep inductive_set → insert n n ∈ a := by
    intro a ha
    rw [mem_sep] at ha
    exact ha.2.2 n (inductive_subset_some_inf_contains_Nat ha.2 (mem_powerset.mp ha.1) h)
  unfold Nat
  rw [mem_sInter]
  · exact (all_sub_ind · ·)
  · exact some_inf_powerset_sep_inductive_nonempty

name: Nat_subset_of_inductive
statement: theorem Nat_subset_of_inductive {a : ZFSet} (h : inductive_set a) : Nat ⊆ a
proof:
:= by
  have hb : inductive_set (some_inf.sep (· ∈ a)) :=
    inductive_sep _ inductive_some_inf h.left fun n _ hn => h.right n hn
  intro n hn
  exact mem_sep.mp (inductive_subset_some_inf_contains_Nat hb sep_subset_self hn) |>.right

name: Nat_eq_of_inductive
statement:
theorem Nat_eq_of_inductive {T : ZFSet} (hT : inductive_set T) :
    Nat = ⋂₀ ((powerset T).sep inductive_set)
proof:
:= by
  have Nat_ind : inductive_set Nat := ⟨zero_in_Nat, fun _ _ => succ_mem_Nat' ‹_›⟩
  have hne : ((powerset T).sep inductive_set).Nonempty :=
    ⟨T, mem_sep.mpr ⟨mem_powerset.mpr fun _ => id, hT⟩⟩
  ext n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    rw [mem_sInter hne]
    intro y hy
    exact Nat_subset_of_inductive (mem_sep.mp hy).right hn
  · intro hn
    rw [mem_sInter hne] at hn
    exact hn Nat <| mem_sep.mpr ⟨mem_powerset.mpr (Nat_subset_of_inductive hT), Nat_ind⟩

name: mk_ofNat_mem_Nat
statement:
private theorem mk_ofNat_mem_Nat : ∀ n : ℕ, mk (PSet.ofNat n) ∈ Nat
  | 0 => zero_in_Nat
  | n + 1 => succ_mem_Nat' (mk_ofNat_mem_Nat n)

/
The least inductive set is Mathlib's `ω`: `Nat ⊆ ω` because `ω` is inductive, and every element
of `ω` is a finite von Neumann ordinal, reached from `∅` by successors, hence in `Nat`.
-/

name: Nat_eq_omega
statement: theorem Nat_eq_omega : Nat = ω
proof:
:= by
  refine ZFSet.ext fun x => ⟨fun hx => Nat_subset_of_inductive omega_inductive hx, fun hx => ?_⟩
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h x =>
    obtain ⟨⟨n⟩, h⟩ := hx
    change mk x ∈ Nat
    rw [ZFSet.sound h]
    exact mk_ofNat_mem_Nat n

name: nat_one_eq
statement: theorem nat_one_eq : 1 = succ 0
proof: := rfl

name: succ_ne_zero
statement: theorem succ_ne_zero : ∀ n, succ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩ h
  rw [succ, nat_zero_eq, Subtype.mk.injEq, ZFSet.ext_iff] at h
  simp only [mem_insert_iff, notMem_empty, iff_false, not_or] at h
  exact h n |>.1 rfl

name: succ_inj_aux
statement: theorem succ_inj_aux {m n a : ZFSet} (h : insert m m = insert n n) (h' : a ∈ m) : a ∈ n
proof:
:= by
  have d' : a ∈ m ∨ a = m ↔ a ∈ n ∨ a = n := by
    have : a ∈ insert m m ↔ a ∈ n ∨ a = n := by
      rw [h, mem_insert_iff]
      exact Or.comm
    rw [mem_insert_iff, _root_.or_comm] at this
    assumption
  let h'' := mem_insert m m
  rw [h] at h''
  simp only [mem_insert_iff] at h''
  rcases h'' with rfl | h''
  · assumption
  · rcases d'.mp (Or.inl h') with _ | rfl
    · assumption
    · absurd mem_asymm h''
      assumption

name: succ_inj_aux'
statement: theorem succ_inj_aux' {m n : ZFSet} (h : insert m m = insert n n) : m = n
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ => ⟨succ_inj_aux h, succ_inj_aux <| Eq.symm h⟩

name: succ_inj
statement: theorem succ_inj {m n} (h : succ m = succ n) : m = n
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  let ⟨n, hn⟩ := n
  simp only [succ, Subtype.mk.injEq] at *
  ext1
  exact ⟨succ_inj_aux h, succ_inj_aux (Eq.symm h)⟩

name: sep_of_ind_is_ind
statement:
theorem sep_of_ind_is_ind (P : ZFSet → Prop) {a} (h : inductive_set a)
  (h₀ : P ∅) (ih : ∀ n, n ∈ a → P n → P (insert n n)) : inductive_set (a.sep P)
proof:
:= by
  unfold inductive_set at *
  apply And.intro
  · exact mem_sep.mpr ⟨h.left, h₀⟩
  · simp only [mem_sep, and_imp]
    intros
    exact ⟨h.right _ ‹_›, ih _ ‹_› ‹_›⟩

name: succ_subrelation_mem'
statement:
theorem succ_subrelation_mem' :
  Subrelation (fun x y => insert x x = y) (fun x y : ZFSet => x ∈ y)
proof:
:= by
  intro _ _ _
  subst_eqs
  rw [mem_insert_iff]
  left
  rfl

name: succ_wf'
statement: theorem succ_wf' : @WellFounded ZFSet (fun x y => insert x x = y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subrelation.wf
  · exact succ_subrelation_mem'
  · exact mem_wf

name: mem_wf'
statement: theorem mem_wf' : @WellFounded ZFNat (·.1 ∈ ·.1)
proof:
:= by
  have : (fun x y : ZFNat => x.1 ∈ y.1) = ((fun x y : ZFSet => x ∈ y) on Subtype.val) := rfl
  rw [this]
  apply WellFounded.onFun
  exact mem_wf

name: succ_subrelation_mem
statement: theorem succ_subrelation_mem : Subrelation (succ · = ·) (·.1 ∈ ·.1)
proof:
:= by
  intro _ _ _
  simp only [succ] at *
  subst_eqs
  rw [mem_insert_iff]
  left
  rfl

name: succ_wf
statement: theorem succ_wf : @WellFounded ZFNat (succ · = ·)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subrelation.wf
  · exact succ_subrelation_mem
  · exact mem_wf'

name: ind
statement:
lemma ind {P : ZFSet → Prop} (n : ZFSet)
  (h : n ∈ Nat) (zero : P ∅) (succ : ∀ n ∈ Nat, P n → P (insert n n)) : P n
proof:
:= by
  have : Nat.sep P |>.inductive_set := by
    unfold inductive_set
    apply And.intro
    · exact mem_sep.mpr ⟨zero_in_Nat, ‹_›⟩
    · simp only [mem_sep, and_imp]
      intros
      exact ⟨succ_mem_Nat' ‹_›, succ _ ‹_› ‹_›⟩
  let p := inductive_subset_some_inf_contains_Nat this
  let p' := fun x (_ : x ∈ Nat.sep P) => Nat_subset_some_inf (ZFSet.sep_subset_self ‹_›)
  simp_rw [subset_def, mem_sep] at p
  simp only [mem_sep] at p'
  exact p p' h |>.right

name: induction
statement:
theorem induction {P : ZFNat → Prop} (n : ZFNat)
  (zero : P 0) (succ : ∀ n, P n → P (succ n)) : P n
proof:
:= by classical
  let ⟨n, hn⟩ := n
  let P' x := if hx : x ∈ Nat then P ⟨x, hx⟩ else PUnit
  have : P' n = P ⟨n, hn⟩ := dif_pos hn
  rw [← this]
  apply @ind P' n hn
  · unfold P'
    simpa [hn, zero_in_Nat, nat_zero_eq] using zero
  · intro m hm hm'
    unfold P' at *
    rw [dif_pos hm] at hm'
    rw [dif_pos <| succ_mem_Nat' hm]
    exact succ ⟨m, hm⟩ hm'

name: cases
statement:
@[cases_eliminator]
theorem cases {P : ZFNat → Prop} (n : ZFNat) (zero : P 0) (succ : ∀ n, P (succ n)) : P n
proof:
:=
  induction n zero fun n _ => succ n

name: every_nat_transitive
statement: theorem every_nat_transitive {n : ZFSet} (h : n ∈ Nat) : transitive n
proof:
:= by
  unfold transitive
  apply ind _ h
  · intros _ _
    exact False.elim (notMem_empty _ ‹_›)
  · intros _ _ ih _ hy _ _
    rw [mem_insert_iff] at hy ⊢
    rcases hy with rfl | _
    · exact Or.inr ‹_›
    · exact Or.inr (ih _ ‹_› ‹_›)

name: lt_succ
statement: theorem lt_succ {n : ZFNat} : n < succ n
proof: := mem_insert _ _

name: le_succ
statement: theorem le_succ {n : ZFNat} : n ≤ succ n
proof: := Or.inl lt_succ

name: lt_trans
statement: theorem lt_trans {x y z : ZFNat} : x < y → y < z → x < z
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ => every_nat_transitive z.2 _ ‹_› ‹_›

name: lt_irrefl
statement: theorem lt_irrefl {n : ZFNat} : ¬ n < n
proof: := fun _ => mem_irrefl _ ‹_›

name: lt_imp_ne
statement: theorem lt_imp_ne {n m : ZFNat} : n < m → n ≠ m
proof:
:= fun _ _ => by
  subst_eqs
  absurd lt_irrefl ‹_›
  trivial

name: le_trans
statement: theorem le_trans {x y z : ZFNat} : x ≤ y → y ≤ z → x ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  rintro (_ | rfl)  (_ | rfl)
  · left; exact lt_trans ‹_› ‹_›
  · left; assumption
  · left; assumption
  · right; rfl

name: le_antisymm
statement: theorem le_antisymm {x y : ZFNat} : x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y
proof:
:= by
  rintro (h | rfl) (_ | _)
  · absurd lt_irrefl <| lt_trans ‹_› ‹_›
    trivial
  · symm; assumption
  · trivial
  · trivial

name: lt_le_iff
statement: theorem lt_le_iff {n m} : n ≤ m ↔ n < succ m
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · rintro (_ | rfl)
    · exact lt_trans ‹_› lt_succ
    · exact lt_succ
  · intro h
    let ⟨n, hn⟩ := n
    let ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
    dsimp [LT.lt, nat_lt, succ] at *
    rw [mem_insert_iff] at h
    rcases h with rfl | _
    · right; rfl
    · left; assumption

name: lt_mono
statement: theorem lt_mono {x y : ZFNat} : x < y → x.succ < y.succ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction y using induction with
  | zero =>
    absurd not_lt_zero h
    trivial
  | succ y ih =>
    rcases lt_le_iff.mpr h with (h | rfl)
    · exact lt_trans (ih h) lt_succ
    · exact lt_succ

name: succ_lt_mono
statement: theorem succ_lt_mono {x y : ZFNat} : succ x < succ y → x < y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction y using induction with
  | zero =>
    rcases lt_le_iff.mpr h with (h | h)
    · absurd not_lt_zero h; trivial
    · absurd succ_ne_zero x h; trivial
  | succ y ih =>
    rcases lt_le_iff.mpr h with (h | h)
    · exact lt_trans (ih h) lt_succ
    · replace h := succ_inj h
      subst h
      exact lt_succ

name: le_mono
statement: theorem le_mono {x y : ZFNat} : x ≤ y → x.succ ≤ y.succ
proof:
:= by
  rintro (h | rfl)
  · left
    induction y using induction with
    | zero =>
      absurd not_lt_zero h
      trivial
    | succ y ih =>
      rcases lt_le_iff.mpr h with (h | rfl)
      · exact lt_trans (ih h) lt_succ
      · exact lt_succ
  · right; rfl

name: succ_le_mono
statement: theorem succ_le_mono {x y : ZFNat} : x.succ ≤ y.succ → x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rintro (h | h)
  · left
    induction y using induction with
    | zero =>
      rcases lt_le_iff.mpr h with (h | h)
      · absurd not_lt_zero h; trivial
      · absurd succ_ne_zero x h; trivial
    | succ y ih =>
      rcases lt_le_iff.mpr h with (h | h)
      · exact lt_trans (ih h) lt_succ
      · rw [← h]; exact lt_succ
  · replace h := succ_inj h; subst h; right; rfl

name: le_lt_iff
statement: theorem le_lt_iff {n m} : succ n ≤ m ↔ n < m
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_le_iff]
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro; exact succ_lt_mono ‹_›
  · exact lt_mono

name: le_total
statement: theorem le_total {x y : ZFNat} : x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | zero =>
    left
    induction y using induction with
    | zero => right; rfl
    | succ _ ih => exact le_trans ih (le_succ)
  | succ x ih =>
    induction y using induction with
    | zero =>
      rcases ih with ((h | _) | (_ | _))
      · absurd not_lt_zero h; trivial
      · subst_eqs; right; exact le_succ
      · right; left; exact lt_trans ‹_› lt_succ
      · subst_eqs; right; left; exact lt_succ
    | succ y ih' =>
      rcases ih with (h | _) | (h | _)
      · rcases ih' (Or.inl <| lt_le_iff.mpr h) with l | (r | rfl)
        · left; left; exact lt_le_iff.mp l
        · right; right; congr; exact le_antisymm (lt_le_iff.mpr r) (lt_le_iff.mpr h)
        · replace h := lt_le_iff.mpr h
          left
          apply le_mono
          exact h
      · subst_eqs; right; exact le_succ
      · right
        simp only [lt_le_iff]
        exact lt_trans (lt_trans h lt_succ) lt_succ
      · subst_eqs
        right
        exact le_succ

name: lt_iff_le_not_ge
statement: theorem lt_iff_le_not_ge {x y : ZFNat} : x < y ↔ x ≤ y ∧ ¬ y ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro
    apply And.intro
    · left
      assumption
    · rintro (_ | rfl)
      · exact lt_irrefl (lt_trans ‹_› ‹_›)
      · exact lt_irrefl ‹_›
  · rintro ⟨h | rfl, h'⟩
    · assumption
    · simp only [LE.le, or_true] at h'
      contradiction

name: strong_induction
statement:
theorem strong_induction {P : ZFNat → Prop} (n : ZFNat)
  (ind : ∀ n, (∀ m, m < n → P m) → P n) : P n
proof:
:= by
  let Q x := ∀ m < x, P m
  have aux {x} : Q x := by
    induction x using induction with
    | zero =>
      intros _ _
      exact False.elim (not_lt_zero ‹_›)
    | succ n ih =>
      intros m hm
      unfold Q at ih
      by_cases h : m = n
      · subst h
        exact ind _ ih
      · have h' : m < n := by
          rcases lt_le_iff.mpr hm with (_ | rfl)
          · assumption
          · contradiction
        exact ih m h'
  exact ind _ aux

name: mem_Nat_of_mem_mem_Nat
statement: theorem mem_Nat_of_mem_mem_Nat {n m : ZFSet} (hn : n ∈ Nat) : m ∈ n → m ∈ Nat
proof:
:= by
  apply ZFNat.ind n hn
  · intro h
    nomatch notMem_empty m h
  · intro n hn ih hm
    rw [mem_insert_iff] at hm
    rcases hm with rfl | hm
    · exact hn
    · exact ih hm

name: not_zero_imp_succ
statement: theorem not_zero_imp_succ {n : ZFNat} : n ≠ 0 → ∃ m, n = succ m
proof:
:= by
  induction n using induction with
  | zero => intro h; contradiction
  | succ n _ =>
    intro
    exact exists_apply_eq_apply' succ n

name: sUnion_insert_nat
statement: lemma sUnion_insert_nat {x : ZFSet} (h : x ∈ Nat) : (⋃₀ (insert x x) : ZFSet) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply ind _ h
  · rw [sUnion_insert, sUnion_empty]
    ext1
    simp only [mem_union, notMem_empty, or_self]
  · intros n _ ih
    rw [sUnion_insert, ih]
    ext1
    simp only [mem_union, mem_insert_iff, or_self_right]

name: pred_in_Nat'
statement: theorem pred_in_Nat' ⦃x : ZFSet⦄ (h : x ∈ Nat) : (⋃₀ x : ZFSet) ∈ Nat
proof:
:= by
  apply ind _ h
  · rw [sUnion_empty]
    exact zero_in_Nat
  · intros
    rw [sUnion_insert_nat] <;> assumption

name: pred_eq
statement: theorem pred_eq (n : ZFNat) : pred n = ⟨⋃₀ n.val, pred_in_Nat' n.property⟩
proof: := rfl

name: pred_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pred_zero : pred 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold pred
  rw [nat_zero_eq, Subtype.map, Subtype.mk.injEq, sUnion_empty]

name: pred_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pred_one : pred 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold pred
  rw [nat_one_eq, nat_zero_eq, Subtype.map, Subtype.mk.injEq]
  dsimp [succ]
  rw [LawfulSingleton.insert_empty_eq, sUnion_singleton]

name: pred_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pred_succ {n : ZFNat} : pred (succ n) = n
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨_, _⟩ := n
  simp only [pred, succ, Subtype.map]
  congr
  exact sUnion_insert_nat ‹_›

name: succ_pred
statement:
@[simp]
theorem succ_pred {n : ZFNat} (h : n ≠ 0) : succ (pred n) = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using strong_induction with
  | ind n ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := not_zero_imp_succ h
    subst hm
    by_cases h' : m = 0 <;> subst_eqs <;> rw [pred_succ]

name: succ_lift_eq
statement: private theorem succ_lift_eq {x : ZFNat} : ↑(succ x) = insert x.val x.val
proof: := by rfl

name: succ_eq
statement:
private theorem succ_eq (n : ZFSet) (n_Nat : n ∈ Nat) :
  ⟨insert n n, succ_mem_Nat' n_Nat⟩ = succ ⟨n, n_Nat⟩
proof: := by rfl

name: rec'_zero.
proof:
:= by
    unfold ZFNat.rec' WellFounded.fix
    beta_reduce
    rw [WellFounded.fixF_eq, dite_cond_eq_true]
    exact eq_self _

name: rec'_succ.
statement:
theorem rec'_succ.{u} {motive : ZFSet → Sort u} (n : ZFSet) (n_Nat : n ∈ Nat)
  (zero : motive ∅) (succ : Π x ∈ Nat, motive x → motive (insert x x)) :
  rec' (insert n n) (succ_mem_Nat' n_Nat) zero succ = succ n n_Nat (rec' n n_Nat zero succ)
proof:
:= by
    unfold ZFNat.rec' WellFounded.fix
    beta_reduce
    rw [WellFounded.fixF_eq, dite_cond_eq_false]
    · apply cast_eq_iff_heq.mpr
      · congr
        · conv => enter [1, 1]; rw [succ_eq _ n_Nat, pred_succ]
        · exact proof_irrel_heq ..
        · conv =>
            left
            conv => arg 1; rw [succ_eq _ n_Nat]
            rw [pred_succ]
        · exact proof_irrel_heq ..
        · apply succ_pred
          rw [succ_eq _ n_Nat]
          exact succ_ne_zero _
      · apply eq_false
        intro h
        rw [succ_eq _ n_Nat] at h
        exact succ_ne_zero _ h

name: induction_is_rec_into_Prop
statement:
@[simp]
theorem induction_is_rec_into_Prop {motive : ZFNat → Prop} :
  induction = ZFNat.rec (motive := motive)
proof: := rfl

name: rec_zero.
proof: := by conv => arg 1; simp [ZFNat.rec, ZFNat.rec'_zero]

name: rec_succ.
statement:
theorem rec_succ.{u} {motive : ZFNat → Sort u} (n : ZFNat)
  (zero : motive 0) (succ' : Π x, motive x → motive (succ x)) :
  rec (succ n) zero succ' = succ' n (ZFNat.rec n zero succ')
proof:
:= by
    simp only [succ, rec, eq_mpr_eq_cast, id_eq, eq_mp_eq_cast, ZFNat.rec'_succ _ n.property,
      SetLike.eta, dite_eq_ite]
    exact eq_of_heq (HEq.trans (cast_heq _ _) (cast_heq _ _))

name: rec_unique.
statement:
theorem rec_unique.{u} {motive : ZFNat → Sort u} (zero : motive 0)
  (succ' : Π x, motive x → motive (succ x)) (f : Π x, motive x)
  (h₀ : f 0 = zero) (hs : ∀ x, f (succ x) = succ' x (f x)) (n : ZFNat) :
    f n = ZFNat.rec n zero succ'
proof:
:= by
  induction n using ZFNat.rec with
  | zero => rw [h₀, rec_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [hs, rec_succ, ih]

name: pred'_eq_pred
statement: lemma pred'_eq_pred : pred = ZFNat.pred'
proof:
:= by
  ext1 n
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pred_zero, ZFNat.pred', ZFNat.rec_zero]
  | succ _ _ => rw [pred_succ, ZFNat.pred', ZFNat.rec_succ]

name: zero_lt_succ
statement: theorem zero_lt_succ {n : ZFNat} : 0 < n.succ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact lt_succ
  | succ n ih => exact lt_trans ih lt_succ

name: pos_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem pos_of_ne_zero {n : ZFNat} : 0 ≠ n → 0 < n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; nomatch h
  | succ x ih =>
    intro
    exact zero_lt_succ

name: add_inst_eq
statement: lemma add_inst_eq {n m : ZFNat} : n + m = n.add m
proof: := rfl

name: add_one_eq_succ
statement: lemma add_one_eq_succ {n : ZFNat} : n + 1 = succ n
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [add_inst_eq]
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [ZFNat.add, ZFNat.rec_zero, nat_one_eq]
  | succ _ ih => rw [ZFNat.add, ZFNat.rec_succ, ← ZFNat.add, ih]

name: add_one_eq_succ'
statement: lemma add_one_eq_succ' {n : ZFNat} : 1 + n = succ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_inst_eq, ZFNat.add, nat_one_eq, rec_succ, rec_zero]

name: add_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma add_zero {n : ZFNat} : n + 0 = n
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [add_inst_eq]
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [ZFNat.add, rec_zero]
  | succ _ ih => rw [ZFNat.add, rec_succ, ← ZFNat.add, ih]

name: zero_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_add {n : ZFNat} : 0 + n = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_inst_eq, ZFNat.add, rec_zero]

name: add_succ
statement: lemma add_succ {n m : ZFNat} : succ n + m = succ (n + m)
proof: := rec_succ n m fun _ => succ

name: succ_add
statement: lemma succ_add {n m : ZFNat} : succ (n + m) = n + succ m
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [add_inst_eq, add_inst_eq, ZFNat.add, rec_zero, ZFNat.add, rec_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [add_succ, ih]
    dsimp [add_inst_eq]
    conv => rhs; rw [ZFNat.add, rec_succ]

name: add_comm
statement: lemma add_comm (n m : ZFNat) : n + m = m + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [add_zero, add_inst_eq, ZFNat.add, rec_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [← succ_add, add_succ, ih]

name: add_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma add_assoc (n m k : ZFNat) : n + (m + k) = n + m + k
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [zero_add, zero_add]
  | succ _ ih => rw [add_succ, add_succ, add_succ, ih]

name: add_left_comm
statement: lemma add_left_comm (n m k : ZFNat) : n + (m + k) = m + (n + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc, add_assoc, add_comm n]

name: add_right_comm
statement: lemma add_right_comm (n m k : ZFNat) : (n + m) + k = (n + k) + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_assoc, add_comm m, add_assoc]

name: add_left_cancel
statement: theorem add_left_cancel {n m k : ZFNat} : n + m = n + k ↔ m = k
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [zero_add]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_rw [add_succ]
    apply Iff.intro
    · intro h
      exact ih.mp (succ_inj h)
    · intro h
      rw [h]

name: add_right_cancel
statement: theorem add_right_cancel {n m k : ZFNat} : n + m = k + m ↔ n = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm n, add_comm k]
  exact add_left_cancel

name: eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero : ∀ {n m : ZFNat}, n + m = 0 → n = 0 ∧ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp only [zero_add, true_and, imp_self]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h
    rw [add_succ, succ_add] at h
    absurd succ_ne_zero m (ih h).right
    trivial

name: eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_left
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_left {n m : ZFNat} (h : n + m = 0) : m = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero h |>.right

name: add_left_eq_self
statement: @[simp] theorem add_left_eq_self {a b : ZFNat} : a + b = b ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; rhs; rw [← @zero_add b]
  rw [add_right_cancel]

name: add_right_eq_self
statement: @[simp] theorem add_right_eq_self {a b : ZFNat} : a + b = a ↔ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; rhs; rw [← @add_zero a]
  rw [add_left_cancel]

name: self_eq_add_right
statement: @[simp] theorem self_eq_add_right {a b : ZFNat} : a = a + b ↔ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; lhs; rw [← @add_zero a]
  rw [add_left_cancel]
  exact eq_comm

name: self_eq_add_left
statement: @[simp] theorem self_eq_add_left {a b : ZFNat} : a = b + a ↔ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; lhs; rw [← @zero_add a]
  rw [add_right_cancel]
  exact eq_comm

name: lt_of_succ_le
statement: theorem lt_of_succ_le {n m : ZFNat} (h : succ n ≤ m) : n < m
proof: := le_lt_iff.mp ‹_›

name: succ_le_of_lt
statement: theorem succ_le_of_lt {n m : ZFNat} (h : n < m) : succ n ≤ m
proof: := le_lt_iff.mpr ‹_›

name: le.dest
statement: theorem le.dest {n m : ZFNat} : n ≤ m → ∃ k, n + k = m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨m, zero_add⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases h with h | rfl
    · have : n < m := by
        apply lt_trans (lt_succ)
        assumption
      let ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih (Or.inl this)
      exact ⟨pred k, by
        rwa [← add_one_eq_succ, ← add_assoc, add_one_eq_succ', ZFNat.succ_pred]
        intro
        subst_eqs
        rw [add_zero] at this
        exact lt_irrefl this⟩
    · exact ⟨0, add_zero⟩

name: le_succ_of_le
statement: theorem le_succ_of_le {n m : ZFNat} (h : n ≤ m) : n ≤ succ m
proof: := le_trans h le_succ

name: le_add_right
statement: @[simp] theorem le_add_right (n k : ZFNat) : n ≤ n + k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [add_zero]
  | succ _ ih =>
    rw [add_comm, add_succ, ← add_comm]
    exact le_succ_of_le ih

name: le_add_left
statement: @[simp] theorem le_add_left (n m : ZFNat) : n ≤ m + n
proof: := add_comm .. ▸ le_add_right ..

name: le.intro
statement: theorem le.intro {n m k : ZFNat} (h : n + k = m) : n ≤ m
proof: := h ▸ le_add_right n k

name: zero_le
statement: theorem zero_le {n : ZFNat} : 0 ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => right; rfl
  | succ n ih => exact le_trans ih le_succ

name: le_of_add_le_add_left
statement: theorem le_of_add_le_add_left {a b c : ZFNat} (h : a + b ≤ a + c) : b ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  match le.dest h with
  | ⟨d, hd⟩ =>
    apply @le.intro _ _ d
    rw [← add_assoc] at hd
    exact add_left_cancel.mp hd

name: add_le_add_left
statement: theorem add_le_add_left {n m : ZFNat} (h : n ≤ m) (k : ZFNat) : k + n ≤ k + m
proof:
:=
  match le.dest h with
  | ⟨w, hw⟩ =>
    have : k + (n + w) = k + m     := congrArg _ hw
    le.intro <| (Eq.symm <| add_assoc k n w).trans this

name: add_le_add_iff_left
statement: @[simp] theorem add_le_add_iff_left {n m k : ZFNat} : n + m ≤ n + k ↔ m ≤ k
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_of_add_le_add_left, fun h => add_le_add_left h _⟩

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_right
statement: theorem lt_of_add_lt_add_right {n m k : ZFNat} : k + n < m + n → k < m
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp_rw [add_zero]; exact id
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_rw [← succ_add]
    intro h
    apply succ_lt_mono at h
    exact ih h

name: add_lt_add_left
statement: theorem add_lt_add_left {n m : ZFNat} (h : n < m) (k : ZFNat) : k + n < k + m
proof:
:=
  lt_of_succ_le <| succ_add ▸ add_le_add_left (succ_le_of_lt h) k

name: add_lt_add_right
statement: theorem add_lt_add_right {n m : ZFNat} (h : n < m) (k : ZFNat) : n + k < m + k
proof:
:=
  add_comm k m ▸ add_comm k n ▸ add_lt_add_left h k

name: lt_add_of_pos_right
statement: theorem lt_add_of_pos_right {n k : ZFNat} (h : 0 < k) : n < n + k

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_left
statement: theorem lt_of_add_lt_add_left {n m k : ZFNat} : n + k < n + m → k < m
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm n, add_comm n]; exact lt_of_add_lt_add_right

name: add_lt_add_iff_left
statement: @[simp] theorem add_lt_add_iff_left {k n m : ZFNat} : k + n < k + m ↔ n < m
proof:
:=
  ⟨lt_of_add_lt_add_left, fun _ => add_lt_add_left ‹_› _⟩

name: add_lt_add_iff_right
statement: @[simp] theorem add_lt_add_iff_right {k n m : ZFNat} : n + k < m + k ↔ n < m
proof:
:=
  ⟨lt_of_add_lt_add_right, fun _ => add_lt_add_right ‹_› _⟩

name: add_le_add_right
statement: theorem add_le_add_right {n m : ZFNat} (h : n ≤ m) (k : ZFNat) : n + k ≤ m + k
proof:
:=
  add_comm .. ▸ add_comm m k ▸ add_le_add_left h k

name: add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
statement: theorem add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt {a b c d : ZFNat} (hle : a ≤ b) (hlt : c < d) : a + c < b + d
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (add_le_add_right hle _) (add_lt_add_left hlt _)

name: add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le
statement: theorem add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le {a b c d : ZFNat} (hlt : a < b) (hle : c ≤ d) : a + c < b + d
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (add_le_add_left hle _) (add_lt_add_right hlt _)

name: lt_add_of_pos_left
statement: theorem lt_add_of_pos_left {k n : ZFNat} : 0 < k → n < k + n
proof:
:=
  add_comm .. ▸ lt_add_of_pos_right

name: pos_of_lt_add_right
statement: theorem pos_of_lt_add_right {n k : ZFNat} (h : n < n + k) : 0 < k
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_add_lt_add_left
  rw [add_zero]
  assumption

name: pos_of_lt_add_left
statement: theorem pos_of_lt_add_left {n k : ZFNat} : n < k + n → 0 < k
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]; exact pos_of_lt_add_right

name: lt_add_right_iff_pos
statement: @[simp] theorem lt_add_right_iff_pos {n k : ZFNat} : n < n + k ↔ 0 < k
proof:
:=
  ⟨pos_of_lt_add_right, lt_add_of_pos_right⟩

name: lt_add_left_iff_pos
statement: @[simp] theorem lt_add_left_iff_pos {n k : ZFNat} : n < k + n ↔ 0 < k
proof:
:=
  ⟨pos_of_lt_add_left, lt_add_of_pos_left⟩

name: add_pos_left
statement: theorem add_pos_left {m : ZFNat} (h : 0 < m) (n : ZFNat) : 0 < m + n
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le h (le_add_right ..)

name: add_pos_right
statement: theorem add_pos_right {n : ZFNat} (m : ZFNat) (h : 0 < n) : 0 < m + n
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le h (le_add_left ..)

name: pred_le_pred
statement: theorem pred_le_pred {n m : ZFNat} : n ≤ m → (pred n) ≤ (pred m)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction n <;> induction m
  · right; rfl
  · simp only [pred_zero, pred_succ]
    rcases h with (_ | _)
    · exact lt_le_iff.mpr ‹_›
    · absurd (succ_ne_zero _ (Eq.symm ‹_›))
      trivial
  · rcases h with (h | h)
    · absurd not_lt_zero h
      trivial
    · rw [h]
  · simp only [pred_succ]
    exact succ_le_mono h

name: le_of_succ_le_succ
statement: theorem le_of_succ_le_succ {n m : ZFNat} : (succ n) ≤ (succ m) → n ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  replace h := pred_le_pred h
  simp only [pred_succ] at h
  assumption

name: lt_of_succ_lt_succ
statement: theorem lt_of_succ_lt_succ {n m : ZFNat} : succ n < succ m → n < m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases le_of_succ_le_succ (Or.inl h) with (h | rfl)
  · assumption
  · absurd lt_irrefl h
    trivial

name: add_self_ne_one
statement: theorem add_self_ne_one {n : ZFNat} : n + n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [zero_add, nat_one_eq] at h
    absurd succ_ne_zero _ (Eq.symm h)
    trivial
  | succ n _ =>
    rw [add_succ, ← succ_add, nat_one_eq] at h
    absurd succ_ne_zero _ (succ_inj h)
    trivial

name: sub_inst_eq
statement: lemma sub_inst_eq {n m : ZFNat} : n - m = n.sub m
proof: := rfl

name: sub_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_zero {n : ZFNat} : n - 0 = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_inst_eq, ZFNat.sub, ZFNat.rec_zero]

name: sub_one_eq_pred
statement: theorem sub_one_eq_pred {n : ZFNat} : n - 1 = pred n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_inst_eq, ZFNat.sub, nat_one_eq, ZFNat.rec_succ, ZFNat.rec_zero]

name: succ_mono
statement: theorem succ_mono {n m : ZFNat} : n < m ↔ succ n < succ m
proof:
:=
  ⟨lt_mono, lt_of_succ_lt_succ⟩

name: sub_succ
statement: theorem sub_succ (n m : ZFNat) : n - succ m = pred (n - m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_inst_eq, ZFNat.sub, ZFNat.rec_succ, ← ZFNat.sub]
  rfl

name: zero_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_sub {n : ZFNat} : 0 - n = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [sub_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [sub_succ, ih, pred_zero]

name: succ_sub_succ
statement: theorem succ_sub_succ (n m : ZFNat) : succ n - succ m = n - m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero      => rw [← nat_one_eq, sub_one_eq_pred, pred_succ, sub_zero]
  | succ m ih => rw [sub_succ, ih, ← sub_succ]

name: succ_sub_self
statement: theorem succ_sub_self (n : ZFNat) : succ n - n = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [sub_zero, nat_one_eq]
  | succ n ih => rw [succ_sub_succ, ih]

name: sub_self
statement: theorem sub_self {n : ZFNat} : n - n = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [sub_zero]
  | succ n _ => rw [sub_succ, succ_sub_self, pred_one]

name: sub_add_distrib
statement: theorem sub_add_distrib {n m k : ZFNat} : n - (m + k) = n - m - k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [add_zero, sub_zero]
  | succ k ih => rw [← succ_add, sub_succ, ih, ← sub_succ]

name: sub_ne_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem sub_ne_zero_of_lt {a b : ZFNat} : a < b → b - a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction a generalizing b with
  | zero => rw [sub_zero]; exact zero_lt_ne_zero h
  | succ a ih =>
    induction b with
    | zero => exact absurd h not_lt_zero
    | succ b _ => rw [succ_sub_succ]; exact ih <| succ_mono.mpr h

name: le_of_succ_le
statement: theorem le_of_succ_le {n m : ZFNat} (_ : succ n ≤ m) : n ≤ m
proof: := le_trans le_succ ‹_›

name: lt_of_succ_lt
statement: theorem lt_of_succ_lt {n m : ZFNat} (h : succ n < m) : n < m
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_of_succ_le (.inl h) with (h | rfl)
  · assumption
  · absurd lt_irrefl (lt_trans lt_succ h); trivial

name: le_of_lt
statement: theorem le_of_lt {n m : ZFNat} : n < m → n ≤ m
proof: := Or.inl

name: add_sub_of_le
statement: theorem add_sub_of_le {a b : ZFNat} (h : a ≤ b) : a + (b - a) = b
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => rw [sub_zero, zero_add]
  | succ a ih =>
    have hne : b - a ≠ 0 := by
      apply sub_ne_zero_of_lt
      exact lt_of_succ_le ‹_›
    have : a ≤ b := le_of_succ_le ‹_›
    rw [sub_succ, add_succ, succ_add, succ_pred hne, ih this]

name: sub_one_cancel
statement: theorem sub_one_cancel {a b : ZFNat} : 0 < a → 0 < b → a - 1 = b - 1 → a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro ha hb h
  rw [← succ_pred (zero_lt_ne_zero ha), ← succ_pred (zero_lt_ne_zero hb)]
  simpa only [← sub_one_eq_pred, ← add_one_eq_succ, add_right_cancel]

name: sub_add_cancel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_add_cancel {n m : ZFNat} (h : m ≤ n) : n - m + m = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, add_sub_of_le h]

name: add_sub_add_right
statement: theorem add_sub_add_right (n k m : ZFNat) : (n + k) - (m + k) = n - m
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp_rw [add_zero]
  | succ k ih => rwa [← succ_add, ← succ_add, succ_sub_succ]

name: add_sub_add_left
statement: theorem add_sub_add_left (k n m : ZFNat) : (k + n) - (k + m) = n - m
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm k n, add_comm k m, add_sub_add_right]

name: add_sub_cancel
statement: @[simp] theorem add_sub_cancel (n m : ZFNat) : n + m - m = n
proof:
:=
  suffices n + m - (0 + m) = n by rw [zero_add] at this; assumption
  by rw [add_sub_add_right, sub_zero]

name: add_sub_cancel_left
statement: theorem add_sub_cancel_left (n m : ZFNat) : n + m - n = m
proof:
:= by
  have : n + m - (n + 0) = m := by rw [add_sub_add_left, sub_zero]
  rwa [add_zero] at this

name: add_sub_assoc
statement: theorem add_sub_assoc {m k : ZFNat} (h : k ≤ m) (n : ZFNat) : n + m - k = n + (m - k)
proof:
:= by
 rcases le.dest h with ⟨l, rfl⟩
 rw [add_assoc, add_comm n, ← add_assoc, add_sub_cancel_left k, add_comm k, add_sub_cancel]

name: eq_add_of_sub_eq
statement: theorem eq_add_of_sub_eq {a b c : ZFNat} (hle : b ≤ a) (h : a - b = c) : a = c + b
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.symm, sub_add_cancel hle]

name: sub_eq_of_eq_add
statement: theorem sub_eq_of_eq_add {a b c : ZFNat} (h : a = c + b) : a - b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [h, add_sub_cancel]

name: add_eq_add_sub_eq_sub
statement: theorem add_eq_add_sub_eq_sub {a b c d : ZFNat} : a + b = c + d → a - c = d - b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : a = c + d - b := ZFNat.sub_eq_of_eq_add h.symm |>.symm
  subst this
  rw [←ZFNat.sub_add_distrib, ZFNat.add_comm b c, ZFNat.add_sub_add_left c d b]

name: sub_factor
statement: theorem sub_factor {m k n : ZFNat} (_ : k ≤ m) (_ : m ≤ n) : n - m + k = n - (m - k)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply sub_eq_of_eq_add
  rw [← add_assoc, ← add_sub_assoc, add_comm k, add_sub_assoc, sub_self, add_zero, add_comm,
    ← add_sub_assoc, add_comm, add_sub_assoc, sub_self, add_zero]
  · trivial
  · assumption
  · trivial
  · assumption

name: sub_add_comm
statement: theorem sub_add_comm {m n k : ZFNat} (h : m ≤ n) : n - m + k = n + k - m
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, add_comm n k, add_sub_assoc h k]

name: succ_le_succ
statement:
theorem succ_le_succ {n m : ZFNat} : n ≤ m → succ n ≤ succ m
  | .inl _ => .inl <| succ_mono.mp ‹_›
  | .inr _ => .inr <| congrArg succ ‹_›

name: succ_le_succ_iff
statement:
theorem succ_le_succ_iff {a b : ZFNat} : succ a ≤ succ b ↔ a ≤ b where
  mp
proof:
:= le_of_succ_le_succ
  mpr := succ_le_succ

name: le_zero_imp_eq
statement: theorem le_zero_imp_eq {n : ZFNat} : n ≤ 0 → n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro (h | rfl)
  · exact absurd h not_lt_zero
  · rfl

name: mul_inst_eq
statement: lemma mul_inst_eq {n m : ZFNat} : n * m = n.mul m
proof: := rfl

name: mul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mul_zero {n : ZFNat} : n * 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [mul_inst_eq]
  induction n using induction with
  | zero => rw [ZFNat.mul, rec_zero]
  | succ _ ih => rw [ZFNat.mul, rec_succ, ← ZFNat.mul, ih, add_zero]

name: zero_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_mul {n : ZFNat} : 0 * n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_inst_eq, ZFNat.mul, rec_zero]

name: mul_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mul_one {n : ZFNat} : n * 1 = n
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [mul_inst_eq]
  induction n using induction with
  | zero => rw [ZFNat.mul, rec_zero]
  | succ _ ih => rw [ZFNat.mul, rec_succ, ← ZFNat.mul, ih, add_one_eq_succ]

name: one_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_mul {n : ZFNat} : 1 * n = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_inst_eq, ZFNat.mul, nat_one_eq, rec_succ, rec_zero, zero_add]

name: mul_succ
statement: lemma mul_succ {n m : ZFNat} : (n + 1) * m = n * m + m
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [zero_add, one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add]
  | succ n ih => rw [add_one_eq_succ, mul_inst_eq, ZFNat.mul, rec_succ, rec_succ, ← ZFNat.mul,
    ← mul_inst_eq, ← ih, add_one_eq_succ]

name: succ_mul
statement: lemma succ_mul {n m : ZFNat} : (succ n) * m = n * m + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_one_eq_succ, mul_succ]

name: left_distrib
statement: lemma left_distrib {n m k : ZFNat} : n * (m + k) = n * m + n * k
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [zero_mul, zero_mul, zero_add, zero_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← add_one_eq_succ]
    conv_rhs => rw [mul_succ, mul_succ, add_assoc, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, add_comm m, add_assoc,
      add_assoc, ← ih, ← add_assoc, add_comm k m, ← mul_succ]

name: mul_comm
statement: lemma mul_comm (n m : ZFNat) : n * m = m * n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using induction with
  | zero => rw [zero_mul, mul_zero]
  | succ n ih => rw [← add_one_eq_succ, mul_succ, ih, left_distrib, mul_one]

name: succ_mul'
statement: lemma succ_mul' {n m : ZFNat} : m * (succ n) = m * n + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, succ_mul, mul_comm]

name: right_distrib
statement: lemma right_distrib {n m k : ZFNat} : (n + m) * k = n * k + m * k
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, left_distrib, mul_comm m, mul_comm k]

name: mul_assoc
statement: lemma mul_assoc (n m k : ZFNat) : n * m * k = n * (m * k)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using induction with
  | zero => rw [zero_mul, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← add_one_eq_succ]
    conv =>
      rhs
      rw [right_distrib, one_mul, ← ih, ← right_distrib, ← mul_succ]

name: mul_left_comm
statement: lemma mul_left_comm (n m k : ZFNat) : n * (m * k) = m * (n * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm n m, mul_assoc]

name: two_mul
statement: lemma two_mul (n : ZFNat) : (1 + 1) * n = n + n
proof: := by rw [mul_succ, one_mul]

name: mul_two
statement: lemma mul_two (n : ZFNat) : n * (1 + 1) = n + n
proof: := by rw [mul_comm, two_mul]

name: sub_lt_eq_zero
statement: lemma sub_lt_eq_zero {n m : ZFNat} (h : n ≤ m) : n - m = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction with
  | zero => rw [le_zero_imp_eq h, sub_zero]
  | succ _ ih =>
    rcases h with _ | rfl
    · rw [sub_succ, ih]
      · exact pred_zero
      · exact lt_le_iff.mpr ‹_›
    · rw [sub_self]

name: add_lt_trans
statement: theorem add_lt_trans {n m p q : ZFNat} : n < m → p < q → n + p < m + q
proof:
:= by
  intros h h'
  exact lt_trans (add_lt_add_left h' n) (add_lt_add_right h q)

name: pos_mul_pos
statement: theorem pos_mul_pos {k n : ZFNat} (h : 0 < k) : 0 < k*n → 0 < n
proof:
:= by
  intro h'
  induction n with
  | zero => rwa [mul_zero] at h'
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := not_zero_imp_succ (zero_lt_ne_zero h)
    rcases lt_le_iff.mpr h with (_ | rfl)
    · by_contra contr
      rw [not_lt] at contr
      replace contr := le_zero_imp_eq contr
      nomatch succ_ne_zero m contr
    · rw [← nat_one_eq, one_mul] at h'
      assumption

name: mul_lt_mono
statement: theorem mul_lt_mono {n m k : ZFNat} (h : 0 < k) : n < m → k*n < k*m
proof:
:= by
  intro h'
  induction m using induction with
  | zero => nomatch not_lt_zero h'
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [← add_one_eq_succ, left_distrib, mul_one]
    rcases lt_le_iff.mpr h' with (h' | rfl)
    · let this := add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (@zero_le k) (ih h')
      rwa [zero_add, add_comm] at this
    · conv => lhs; rw [← @zero_add (k*n), add_comm]
      exact add_lt_add_left h (k*n)

name: mul_le_mono
statement: theorem mul_le_mono {k m n : ZFNat} : n ≤ m → k*n ≤ k*m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction k using induction with
  | zero => rw [zero_mul, zero_mul]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [succ_mul, succ_mul]
    by_contra contr
    rw [not_le, add_comm, add_comm _ n] at contr
    rcases ih with _ | l
    · nomatch lt_irrefl <| lt_trans (add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt h ‹_›) contr
    · rcases h with _ | rfl
      · rw [l] at contr
        nomatch lt_irrefl <| lt_trans (lt_of_add_lt_add_right contr) ‹_›
      · nomatch lt_irrefl ‹_›

name: mul_lt_cancel
statement: theorem mul_lt_cancel {k m n : ZFNat} : k*n < k*m → n < m
proof:
:= by
  contrapose
  rw [not_lt, not_lt]
  exact mul_le_mono

name: lt_mul_iff
statement: lemma lt_mul_iff {n m k : ZFNat} : n < m ↔ (k+1)*n < (k+1)*m
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · induction k using induction with
    | zero => rw [zero_add, one_mul, one_mul]; exact id
    | succ k ih =>
      intro
      rw [← add_one_eq_succ, mul_succ, mul_succ (m:=m)]
      exact add_lt_trans (ih ‹_›) ‹_›
  · exact mul_lt_cancel

name: left_distrib_mul_sub_one
statement: lemma left_distrib_mul_sub_one {n m : ZFNat} : n * (m - 1) = n * m - n
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction with
  | zero => rw [zero_sub, mul_zero, zero_sub]
  | succ _ _ =>
    rw [nat_one_eq, succ_sub_succ, sub_zero, succ_mul', add_sub_assoc, sub_self, add_zero]
    right
    rfl

name: left_distrib_mul_sub_aux
statement: lemma left_distrib_mul_sub_aux {n m k : ZFNat} (h : k < m) : n * (m - k) = n * m - n * k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [sub_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [mul_comm n k.succ, succ_mul, mul_comm k n, sub_add_distrib]
    specialize ih (lt_trans lt_succ h)
    rw [← ih, ← left_distrib_mul_sub_one, ← sub_add_distrib, add_one_eq_succ]

name: sub_eq_zero_imp_le
statement: lemma sub_eq_zero_imp_le {a b : ZFNat} : a - b = 0 ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro h
    induction b with
    | zero => rw [sub_zero] at h; right; assumption
    | succ b ih =>
      induction a with
      | zero => exact zero_le
      | succ a _ =>
        apply le_mono
        rw [succ_sub_succ] at h
        by_contra contr
        rw [not_le] at contr
        absurd sub_ne_zero_of_lt contr
        assumption
  · intro
    exact sub_lt_eq_zero ‹_›

name: sub_eq_zero_mul
statement: lemma sub_eq_zero_mul {n a b : ZFNat} : a - b = 0 → n * a - n * b = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [zero_mul, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  | succ _ _ => exact sub_eq_zero_imp_le.mpr (mul_le_mono (sub_eq_zero_imp_le.mp ‹_›))

name: left_distrib_mul_sub
statement: lemma left_distrib_mul_sub {n m k : ZFNat} : n * (m - k) = n * m - n * k
proof:
:= by
  rcases @le_total m k with (h | rfl) | _ | rfl
  · replace h := sub_lt_eq_zero (Or.inl h)
    rw [h, mul_zero, sub_eq_zero_mul h]
  · rw [sub_self, sub_self, mul_zero]
  · exact left_distrib_mul_sub_aux ‹_›
  · rw [sub_self, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: right_distrib_mul_sub
statement: lemma right_distrib_mul_sub {n m k : ZFNat} : (m - k)*n = m*n - k*n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, left_distrib_mul_sub, mul_comm, mul_comm k]

name: add_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma add_eq_zero_iff {n m : ZFNat} : n + m = 0 ↔ n = 0 ∧ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      rw [zero_add] at h
      exact ⟨rfl, h⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        rw [add_zero] at h
        exact ⟨h, rfl⟩
      | succ m ih' =>
        rw [add_succ] at h
        nomatch succ_ne_zero _ h
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [zero_add]

name: mul_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma mul_eq_zero_iff {n m : ZFNat} : n * m = 0 ↔ n = 0 ∨ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n with
    | zero => left; rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      induction m with
      | zero => right; rfl
      | succ m ih' =>
        rw [←add_one_eq_succ, mul_succ, add_eq_zero_iff] at h
        nomatch succ_ne_zero _ h.2
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · rw [zero_mul]
    · rw [mul_zero]

name: eq_le_le_iff
statement: lemma eq_le_le_iff {n m : ZFNat} : n = m ↔ n ≤ m ∧ m ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
  · rintro ⟨n_le_m, m_le_n⟩
    rcases n_le_m with n_le_m | rfl
    · rcases m_le_n with m_le_n | rfl
      · nomatch lt_irrefl <| lt_trans n_le_m m_le_n
      · rfl
    · rfl

name: mul_left_cancel_iff
statement: lemma mul_left_cancel_iff {n m k : ZFNat} (k_pos : k ≠ 0) : k * m = k * n ↔ m = n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · induction n generalizing m with
    | zero =>
      intro hm
      rw [mul_zero, mul_eq_zero_iff] at hm
      rcases hm with rfl | rfl
      · contradiction
      · rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      intro eq
      cases m with
      | zero =>
        symm at eq
        rw [mul_zero, mul_eq_zero_iff] at eq
        rcases eq with rfl | eq
        · contradiction
        · nomatch succ_ne_zero _ eq
      | succ m =>
        congr
        rw [eq_le_le_iff]
        and_intros
        · have := zero_add ▸ @ZFNat.sub_eq_of_eq_add (k * m.succ) (k * n.succ) 0 <| eq
          rw [←left_distrib_mul_sub, mul_eq_zero_iff] at this
          rcases this with rfl | this
          · contradiction
          · rwa [ZFNat.succ_sub_succ, ZFNat.sub_eq_zero_imp_le] at this
        · have := zero_add ▸ @ZFNat.sub_eq_of_eq_add (k * n.succ) (k * m.succ) 0 <| eq.symm
          rw [←left_distrib_mul_sub, mul_eq_zero_iff] at this
          rcases this with rfl | this
          · contradiction
          · rwa [ZFNat.succ_sub_succ, ZFNat.sub_eq_zero_imp_le] at this
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

name: mul_right_cancel_iff
statement: lemma mul_right_cancel_iff {n m k : ZFNat} (k_pos : k ≠ 0) : m * k = n * k ↔ m = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm m k, mul_comm n k]
  exact mul_left_cancel_iff k_pos

name: pow_inst_eq
statement: lemma pow_inst_eq {n p : ZFNat} : n ^ p = n.pow p
proof: := rfl

name: pow_zero
statement: lemma pow_zero {n : ZFNat} : n ^ 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pow_inst_eq]
  rw [ZFNat.pow, rec_zero]

name: pow_one
statement: lemma pow_one {n : ZFNat} : n ^ 1 = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_inst_eq, ZFNat.pow, nat_one_eq, rec_succ, rec_zero, ← nat_one_eq, one_mul]

name: pow_succ
statement: lemma pow_succ {n p : ZFNat} : n ^ succ p = n ^ p * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_inst_eq, ZFNat.pow, ZFNat.rec_succ, ← ZFNat.pow, ← pow_inst_eq]

name: induction'
statement:
@[induction_eliminator]
theorem induction' {P : ZFNat → Prop} (n : ZFNat)
  (zero : P 0) (succ : ∀ n, P n → P (n + 1)) : P n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← add_one_eq_succ]
    exact succ n ih

name: toNat_is_id
statement: theorem toNat_is_id {n : ℕ} : (n : ZFNat).toNat = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => apply ZFNat.rec_zero
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ, ZFNat.toNat,
    ZFNat.rec_succ, ← ZFNat.toNat, ih]

name: Nat.is_transitive
statement: theorem Nat.is_transitive : transitive Nat
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  apply ZFNat.rec' n hn
  case zero => exact empty_subset Nat
  case succ =>
    intros x hx hx' z hz
    rw [mem_insert_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | hz
    · assumption
    · exact hx' hz

name: Nat.is_inductive
statement:
theorem Nat.is_inductive : inductive_set Nat where
  left
proof:
:= ZFNat.zero_in_Nat
  right := fun _ _ => ZFNat.succ_mem_Nat' ‹_›

name: ZFNat.ofNat_inj
statement:
theorem ZFNat.ofNat_inj {n m : ℕ} : (n : ZFNat) = (m : ZFNat) ↔ n = m where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro h
    induction n generalizing m with
    | zero =>
      conv_rhs at h =>
        unfold Nat.cast NatCast.natCast
      unfold_projs at h
      unfold Nat.unaryCast at h
      split at h
      · rfl
      · rw [ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ] at h
        nomatch ZFNat.succ_ne_zero _ h.symm
    | succ n ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero =>
        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero] at h
        rw [ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ] at h
        nomatch ZFNat.succ_ne_zero _ h
      | succ m =>
        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h
        rw [ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ, ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ] at h
        obtain rfl := ih <| ZFNat.succ_inj h
        rfl
  mpr := by
    rintro rfl
    rfl

name: ZFNat.toNat_eq
statement: theorem ZFNat.toNat_eq (n : ZFNat) : ZFNat.toNat n = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [ZFNat.toNat, ZFNat.rec_zero]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ, ZFNat.toNat, ZFNat.rec_succ, ←ZFNat.toNat]
    unfold Nat.cast
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.cast_add, ih, Nat.cast_one, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    rw [ZFNat.add_one_eq_succ]

name: ZFNat.toNat_iff
statement:
theorem ZFNat.toNat_iff {n m : ZFNat} : n = m ↔ n.toNat = m.toNat where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rintro rfl
    rfl
  mpr := by
    intro h
    induction n generalizing m with
    | zero =>
      cases m with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ m =>
        rw [toNat, ZFNat.rec_zero, toNat, ZFNat.rec_succ] at h
        nomatch Nat.succ_ne_zero _ h.symm
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [add_one_eq_succ, ZFNat.toNat, ZFNat.rec_succ] at h
      cases m with
      | zero =>
        rw [ZFNat.toNat, ZFNat.rec_zero] at h
        nomatch Nat.succ_ne_zero _ h
      | succ m =>
        rw [ZFNat.toNat, ZFNat.rec_succ, _root_.Nat.succ_inj, ←toNat, ←toNat] at h
        rw [add_one_eq_succ]
        obtain rfl := ih h
        rfl

name: toNat_zero
statement: theorem toNat_zero : (0 : ZFNat).toNat = 0
proof: := by rw [toNat, rec_zero]

name: toNat_succ
statement: theorem toNat_succ (a : ZFNat) : (succ a).toNat = a.toNat.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [toNat, ZFNat.rec_succ]
  rfl

name: toNat_one
statement: theorem toNat_one : (1 : ZFNat).toNat = 1
proof: := by rw [nat_one_eq, toNat_succ, toNat_zero]

name: toNat_pred
statement: theorem toNat_pred (a : ZFNat) : (pred a).toNat = a.toNat.pred
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a = 0
  · subst h
    rw [pred_zero, toNat_zero]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := not_zero_imp_succ h
    rw [pred_succ, toNat_succ, Nat.pred_succ]

name: toNat_add
statement: theorem toNat_add (a b : ZFNat) : (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat
proof:
:=
  ofNat_inj.mp (by rw [Nat.cast_add, toNat_eq, toNat_eq, toNat_eq])

name: toNat_mul
statement: theorem toNat_mul (a b : ZFNat) : (a * b).toNat = a.toNat * b.toNat
proof:
:=
  ofNat_inj.mp (by rw [Nat.cast_mul, toNat_eq, toNat_eq, toNat_eq])

name: toNat_sub
statement: theorem toNat_sub (a b : ZFNat) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => rw [sub_zero, toNat_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
  | succ b ih => rw [add_one_eq_succ, sub_succ, toNat_pred, ih, toNat_succ, Nat.sub_succ]

name: toNat_pow
statement: theorem toNat_pow (a b : ZFNat) : (a ^ b).toNat = a.toNat ^ b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, toNat_one, toNat_zero, Nat.pow_zero]
  | succ b ih => rw [add_one_eq_succ, pow_succ, toNat_mul, ih, toNat_succ, Nat.pow_succ]

name: toNat_le
statement:
theorem toNat_le (a b : ZFNat) : a ≤ b ↔ a.toNat ≤ b.toNat where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := le.dest h
    rw [toNat_add]
    exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  mpr h := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Nat.le.dest h
    refine le.intro (k := (j : ZFNat)) (toNat_iff.mpr ?_)
    rw [toNat_add, toNat_is_id, hj]

name: toNat_lt
statement: theorem toNat_lt (a b : ZFNat) : a < b ↔ a.toNat < b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_lt_iff, toNat_le, toNat_succ, Nat.succ_le_iff]

name: ringEquivNat_succ
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem ringEquivNat_succ (a : ZFNat) :
    ringEquivNat (succ a) = (ringEquivNat a).succ
proof: := toNat_succ a

name: ringEquivNat_sub
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem ringEquivNat_sub (a b : ZFNat) :
    ringEquivNat (a - b) = ringEquivNat a - ringEquivNat b
proof: := toNat_sub a b

name: ringEquivNat_pow
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem ringEquivNat_pow (a b : ZFNat) :
    ringEquivNat (a ^ b) = ringEquivNat a ^ ringEquivNat b
proof: := toNat_pow a b

name: ringEquivNat_dvd
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem ringEquivNat_dvd (a b : ZFNat) :
    a ∣ b ↔ ringEquivNat a ∣ ringEquivNat b
proof: := (map_dvd_iff ringEquivNat).symm

name: ringEquivNat_le
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem ringEquivNat_le (a b : ZFNat) :
    a ≤ b ↔ ringEquivNat a ≤ ringEquivNat b
proof: := toNat_le a b

name: ringEquivNat_lt
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem ringEquivNat_lt (a b : ZFNat) :
    a < b ↔ ringEquivNat a < ringEquivNat b
proof: := toNat_lt a b

name: qrel_eq
statement:
protected theorem qrel_eq : Equivalence ZFSet.qrel where
  refl x
proof:
:= ZFInt.mul_comm x.1 x.2
  symm h := by
    unfold ZFSet.qrel at h ⊢
    rw [ZFInt.mul_comm, ←h, ZFInt.mul_comm]
  trans := by
    rintro ⟨p, q, hq⟩ ⟨u, v, hv⟩ ⟨s, t, ht⟩ hpq huv
    dsimp [ZFSet.qrel] at hpq huv ⊢
    
    have : p * t * u * v = q * s * u * v := by
      suffices p * v * u * t = q * u * s * v by
        rw [
          mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
          mul_comm t, mul_comm u,
          ←mul_assoc, ←mul_assoc,
          this,
          mul_assoc, mul_assoc,
          mul_comm u, mul_assoc, mul_comm v,
          ←mul_assoc, ←mul_assoc]
      rw [hpq, mul_assoc, huv, mul_comm v s, ← mul_assoc]
    conv at this =>
      conv => lhs; rw [mul_assoc]
      conv => rhs; rw [mul_assoc]
    by_cases u_mul_v : u * v = 0
    · rw [ZFInt.mul_comm] at u_mul_v
      obtain ⟨⟩ := ZFInt.mul_eq_zero_of_ne_zero u_mul_v hv
      rw [ZFInt.mul_zero, ZFInt.mul_comm] at hpq
      obtain ⟨⟩ := ZFInt.mul_eq_zero_of_ne_zero hpq hv
      rw [ZFInt.zero_mul] at huv
      symm at huv
      obtain ⟨⟩ := ZFInt.mul_eq_zero_of_ne_zero huv hv
      rw [ZFInt.mul_zero, ZFInt.zero_mul]
    · rwa [ZFInt.mul_right_cancel_iff u_mul_v] at this

name: mk_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq (x : ZFInt × ZFInt') : @Eq ZFRat ⟦x⟧ (mk x)
proof: := rfl

name: mk_out
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_out : ∀ x : ZFRat, mk x.out = x
proof: := Quotient.out_eq

name: eq
statement: theorem eq {x y : ZFInt × ZFInt'} : mk x = mk y ↔ ZFSet.qrel x y
proof: := Quotient.eq

name: sound
statement: theorem sound {x y : ZFInt × ZFInt'} (h : ZFSet.qrel x y) : mk x = mk y
proof: := Quotient.sound h

name: exact
statement: theorem exact {x y : ZFInt × ZFInt'} : mk x = mk y → ZFSet.qrel x y
proof: := Quotient.exact

name: zero_eq
statement: theorem zero_eq : (0 : ZFRat) = mk (0, ⟨1, ZFInt.one_ne_zero⟩)
proof: := rfl

name: one_eq
statement: theorem one_eq : (1 : ZFRat) = mk (1, ⟨1, ZFInt.one_ne_zero⟩)
proof: := rfl

name: mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_iff {n m} : ZFRat.mk (n,m) = 0 ↔ n = 0 where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro h
    rw [zero_eq, eq, ZFSet.qrel] at h
    simpa only [mul_one, ne_eq, mul_zero] using h
  mpr := by
    rintro rfl
    apply ZFRat.sound
    rw [ZFSet.qrel, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: mk_ne_zero
statement: theorem mk_ne_zero {a : ZFInt} {b : ZFInt'} (ha : a ≠ 0) : mk (a, b) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, mk_eq_zero_iff]
  exact ha

name: mk_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_one_iff {n m} : ZFRat.mk (n,m) = 1 ↔ n = m where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    intro h
    rw [one_eq, eq, ZFSet.qrel] at h
    simpa only [ne_eq, mul_one] using h
  mpr := by
    rintro rfl
    apply ZFRat.sound
    rw [ZFSet.qrel, mul_one]

name: one_ne_zero
statement: theorem one_ne_zero : (1 : ZFRat) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [one_eq, zero_eq, eq, ZFSet.qrel, mul_one, mul_zero] at h
  nomatch ZFInt.one_ne_zero h

name: add_eq
statement:
theorem add_eq (n m : ZFInt × ZFInt') :
  mk n + mk m = mk (n.1 * m.2 + n.2 * m.1,
    ⟨n.2.1 * m.2.1, fun c ↦ nomatch m.2.2 (ZFInt.mul_eq_zero_of_ne_zero c n.2.2)⟩)
proof: := rfl

name: add_assoc
statement: theorem add_assoc (n m k : ZFRat) : n + (m + k) = n + m + k
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Quotient.ind
  induction m using Quotient.ind
  induction k using Quotient.ind
  rename_i n m k
  obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn₂⟩ := n
  obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm₂⟩ := m
  obtain ⟨k₁, k₂, hk₂⟩ := k
  apply ZFRat.sound
  ring

name: add_comm
statement: theorem add_comm (n m : ZFRat) : n + m = m + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Quotient.ind
  induction m using Quotient.ind
  rename_i n m
  obtain ⟨n₁, n₂, hn₂⟩ := n
  obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, hm₂⟩ := m
  apply ZFRat.sound
  ring

name: add_left_comm
statement: lemma add_left_comm (n m k : ZFRat) : n + (m + k) = m + (n + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc, add_assoc, add_comm n]

name: add_right_comm
statement: lemma add_right_comm (n m k : ZFRat) : (n + m) + k = (n + k) + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_assoc, add_comm m, add_assoc]

name: add_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_zero {x : ZFRat} : x + 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.ind
  simp_rw [mk_eq, zero_eq, ZFRat.add_eq, mul_one, ne_eq, mul_zero, ZFInt.add_zero]

name: zero_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_add {x : ZFRat} : 0 + x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, add_zero]

name: neg_eq
statement: theorem neg_eq (n : ZFInt × ZFInt') : -mk n = mk (-n.1, n.2)
