  exact Or.inl rfl

name: top_eq_true
statement: @[simp] theorem top_eq_true : ⊤ = true
proof: := rfl

name: bot_eq_false
statement: @[simp] theorem bot_eq_false : ⊥ = false
proof: := rfl

name: true_ne_false
statement: theorem true_ne_false : (⊤ : ZFBool) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [top_eq_true, bot_eq_false] at h
  injection h with h
  nomatch zftrue_ne_zffalse h

name: mem_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_𝔹_iff (p : ZFSet) : p ∈ 𝔹 ↔ p = zffalse ∨ p = zftrue
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton]

name: powerset_false
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerset_false : zffalse.powerset = zftrue
proof:
:= by
  unfold zftrue zffalse
  ext x
  simp only [mem_powerset, mem_singleton]
  apply Iff.intro
  · exact subset_of_empty
  · exact (subset_of_subset_of_eq (fun _ a => a) ·)

name: powerset_
statement:
theorem powerset_𝔹_def :
  ZFSet.𝔹.powerset = {∅, {ZFSet.zffalse}, {ZFSet.zftrue}, {ZFSet.zffalse, ZFSet.zftrue}}
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [ZFSet.mem_powerset, ZFSet.𝔹] at h
    simp_rw [ZFSet.mem_insert_iff, ZFSet.mem_singleton]
    by_cases hx : x = ∅
    · left; exact hx
    · right
      by_cases hx' : ZFSet.zffalse ∈ x
      · rw [← or_assoc, or_comm, ← or_assoc]
        left
        by_cases hx'' : ZFSet.zftrue ∈ x
        · left
          ext1 s
          constructor
          · intro hs; exact h hs
          · intro hs; rcases (ZFSet.ZFBool.mem_𝔹_iff s).mp hs with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
        · right
          ext1 s
          constructor
          · intro hs
            rw [ZFSet.mem_singleton]
            rcases ZFSet.ZFBool.mem_𝔹_iff s |>.mp (h hs) with rfl | rfl <;> trivial
          · intro hs
            rcases ZFSet.mem_singleton.mp hs
            exact hx'
      · by_cases hx'' : ZFSet.zftrue ∈ x
        · right
          left
          ext1 s
          constructor
          · intro hs
            rw [ZFSet.mem_singleton]
            rcases (ZFSet.ZFBool.mem_𝔹_iff s).mp (h hs) with rfl | rfl <;> trivial
          · intro hs
            rcases ZFSet.mem_singleton.mp hs
            exact hx''
        · simp_rw [ZFSet.subset_def, ZFSet.ZFBool.mem_𝔹_iff] at h
          obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := nonempty_exists_iff.mp hx
          rcases h hw with rfl | rfl <;> contradiction
  · intro hx
    simp_rw [ZFSet.mem_insert_iff, ZFSet.mem_singleton] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rw [ZFSet.mem_powerset]
    · exact ZFSet.empty_subset ZFSet.𝔹
    · intro _ hx
      rw [ZFSet.ZFBool.mem_𝔹_iff]
      rcases ZFSet.mem_singleton.mp hx
      left; rfl
    · intro _ hx
      rw [ZFSet.ZFBool.mem_𝔹_iff]
      rcases ZFSet.mem_singleton.mp hx
      right; rfl

name: casesOn_of_false
statement:
@[simp]
theorem casesOn_of_false {motive : ZFBool → Sort*}
  (false_case : motive ⊥) (true_case : motive ⊤) :
    ZFBool.casesOn ⊥ false_case true_case = false_case
proof:
:= by
  rw [casesOn]
  dsimp only
  split
  · rfl
  · exact absurd rfl ‹_›

name: casesOn_of_true
statement:
@[simp]
theorem casesOn_of_true {motive : ZFBool → Sort*}
  (false_case : motive ⊥) (true_case : motive ⊤) :
    ZFBool.casesOn ⊤ false_case true_case = true_case
proof:
:= by
  rw [casesOn]
  dsimp only
  split
  · exact absurd ‹_› zftrue_ne_zffalse
  · rfl

name: casesOn_unique
statement:
theorem casesOn_unique {motive : ZFBool → Sort*}
  (false_case : motive ⊥) (true_case : motive ⊤) (g : Π p, motive p)
  (hfalse : g ⊥ = false_case) (htrue : g ⊤ = true_case) (p : ZFBool) :
    g p = ZFBool.casesOn p false_case true_case
proof:
:= by
  cases p using ZFBool.casesOn with
  | false => rw [hfalse, casesOn_of_false]
  | true => rw [htrue, casesOn_of_true]

name: not_true_eq_false
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_true_eq_false : ZFBool.not ⊤ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  rw [mem_symmDiff]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨l, r⟩ | ⟨l, r⟩) <;> nomatch r l
  · intro h
    nomatch notMem_empty _ h

name: not_false_eq_true
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_false_eq_true : ZFBool.not ⊥ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  rw [mem_symmDiff]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨l, r⟩ | ⟨l, r⟩)
    · exact l
    · nomatch notMem_empty _ l
  · intro h
    left
    exact ⟨h, notMem_empty _⟩

name: and_comm
statement: theorem and_comm (p q : ZFBool) : p ⋀ q = q ⋀ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := q
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  repeat rw [mem_inter]
  exact And.comm

name: and_assoc
statement: theorem and_assoc (p q r : ZFBool) : p ⋀ q ⋀ r = p ⋀ (q ⋀ r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := q
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := r
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  repeat rw [mem_inter]
  exact _root_.and_assoc

name: and_true
statement:
@[simp]
theorem and_true (p : ZFBool) : p ⋀ ⊤ = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := p
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  rw [mem_inter]
  rw [mem_𝔹_iff] at hP
  rw [and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  intro h
  cases hP
  · subst_eqs
    simp only [notMem_empty] at h
  · subst_eqs
    assumption

name: and_false
statement:
@[simp]
theorem and_false (p : ZFBool) : p ⋀ ⊥ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := p
  ext
  rw [mem_inter]
  rw [mem_𝔹_iff] at hP
  rcases hP with rfl | rfl
  · exact and_iff_left_of_imp id
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, h⟩
      exact h
    · intro h
      nomatch notMem_empty _ h

name: and_iff
statement: theorem and_iff (p q : ZFBool) : p ⋀ q = ⊤ ↔ p = ⊤ ∧ q = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases q using casesOn with
    | false =>
      rw [and_false] at h
      nomatch true_ne_false h.symm
    | true => exact ⟨and_true p ▸ h, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl,rfl⟩)
    rw [and_true]

name: or_comm
statement: theorem or_comm (p q : ZFBool) : p ⋁ q = q ⋁ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := q
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  repeat rw [mem_union]
  exact Or.comm

name: or_assoc
statement: theorem or_assoc (p q r : ZFBool) : p ⋁ q ⋁ r = p ⋁ (q ⋁ r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := q
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := r
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  repeat rw [mem_union]
  exact _root_.or_assoc

name: or_true
statement: theorem or_true (p : ZFBool) : p ⋁ ⊤ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := p
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  rw [mem_union]
  rw [mem_𝔹_iff] at hP
  cases hP <;> subst_eqs
  · simp only [notMem_empty, mem_singleton, false_or, top_eq_true]
  · exact or_iff_left_of_imp id

name: or_false
statement: theorem or_false (p : ZFBool) : p ⋁ ⊥ = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := p
  rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  ext1
  rw [mem_union]
  rw [mem_𝔹_iff] at hP
  cases hP <;> subst_eqs
  · rw [or_self]
  · simp only [notMem_empty, _root_.or_false]

name: or_iff
statement: theorem or_iff (p q : ZFBool) : p ⋁ q = ⊤ ↔ p = ⊤ ∨ q = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases p using casesOn with
    | false =>
      rw [or_comm, or_false] at h
      exact Or.inr h
    | true => exact Or.inl rfl
  · intro h
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · rw [or_comm, or_true]
    · rw [or_true]

name: toBool_false
statement: theorem toBool_false : toBool ⊥ = Bool.false
proof:
:= by
  rw [toBool]
  split_ifs with h h'
  · nomatch zftrue_ne_zffalse h.symm
  · rfl
  · nomatch h'

name: toBool_true
statement: theorem toBool_true : toBool ⊤ = Bool.true
proof:
:= by
  rw [toBool]
  split_ifs with h h'
  · rfl
  · nomatch h rfl
  · nomatch h'

name: toBool_and
statement: theorem toBool_and (p q : ZFBool) : (p ⋀ q).toBool = (p.toBool && q.toBool)
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> cases q
  · rw [and_false, toBool_false, Bool.false_and]
  · rw [and_true, toBool_true, toBool_false, Bool.false_and]
  · rw [and_false, toBool_true, toBool_false, Bool.and_false]
  · rw [and_true, toBool_true, Bool.true_and]

name: toBool_or
statement: theorem toBool_or (p q : ZFBool) : (p ⋁ q).toBool = (p.toBool || q.toBool)
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> cases q
  · rw [or_false, toBool_false, Bool.false_or]
  · rw [or_true, toBool_true, toBool_false, Bool.or_true]
  · rw [or_false, toBool_true, toBool_false, Bool.true_or]
  · rw [or_true, toBool_true, Bool.true_or]

name: toBool_not
statement: theorem toBool_not (p : ZFBool) : toBool p.not = ¬ p.toBool
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  · rw [not_false_eq_true, toBool_true, toBool_false, Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.coe_sort_true]
    exact _root_.not_false_eq_true.symm
  · rw [not_true_eq_false, toBool_false, toBool_true, Bool.coe_false]
    exact eq_false (fun h => h rfl) |>.symm

name: not_top_iff_bot
statement: theorem not_top_iff_bot {P : ZFBool} : P ≠ ⊤ ↔ P = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    cases P <;> trivial
  · intro _ h
    subst P
    injections h
    nomatch zftrue_ne_zffalse h.symm

name: not_bot_iff_top
statement: theorem not_bot_iff_top {P : ZFBool} : P ≠ ⊥ ↔ P = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    cases P <;> trivial
  · intro _ h
    subst P
    injections h
    nomatch zftrue_ne_zffalse h

name: mem_ofBool_
statement: theorem mem_ofBool_𝔹 (b : Bool) : (ofBool b).val ∈ 𝔹
proof:
:= by
  unfold 𝔹
  rcases b <;> simp [ofBool]

name: sub_ofBool_singleton_
statement: theorem sub_ofBool_singleton_𝔹 (b : Bool) : {(ofBool b).val} ⊆ 𝔹
proof:
:= by
  intro
  rw [mem_singleton]
  rintro rfl
  exact mem_ofBool_𝔹 b

name: to_Bool_ofBool
statement: theorem to_Bool_ofBool (b : Bool) : ZFBool.toBool (ofBool b) = b
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> rw [ofBool, ZFBool.toBool]
  · split_ifs with h
    · nomatch zftrue_ne_zffalse.symm h
    · rfl
    · generalize_proofs
      contradiction
  · split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · contradiction
    · generalize_proofs
      contradiction

name: of_Bool_toBool
statement: theorem of_Bool_toBool (b : ZFBool) : ofBool b.toBool = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := b
  rw [ZFBool.toBool, ofBool.eq_def]
  split_ifs with h <;> (first | subst b | contradiction) <;> trivial

name: ofBool_decide_eq_true_iff
statement: theorem ofBool_decide_eq_true_iff {P : Prop} [Decidable P] : ofBool (decide P) = ⊤ ↔ P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hP : decide P with
    | false =>
      rw [hP] at h
      unfold ofBool at h
      injection h with h
      nomatch zftrue_ne_zffalse h.symm
    | true => exact decide_eq_true_eq.mp hP
  · intro h
    cases hP : decide P with
    | false =>
      rw [Bool.decide_false_iff] at hP
      contradiction
    | true => rfl

name: ofBool_decide_eq_false_iff
statement: theorem ofBool_decide_eq_false_iff {P : Prop} [Decidable P] : ofBool (decide P) = ⊥ ↔ ¬P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hP : decide P with
    | false => exact decide_eq_false_iff_not.mp hP
    | true =>
      rw [hP] at h
      unfold ofBool at h
      injection h with h
      nomatch zftrue_ne_zffalse h
  · intro h
    cases hP : decide P with
    | false => rfl
    | true =>
      rw [Bool.decide_iff] at hP
      contradiction

name: and_coe
statement: theorem and_coe (p q : ZFBool) : p ⋀ q = ((p : Bool) && (q : Bool))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toBool_and, of_Bool_toBool]

name: or_coe
statement: theorem or_coe (p q : ZFBool) : p ⋁ q = ((p : Bool) || (q : Bool))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toBool_or, of_Bool_toBool]

name: not_coe
statement: theorem not_coe (p : ZFBool) : ZFBool.not p = ¬(p : Bool)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toBool_not]

name: and_or_distrib_left
statement: theorem and_or_distrib_left (p q r : ZFBool) : p ⋀ (q ⋁ r) = (p ⋀ q) ⋁ (p ⋀ r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [and_coe, or_coe, and_coe, and_coe, or_coe]
  iterate 3 rw [to_Bool_ofBool]
  rw [Bool.and_or_distrib_left]

name: toBool_eq_iff
statement:
@[transfer_simps↓]
theorem toBool_eq_iff (p : ZFBool) (b : Bool) : p.toBool = b ↔ p = ofBool b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    rw [of_Bool_toBool]
  · rintro rfl
    rw [to_Bool_ofBool]

name: ofBool_inj
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem ofBool_inj (b c : Bool) : ofBool b = ofBool c ↔ b = c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← to_Bool_ofBool b, ← to_Bool_ofBool c, h]
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

name: ofBool_true
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem ofBool_true : ofBool Bool.true = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: ofBool_false
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem ofBool_false : ofBool Bool.false = ⊥
proof: := rfl

name: toBool_eq_equivBool
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem toBool_eq_equivBool (p : ZFBool) : p.toBool = equivBool p
proof: := rfl

name: equivBool_ofBool
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivBool_ofBool (b : Bool) : equivBool (ofBool b) = b
proof:
:=
  to_Bool_ofBool b

name: equivBool_true
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivBool_true : equivBool ZFBool.true = Bool.true
proof: := toBool_true

name: equivBool_false
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivBool_false : equivBool ZFBool.false = Bool.false
proof: := toBool_false

name: equivBool_top
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivBool_top : equivBool (⊤ : ZFBool) = Bool.true
proof: := toBool_true

name: equivBool_bot
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivBool_bot : equivBool (⊥ : ZFBool) = Bool.false
proof: := toBool_false

name: equivBool_and
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem equivBool_and (p q : ZFBool) :
    equivBool (no_index (p ⋀ q)) = (equivBool p && equivBool q)
proof: := toBool_and p q

name: equivBool_or
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem equivBool_or (p q : ZFBool) :
    equivBool (no_index (p ⋁ q)) = (equivBool p || equivBool q)
proof: := toBool_or p q

name: equivBool_not
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem equivBool_not (p : ZFBool) :
    equivBool (no_index p.not) = !equivBool p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | false => rw [not_false_eq_true, equivBool_top, equivBool_bot]; rfl
  | true => rw [not_true_eq_false, equivBool_bot, equivBool_top]; rfl

name: equivProp_apply
statement: theorem equivProp_apply (p : ZFBool) : equivProp p = (p.toBool = Bool.true)
proof: := rfl

name: equivProp_ofBool
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivProp_ofBool (b : Bool) : equivProp (ofBool b) ↔ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivProp_apply, to_Bool_ofBool]

name: equivProp_top
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivProp_top : equivProp (⊤ : ZFBool) ↔ True
proof:
:=
  iff_of_true toBool_true trivial

name: equivProp_bot
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivProp_bot : equivProp (⊥ : ZFBool) ↔ False
proof:
:= by
  change (⊥ : ZFBool).toBool = Bool.true ↔ False
  rw [toBool_false]
  exact iff_of_false Bool.false_ne_true not_false

name: equivProp_true
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivProp_true : equivProp ZFBool.true ↔ True
proof: := equivProp_top

name: equivProp_false
statement: @[transfer_simps] theorem equivProp_false : equivProp ZFBool.false ↔ False
proof: := equivProp_bot

name: equivProp_and
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem equivProp_and (p q : ZFBool) :
    equivProp (no_index (p ⋀ q)) ↔ (equivProp p ∧ equivProp q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivProp_apply, equivProp_apply, equivProp_apply, toBool_and, Bool.and_eq_true]

name: equivProp_or
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem equivProp_or (p q : ZFBool) :
    equivProp (no_index (p ⋁ q)) ↔ (equivProp p ∨ equivProp q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivProp_apply, equivProp_apply, equivProp_apply, toBool_or, Bool.or_eq_true]

name: equivProp_not
statement:
@[transfer_simps] theorem equivProp_not (p : ZFBool) :
    equivProp (no_index p.not) ↔ ¬ equivProp p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | false => rw [not_false_eq_true, equivProp_top, equivProp_bot]; simp
  | true => rw [not_true_eq_false, equivProp_bot, equivProp_top]; simp

name: equivZFRelation_related
statement:
theorem equivZFRelation_related (E : ZFSet) (R : { R : ZFSet // R ⊆ E.prod E }) (x y : E) :
    E.equivZFRelation R x y = (x.val.pair y.val ∈ R.val)
proof:
:= by
  unfold equivZFRelation
  dsimp

name: equivZFRelation_Reflexivity
statement:
theorem equivZFRelation_Reflexivity (E : ZFSet) (R : { R : ZFSet // R ⊆ E.prod E }) :
    (∀ x, E.equivZFRelation R x x) = is_rel_reflexive R.val R.prop
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    rw [is_rel_reflexive_iff]
    left
    conv => ext x ; rw [equivZFRelation_related]
    rw [Subtype.forall]

name: equivZFRelation_Symmetry
statement:
theorem equivZFRelation_Symmetry (E : ZFSet) (R : { R : ZFSet // R ⊆ E.prod E }) :
    (∀ x y, E.equivZFRelation R x y → E.equivZFRelation R y x) = is_rel_symmetric R.val R.prop
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    rw [is_rel_symmetric_iff _ R.prop]
    left
    conv => enter [x, y] ; rw [equivZFRelation_related, equivZFRelation_related]
    repeat rw [Subtype.forall] ; ext v ; (conv => repeat rw [forall_comm] ; ext _)
    dsimp only
    rw [←and_imp, ←pair_mem_prod, ←and_imp, and_iff_right_of_imp (R.prop ·)]
  ext
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    exact ⟨(h x y ·), (h y x ·)⟩
  · intro h x y
    exact Iff.mp <| h x y

name: equivZFRelation_Transitivity
statement:
theorem equivZFRelation_Transitivity (E : ZFSet) (R : { R : ZFSet // R ⊆ E.prod E }) :
    (∀ x y z, E.equivZFRelation R x y → E.equivZFRelation R y z → E.equivZFRelation R x z)
      = is_rel_transitive R.val R.prop
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    rw [is_rel_transitive_iff _ R.prop]
    left
    conv =>
      enter [_, _, _]
      rw [equivZFRelation_related, equivZFRelation_related, equivZFRelation_related]
    repeat
      rw [Subtype.forall]
      ext x
      conv => repeat
        rw [forall_comm]
        ext h
        conv => pattern (occs := *) _ → _ → _
    dsimp only
    rw [←and_imp, ←and_imp, and_assoc, ←and_imp, ←and_imp, and_assoc]
    left
    conv =>
      left
      conv => enter [2, 1] ; rw [←and_self (_ ∈ E)]
      rw [and_assoc, ←pair_mem_prod, ←and_assoc, ←pair_mem_prod]
    rw [and_iff_right_of_imp fun ⟨l,r⟩ => ⟨R.prop l, R.prop r⟩]

name: equivZFRelation_Equivalence
statement:
theorem equivZFRelation_Equivalence (E : ZFSet) (R : { R : ZFSet // R ⊆ E.prod E }) :
    Equivalence (E.equivZFRelation R) = is_rel_equivalence R.val R.prop
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [is_rel_equivalence, ←equivZFRelation_Reflexivity, ←equivZFRelation_Symmetry,
    ←equivZFRelation_Transitivity]
  constructor <;> intro ⟨r, s, t⟩ <;> [split_ands ; constructor] <;> assumption

name: ZFEquiv_of_Equivalence
statement:
theorem ZFEquiv_of_Equivalence (E : ZFSet) (r : E → E → Prop) (re : Equivalence r) :
    (E.equivZFRelation.symm r).val.is_rel_equivalence (E.equivZFRelation.symm r).prop
proof:
:=
  (equivZFRelation_Equivalence E (E.equivZFRelation.symm r)).mp
    ( by rw [@Equiv.apply_symm_apply] ; exact re)

name: mem_class_of_self
statement:
theorem mem_class_of_self (hrR : R ⊆ E.prod E := by zrel)
  (heR : R.is_rel_equivalence hrR := by assumption) (x : E) :
    x.val ∈ (class_of hrR heR x).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [class_of, mem_sep]
  constructor
  · exact x.prop
  · rw [is_rel_equivalence, R.is_rel_reflexive_iff] at heR
    exact heR.left x x.prop

name: mem_class_of_iff_related
statement:
theorem mem_class_of_iff_related (hrR : R ⊆ E.prod E := by zrel)
  (heR : R.is_rel_equivalence hrR := by assumption) (x : E) (y : ZFSet) :
    y ∈ (class_of hrR heR x).val ↔ y.pair x.val ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [class_of, mem_sep, and_iff_right_of_imp (And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hrR ·)]
  rw [is_rel_equivalence, R.is_rel_symmetric_iff hrR] at heR
  exact heR.right.left x y

name: class_of_mem_eq_self
statement:
theorem class_of_mem_eq_self (hrR : R ⊆ E.prod E := by zrel)
  (heR : R.is_rel_equivalence hrR := by assumption) (C : E.ZFQuotient R) (x : C.val) :
    class_of hrR heR (of_in_class x) = C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := C
  obtain ⟨hC', ⟨z,hz,extC⟩⟩ := mem_sep.mp hC
  rw [of_in_class, class_of]
  ext y
  dsimp only
  rw [mem_sep, and_iff_right_of_imp (And.right <| pair_mem_prod.mp <| hrR ·)]
  rw [extC]
  rw [is_rel_equivalence, R.is_rel_transitive_iff, R.is_rel_symmetric_iff] at heR
  let ⟨r, s, t⟩ := heR
  constructor
  · intro xy_related
    exact t z x y ⟨(extC x |>.mp hx), xy_related⟩
  · intro zy_related
    exact t x z y ⟨s z x |>.mp (extC x |>.mp hx), zy_related⟩

name: class_eq_iff_related
statement:
theorem class_eq_iff_related (hrR : R ⊆ E.prod E := by zrel)
  (heR : R.is_rel_equivalence hrR := by assumption) (x y : E) :
    class_of hrR heR x = class_of hrR heR y ↔ x.val.pair y.val ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [←mem_class_of_iff_related hrR heR, ←h]
    exact mem_class_of_self hrR heR x
  · intro xy_related
    obtain ⟨x, x_E⟩ := x
    rw [←mem_class_of_iff_related hrR heR] at xy_related
    change class_of _ _ (of_in_class ⟨x, xy_related⟩) = _
    rw [class_of_mem_eq_self hrR heR]

name: lift_class_of
statement:
theorem lift_class_of (hrR : R ⊆ E.prod E := by zrel)
(heR : R.is_rel_equivalence hrR := by assumption) (f : E → α)
(h : ∀ a b, a.val.pair b.val ∈ R → f a = f b) (x : E) :
    lift f h (class_of hrR heR x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  apply h
  rw [of_in_class, ←mem_class_of_iff_related hrR heR]
  exact Subtype.prop <| choose_repr <| class_of _ _ x

name: embedding_symm
statement: theorem embedding_symm {A B : ZFSet} : A ↪ᶻ B ↔ B ↩ᶻ A
proof: := id Iff.rfl

name: embedding_singleton
statement: theorem embedding_singleton {x y : ZFSet} : {x} ↪ᶻ {y}
proof:
:= by
  use {x.pair y}, ?_
  · intro a b c ha hb hc ac bc
    rw [mem_singleton] at ha hb hc
    subst a b c
    rfl
  · and_intros
    · intro z hz
      rw [mem_singleton] at hz
      subst z
      rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_singleton, mem_singleton]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · intro z hz
      rw [mem_singleton] at hz
      subst z
      use y
      and_intros
      · beta_reduce
        rw [mem_singleton]
      · intro z hz
        rw [mem_singleton, pair_inj] at hz
        obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := hz
        rfl

name: embedding_pair
statement: theorem embedding_pair (a b c d : ZFSet) (hab_cd : a = b ↔ c = d) : {a, b} ↪ᶻ {c, d}
proof:
:= by
  use {a.pair c, b.pair d}, ?_
  · intro x y z hx hy hz xy yz
    rw [mem_pair] at hx hy hz xy yz
    simp_rw [pair_inj] at xy yz
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hy with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hz with rfl | rfl <;> try rfl
    · rcases xy with ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ <;> rcases yz with ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ <;> try rfl
      rw [hab_cd]
    · rcases xy with ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ <;> rcases yz with ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ <;> try rfl
      rw [hab_cd]
    · rcases xy with ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ <;> rcases yz with ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ <;> try rfl
      symm
      rw [hab_cd]
    · rcases xy with ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ <;> rcases yz with ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ <;> try rfl
      symm
      rw [hab_cd]
  · and_intros
    · intro z hz
      rw [mem_pair] at hz
      rcases hz with rfl | rfl
      · simp_rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_pair]
        and_intros <;> (left; trivial)
      · simp_rw [pair_mem_prod, mem_pair]
        and_intros <;> (right; trivial)
    · intro z hz
      rw [mem_pair] at hz
      rcases hz with rfl | rfl
      · by_cases hc : c = d
        · subst c
          rw [eq_self, iff_true] at hab_cd
          subst z
          simp only [pair_eq_singleton, mem_singleton, pair_inj, true_and, existsUnique_eq]
        · simp only [hc, iff_false] at hab_cd
          use c
          and_intros
          · beta_reduce
            rw [mem_pair]
            left
            rfl
          · intro y hy
            rw [mem_pair, pair_inj] at hy
            rcases hy with ⟨_, rfl⟩ | eq
            · rfl
            · rw [pair_inj] at eq
              obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq
              nomatch hab_cd rfl
      · by_cases hc : c = d
        · subst c
          rw [eq_self, iff_true] at hab_cd
          subst z
          simp only [pair_eq_singleton, mem_singleton, pair_inj, true_and, existsUnique_eq]
        · simp only [hc, iff_false] at hab_cd
          use d
          and_intros
          · beta_reduce
            rw [mem_pair]
            right
            rfl
          · intro y hy
            rw [mem_pair, pair_inj] at hy
            rcases hy with ⟨rfl, _⟩ | eq
            · nomatch hab_cd rfl
            · rw [pair_inj] at eq
              exact eq.2

name: embedding_refl
statement: theorem embedding_refl (A : ZFSet) : A ↪ᶻ A
proof:
:= by
  use A.Id, Id.IsFunc
  intro x y z hx hy hz xz yz
  rw [pair_mem_Id_iff] at xz yz
  · subst x y
    rfl
  · exact hy
  · exact hx

name: embedding_trans
statement: theorem embedding_trans {A B C : ZFSet} (hAB : A ↪ᶻ B) (hBC : B ↪ᶻ C) : A ↪ᶻ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, injf⟩ := hAB
  obtain ⟨g, hg, injg⟩ := hBC
  use composition g f A B C, IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hg hf
  intro x y z hx hy hz xz yz
  simp only [mem_composition, pair_inj, existsAndEq, and_true,
    exists_and_left, exists_eq_left'] at xz yz
  obtain ⟨xA, zC, w, wB, xw, wz⟩ := xz
  obtain ⟨-, -, w', w'B, xw', w'z⟩ := yz
  obtain rfl := injg _ _ _ wB w'B hz wz w'z
  obtain rfl := injf _ _ _ hx hy wB xw xw'
  rfl

name: succFun_is_func
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem succFun_is_func : IsFunc Nat Nat succFun
proof:
:=
  lambda_isFunc fun hn => ZFNat.succ_mem_Nat' hn

name: succFun_is_pfunc
statement: theorem succFun_is_pfunc : succFun.IsPFunc Nat Nat
proof: := is_func_is_pfunc succFun_is_func

name: succFun_mem_funs
statement: theorem succFun_mem_funs : succFun ∈ funs Nat Nat
proof: := mem_funs.mpr succFun_is_func

name: fapply_succFun
statement:
theorem fapply_succFun {n : ZFSet} (hn : n ∈ Nat) :
    fapply succFun succFun_is_pfunc ⟨n, by zdom⟩
      = ⟨insert n n, ZFNat.succ_mem_Nat' hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  have key : n.pair (insert n n) ∈ succFun := by
    rw [succFun, lambda_spec]
    exact ⟨hn, ZFNat.succ_mem_Nat' hn, rfl⟩
  rw [fapply.of_pair succFun_is_pfunc key]

name: recVal_zero
statement:
theorem recVal_zero {X : ZFSet} {x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s) :
    recVal x s hx hs 0 = ⟨x, hx⟩
proof: := ZFNat.rec_zero ..

name: recVal_succ
statement:
theorem recVal_succ {X : ZFSet} {x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s) (n : ZFNat) :
    recVal x s hx hs n.succ
      = @ᶻs ⟨(recVal x s hx hs n).val, by zdom⟩
proof:
:=
  ZFNat.rec_succ ..

name: recFun_is_func
statement:
@[zfun]
theorem recFun_is_func {X : ZFSet} {x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s) :
    IsFunc Nat X (recFun x s hx hs)
proof:
:= by
  apply lambda_isFunc
  intro n hn
  rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hn)]
  exact Subtype.property _

name: recFun_is_pfunc
statement:
theorem recFun_is_pfunc {X : ZFSet} {x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s) :
    (recFun x s hx hs).IsPFunc Nat X
proof: := is_func_is_pfunc (recFun_is_func hx hs)

name: recFun_mem_funs
statement:
theorem recFun_mem_funs {X : ZFSet} {x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s) :
    recFun x s hx hs ∈ funs Nat X
proof: := mem_funs.mpr (recFun_is_func hx hs)

name: fapply_recFun
statement:
theorem fapply_recFun {X : ZFSet} {x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s)
    {n : ZFSet} (hn : n ∈ Nat) :
    fapply (recFun x s hx hs) (recFun_is_pfunc hx hs)
        ⟨n, by zdom⟩
      = recVal x s hx hs ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  have key : n.pair (recVal x s hx hs ⟨n, hn⟩).val ∈ recFun x s hx hs := by
    rw [recFun, lambda_spec]
    exact ⟨hn, Subtype.property _, by rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hn)]⟩
  rw [fapply.of_pair (recFun_is_pfunc hx hs) key]

name: recFun_zero
statement:
theorem recFun_zero {X : ZFSet} {x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s) :
    ZFSet.pair ∅ x ∈ recFun x s hx hs
proof:
:= by
  rw [recFun, lambda_spec]
  refine ⟨ZFNat.zero_in_Nat, hx, ?_⟩
  rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true ZFNat.zero_in_Nat)]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (recVal_zero hx hs).symm

name: recFun_comp_succFun
statement:
theorem recFun_comp_succFun {X : ZFSet} {x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s) :
    composition (recFun x s hx hs) succFun Nat Nat X
      = composition s (recFun x s hx hs) Nat X X
proof:
:= by
  rw [is_func_ext_iff
    (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc (recFun_is_func hx hs) succFun_is_func)
    (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hs (recFun_is_func hx hs))]
  intro n hn
  rw [fapply_composition (recFun_is_func hx hs) succFun_is_func hn,
    fapply_composition hs (recFun_is_func hx hs) hn]
  have hsucc : (fapply succFun succFun_is_pfunc
      ⟨n, by zdom⟩).val = insert n n :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (fapply_succFun hn)
  have hrec : (fapply (recFun x s hx hs) (recFun_is_pfunc hx hs)
      ⟨n, by zdom⟩).val
      = (recVal x s hx hs ⟨n, hn⟩).val :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (fapply_recFun hx hs hn)
  simp only [hsucc, hrec]
  rw [fapply_recFun hx hs (ZFNat.succ_mem_Nat' hn)]
  exact recVal_succ hx hs ⟨n, hn⟩

name: recFun_unique
statement:
theorem recFun_unique {X : ZFSet} {x s h : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : IsFunc X X s)
    (hh : IsFunc Nat X h) (h0 : ZFSet.pair ∅ x ∈ h)
    (hstep : composition h succFun Nat Nat X = composition s h Nat X X) :
    h = recFun x s hx hs
proof:
:= by
  
  have H_zero : fapply h (is_func_is_pfunc hh)
      ⟨(0 : ZFNat).val, by zdom⟩ = ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    fapply.of_pair (is_func_is_pfunc hh) h0
  have H_succ : ∀ k : ZFNat,
      fapply h (is_func_is_pfunc hh)
          ⟨k.succ.val, by zdom⟩
        = @ᶻs ⟨(fapply h (is_func_is_pfunc hh)
              ⟨k.val, by zdom⟩).val,
            by zdom⟩ := by
    intro k
    have hn := k.property
    have hpt := (is_func_ext_iff (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hh succFun_is_func)
      (IsFunc_of_composition_IsFunc hs hh)).mp hstep k.val hn
    rw [fapply_composition hh succFun_is_func hn, fapply_composition hs hh hn] at hpt
    have hsucc : (fapply succFun succFun_is_pfunc
        ⟨k.val, by zdom⟩).val = insert k.val k.val :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (fapply_succFun hn)
    simp only [hsucc] at hpt
    exact hpt
  
  have key : ∀ k : ZFNat,
      fapply h (is_func_is_pfunc hh) ⟨k.val, by zdom⟩
        = recVal x s hx hs k :=
    ZFNat.rec_unique (motive := fun _ => {y // y ∈ X}) ⟨x, hx⟩
      (fun _ ih => @ᶻs ⟨ih.val, by zdom⟩)
      (fun k => fapply h (is_func_is_pfunc hh)
        ⟨k.val, by zdom⟩)
      H_zero H_succ
  rw [is_func_ext_iff hh (recFun_is_func hx hs)]
  intro n hn
  rw [fapply_recFun hx hs hn]
  exact key ⟨n, hn⟩

name: funs_nat_recursion
statement:
theorem funs_nat_recursion {X x s : ZFSet} (hx : x ∈ X) (hs : s ∈ funs X X) :
    ∃! h, h ∈ funs Nat X ∧
      ZFSet.pair ∅ x ∈ h ∧
      composition h succFun Nat Nat X = composition s h Nat X X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨recFun x s hx (mem_funs.mp hs), ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact recFun_mem_funs hx (mem_funs.mp hs)
  · exact recFun_zero hx (mem_funs.mp hs)
  · exact recFun_comp_succFun hx (mem_funs.mp hs)
  · rintro h ⟨hh, h0, hstep⟩
    exact recFun_unique hx (mem_funs.mp hs) (mem_funs.mp hh) h0 hstep

name: arrowCongr_apply
statement:
theorem arrowCongr_apply {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Sort*} (e₁ : α₁ ≃ α₂) (e₂ : β₁ ≃ β₂)
    (f : α₁ → β₁) (x : α₂) : e₁.arrowCongr e₂ f x = e₂ (f (e₁.symm x))
proof: := rfl

name: arrowCongr_symm_apply
statement:
theorem arrowCongr_symm_apply {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Sort*} (e₁ : α₁ ≃ α₂) (e₂ : β₁ ≃ β₂)
    (f : α₂ → β₂) (x : α₁) : (e₁.arrowCongr e₂).symm f x = e₂.symm (f (e₁ x))
proof: := rfl

name: arrowCongr_symm_iterate
statement:
theorem arrowCongr_symm_iterate {α β : Sort*} (e : α ≃ β) (f : β → β) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    ((e.arrowCongr e).symm f)^[n] x = e.symm (f^[n] (e x))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => exact (e.symm_apply_apply x).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    change ((e.arrowCongr e).symm f)^[n] (((e.arrowCongr e).symm f) x) = _
    rw [ih, arrowCongr_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl

name: prodCongr_apply
statement:
theorem prodCongr_apply {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Type*} (e₁ : α₁ ≃ α₂) (e₂ : β₁ ≃ β₂)
    (p : α₁ × β₁) : e₁.prodCongr e₂ p = (e₁ p.1, e₂ p.2)
proof: := rfl

name: prodCongr_symm_apply
statement:
theorem prodCongr_symm_apply {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Type*} (e₁ : α₁ ≃ α₂) (e₂ : β₁ ≃ β₂)
    (p : α₂ × β₂) : (e₁.prodCongr e₂).symm p = (e₁.symm p.1, e₂.symm p.2)
proof: := rfl

name: forallLift
statement:
theorem forallLift {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (e : α ≃ β) (p : α → Prop) :
    (∀ x, p x) ↔ ∀ x, p (e.symm x)
proof: := e.forall_congr_left

name: existsLift
statement:
theorem existsLift {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (e : α ≃ β) (p : α → Prop) :
    (∃ x, p x) ↔ ∃ x, p (e.symm x)
proof: := e.exists_congr_left

name: eqLift
statement:
theorem eqLift {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (e : α ≃ β) (x y : α) :
    x = y ↔ e x = e y
proof: := (e.apply_eq_iff_eq).symm
